notes: Apple cider simmered with cinnamon sticks, cloves, orange, and lemon — a non-alcoholic warming holiday drink.

name: Antipasto salad
notes: Romaine tossed with salami, pepperoni, mozzarella or provolone, marinated artichokes, olives, peperoncini, and an Italian-style vinaigrette.

name: Chicken tacos
notes: Shredded or diced seasoned chicken folded into soft or crispy tortillas, topped with lettuce, cheese, salsa, and lime crema.

name: Chicken breasts
notes: Boneless chicken breasts baked or sautéed with mushrooms and sour cream — a generic weeknight chicken preparation.

name: Pudding poke cake
notes: A baked cake poked with holes and soaked with a pudding-and-condensed-milk mixture, topped with whipped topping and crumbled candy.

name: Rice and broccoli casserole
notes: Cooked rice baked with broccoli, cream of mushroom soup, and Cheez Whiz or shredded cheese — sometimes with chicken stirred in.

name: Fudgy brownies
notes: Dense, gooey brownies leaning toward truffle texture — high in butter and chocolate, low in flour, baked just until the center sets.

name: Carrot soup
notes: Carrots simmered with onion, ginger, and broth, blended smooth and finished with cream — bright orange and silky.

name: Cheesy potato soup
notes: Diced potatoes simmered with onion and chicken broth, blended (or partially mashed), and finished with milk, butter, and shredded cheese.

name: Shepherd's pie
notes: Ground lamb (or beef, then "cottage pie") simmered with onions, carrots, peas, and gravy, topped with mashed potatoes, and baked.

name: Smothered pork chops
notes: Pork chops dredged in flour, browned, then braised in onion-and-mushroom gravy until tender — a Southern comfort dish.

name: Hot wings (Buffalo)
notes: Deep-fried chicken wings tossed in Frank's RedHot and butter — Buffalo, NY style; served with celery and blue cheese.

name: Caramel rolls
notes: Yeasted dough rolled around cinnamon-sugar and baked over brown-sugar-butter-cream syrup with pecans, then inverted to serve sticky-side-up.

name: Chewy oatmeal cookies
notes: Drop cookies of oats, butter, brown sugar, and warm spices baked at lower heat — chewy rather than crisp, often with raisins.

name: Mississippi mud pie
notes: A chocolate-cookie crust filled with a fudgy chocolate-pudding-and-cream-cheese layer, topped with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

name: Hermits
notes: A New England spiced bar cookie with molasses, raisins, walnuts, and warm spices — kept in a tin to mellow.

name: Mexican bean dip
notes: Refried beans warmed with shredded cheese, salsa, sour cream, and taco seasoning — served with tortilla chips.

name: Wild rice soup
notes: Wild and long-grain rice simmered with mushrooms, onions, carrots, and chicken (or bacon) in a creamy broth — a Minnesota favorite.

name: Cheese pie
notes: A sweet pie of cream cheese, eggs, sugar, and vanilla baked in a graham crust — essentially a slimmer cheesecake.

name: Zucchini nut bread
notes: A spiced quick bread folded with grated zucchini and chopped walnuts or pecans — moist with a tender crumb.

name: Venison stew
notes: Cubed venison browned and slow-braised with potatoes, carrots, onions, and herbs in broth until tender — a hunting-camp classic.

name: Chiles rellenos casserole
notes: Whole green chiles split open and layered with cheese, then poured over with an egg-and-milk batter and baked — a deconstructed chile relleno.

name: Lemon Jello cake
notes: A yellow cake baked from a mix combined with lemon Jello, eggs, and oil — poked and saturated after baking with a lemon-sugar glaze.

name: Seafood chowder
notes: A creamy New England chowder of shrimp, crab, scallops, and white fish simmered with potatoes, onion, and milk-or-cream.

name: Upside-down German chocolate cake
notes: Coconut and pecans layered on the bottom of a pan, then chocolate cake batter and a cream-cheese-powdered-sugar layer that swirls down — earthquake-cake style.

name: Black Forest cake
notes: Chocolate sponge layered with sweet cherries, kirsch syrup, and whipped cream, topped with chocolate shavings — Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte.

name: Chicken quesadillas
notes: Flour tortillas folded around shredded chicken, peppers, onions, and melted cheese — griddled until golden, served with salsa and sour cream.

name: Icebox cake
notes: Chocolate wafers or graham crackers layered with whipped cream in a loaf pan, chilled overnight until the cookies soften into cake — Famous Wafers original.

name: Zucchini appetizers
notes: Grated zucchini baked with eggs, flour, Parmesan, and herbs in a sheet pan, then cut into bite-size squares for appetizers.

name: Barbecued meatballs (variant)
notes: Oven-baked beef meatballs simmered in barbecue sauce or a grape-jelly-and-chili-sauce glaze — held warm in a slow cooker.

name: Fresh salsa
notes: Diced tomato, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime, and salt — a fresh chunky salsa for chips and tacos.

name: Black bean salsa
notes: Black beans tossed with corn, diced tomato, peppers, red onion, cilantro, lime, and cumin — a chunky bean-corn salsa.

name: Turkey meatloaf
notes: Ground turkey bound with breadcrumbs, eggs, and seasonings, baked in a loaf with a ketchup glaze — a leaner meatloaf alternative.

name: Baked bean casserole (calico)
notes: Canned beans baked with ground beef, bacon, brown sugar, and barbecue sauce — same as calico beans / cowboy beans.

name: Braised red cabbage
notes: Shredded red cabbage slow-braised with apples, onions, vinegar, sugar, and warm spices — a German Rotkohl side.

name: Mexican cheese dip (queso)
notes: Velveeta-style processed cheese melted with Rotel tomatoes and chiles — served warm with tortilla chips.

name: Baked ham
notes: A whole or half ham scored, studded with cloves, glazed with brown sugar, pineapple juice, and mustard, then baked until caramelized.

name: Refrigerator bran muffins
notes: A bran-and-buttermilk muffin batter mixed once and stored in the fridge — baked off in small batches as needed for fresh morning muffins.

name: Barbecue ribs
notes: Pork ribs (spare or baby back) seasoned with a dry rub and slow-smoked or oven-baked, then basted repeatedly with barbecue sauce.

name: Hawaiian pie
notes: A no-bake pie of sweetened condensed milk whipped with lemon juice and folded with crushed pineapple, pecans, and whipped topping — millionaire pie variant.

name: Caramel apples
notes: Whole apples on sticks dipped in hot melted caramel, sometimes rolled in chopped nuts — a fairground and Halloween treat.

name: No-bake cheesecake
notes: Cream cheese whipped with sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, and whipped topping or whipped cream, set in a graham crust without baking.

name: Ground beef stroganoff
notes: Browned ground beef simmered with mushrooms and onion in a sour-cream-and-mushroom-soup gravy, served over egg noodles.

name: Baked French toast
notes: Cubed bread soaked overnight in an egg-cream-and-sugar custard, then baked into a strata-style breakfast — sometimes with a streusel topping.

name: Buttermilk cake
notes: A tender butter cake made tangy and moist by buttermilk and a little baking soda — often topped with a simple powdered-sugar glaze.

name: Stuffed French toast
notes: Thick slices of bread filled with sweetened cream cheese (and sometimes fruit jam), dipped in egg-and-milk custard, and griddled until golden.

name: Chocolate trifle
notes: Cubes of chocolate cake or brownies layered with chocolate pudding (sometimes spiked with Kahlúa), toffee bits, and whipped topping.

name: Texas chili
notes: Cubed beef stewed with chiles, cumin, and broth — no beans, no tomato in the strictest "bowl of red" Texas tradition.

name: Baked chicken and rice
notes: Chicken pieces and raw rice baked in mushroom-soup-and-broth gravy — hands-off until the rice is tender.

name: Vegetable pizza bars
notes: A crescent-roll crust spread with herbed cream cheese and topped with chopped raw vegetables and cheese — cut into squares; same as cold veggie pizza.

name: Slush punch
notes: A non-alcoholic punch of fruit juices and sugar frozen until slushy, then scooped and topped with ginger ale or lemon-lime soda.

name: Hot mulled cider
notes: Apple cider simmered with cinnamon sticks, cloves, allspice, and citrus — sweetened and served hot; sometimes spiked with rum or brandy.

name: Rotel chicken (King Ranch)
notes: Shredded chicken baked with rice or noodles, Rotel tomatoes-and-chiles, mushroom soup, and Velveeta until creamy and bubbly.

name: Mini pizzas
notes: English muffins, bagels, or biscuit-dough rounds topped with pizza sauce, pepperoni, and mozzarella, baked until bubbly — kid-friendly snack-size pizzas.

name: Apple coffee cake
notes: A tender butter cake folded with diced apples, topped with a brown-sugar-cinnamon-pecan streusel — served with morning coffee.

name: King Ranch casserole
notes: Shredded chicken layered with tortillas, Rotel tomatoes-and-chiles, mushroom and chicken soups, and shredded cheese — the Texas casserole.

name: Carrot soufflé
notes: Pureed cooked carrots whipped with eggs, sugar, butter, and a touch of flour, baked into a puffed sweet-savory side — Piccadilly Cafeteria-style.

name: Butterfinger cake
notes: A chocolate cake poked and saturated with sweetened condensed milk and caramel, topped with whipped topping and crushed Butterfinger bars.

name: Smothered chicken
notes: Chicken pieces dredged in flour, browned, then braised in onion-and-mushroom gravy until tender — a Southern comfort dish.

name: Stuffed chicken breasts
notes: Pounded chicken breasts rolled around fillings of cheese, herbs, spinach, or ham, then breaded and baked or pan-fried.

name: Sugarless apple pie
notes: A double-crust apple pie sweetened entirely by frozen apple-juice concentrate (no added sugar) — a diabetic-friendly variant.

name: Dried beef dip
notes: Cream cheese mixed with sour cream and torn dried (chipped) beef, peppers, and onion — served chilled or baked warm with crackers.

name: Veggie pizza bars (variant)
notes: A crescent-roll crust spread with herbed cream cheese and topped with chopped raw vegetables and cheese — cut into squares.

name: White cake
notes: A pure-white layer cake made with egg whites only (no yolks), butter, and milk — light, tight crumb, traditionally for weddings and birthdays.

name: Cream cheese mints (variant)
notes: Cream cheese kneaded with powdered sugar and peppermint extract, pressed into rubber molds or rolled into balls — wedding-table candies.

name: Sour cream apple pie
notes: A single-crust apple pie with sliced apples folded into a sour-cream-and-cinnamon custard, baked under a brown-sugar-pecan streusel.

name: Peach Jello salad
notes: Peach gelatin set with canned peaches and crushed pineapple, layered with sweetened cream cheese or whipped topping — a Southern molded dessert.

name: Cranberry Jello salad
notes: Cranberry Jello set with whole-berry cranberry sauce, crushed pineapple, orange, and chopped pecans — a Thanksgiving side-as-dessert.

name: Kool-Aid punch
notes: Kool-Aid powder mixed with pineapple juice, sugar, and ginger ale — a brightly colored kids' party punch.

name: Green pepper steak
notes: Strips of beef stir-fried with green bell peppers and onions in a soy-and-ginger sauce — served over rice.

name: Gourmet potatoes (hash brown casserole)
notes: Frozen hash browns baked with sour cream, butter, cream of chicken soup, and shredded cheddar under a buttered cornflake topping.

name: Holiday fruit salad
notes: Mandarin oranges, pineapple, cherries, cranberries, and chopped pecans folded with whipped topping or sour cream — a festive Southern dessert salad.

name: Hot and sour soup
notes: A Chinese soup of chicken broth, tofu, mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and egg ribbons seasoned with white pepper and rice vinegar — both hot and sour.

name: Layered lettuce salad
notes: Lettuce, peas, onion, eggs, bacon, and cheese layered in a glass bowl, sealed under a mayo-and-sugar topping — chilled overnight (same as 7-layer/24-hour salad).

name: Cucumber dip
notes: Cream cheese and sour cream whipped with grated cucumber, dill, and onion — served chilled with vegetables or chips.

name: Date nut balls
notes: Chopped dates cooked with butter, sugar, and egg, then stirred with Rice Krispies and pecans, rolled into balls and dusted in powdered sugar or coconut.

name: Tomato aspic
notes: Tomato juice set with gelatin and seasoned with celery, onion, and Worcestershire — a savory molded "salad" of the mid-century table.

name: Friendship tea
notes: A powdered hot-drink mix of instant tea, powdered Tang, sugar, and warm spices — gifted in jars to friends to be stirred into hot water.

name: American chop suey
notes: Cooked elbow macaroni mixed with browned ground beef, peppers, onions, and tomato sauce — a New England weeknight dish (unrelated to Chinese chop suey).

name: Upside-down pizza
notes: A casserole of ground beef and pizza sauce topped with mozzarella, then a pizza-dough or biscuit "crust" baked on top — inverted to serve.

name: Sweet potato salad
notes: Cubed roasted or boiled sweet potatoes tossed with red onion, peppers, lime, and a chipotle or honey-mustard dressing.

name: Shrimp gumbo
notes: Shrimp simmered in a dark-roux Louisiana broth with the trinity of vegetables, andouille sausage, okra, and Creole spices — served over rice.

name: Fajitas
notes: Marinated skirt or flank steak (or chicken) seared with sliced peppers and onions, served sizzling with warm tortillas and toppings.

name: Irish soda bread (raisin)
notes: A quick bread of flour, buttermilk, baking soda, and raisins — baked as a round loaf with a deep cross slashed on top.

name: Apple strudel
notes: Thinly stretched dough rolled around spiced apples, raisins, breadcrumbs, and walnuts, baked until crisp and dusted with powdered sugar.

name: Hot fudge cake
notes: A self-saucing chocolate cake — batter spread in a pan, topped with cocoa-sugar and boiling water; the cake rises and a fudge sauce sinks beneath as it bakes.

name: Curried fruit
notes: Mixed canned fruit (pineapple, peaches, pears, cherries) baked with brown sugar, butter, and curry powder — a sweet-savory side served warm with ham.

name: Hot buttered rum
notes: A creamy "batter" of butter, brown sugar, and warm spices stirred into hot water with rum — a winter cocktail.

name: Salsa dip
notes: Cream cheese topped with salsa and shredded cheese, baked or microwaved until melty — served with tortilla chips.

name: Ham ball
notes: Cream cheese mixed with deviled ham, onion, and seasonings, shaped into a ball and rolled in chopped pecans — served chilled with crackers.

name: Lemon cheesecake
notes: A baked cream-cheese cheesecake brightened with lemon juice and zest, set on a graham crust — sometimes topped with lemon curd.

name: Peach delight
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of pecan-shortbread crust, sweet cream cheese, peach pie filling, and whipped topping.

name: Ritz cracker pie
notes: A meringue-style pie of beaten egg whites, sugar, vanilla, and crushed Ritz crackers folded with chopped pecans — bakes into a chewy nut-pie.

name: Black bean salad
notes: Black beans tossed with corn, red onion, peppers, tomato, lime, and cilantro in a cumin-lime vinaigrette.

name: Butter pecan ice cream
notes: A custard ice cream flavored with butter and brown sugar, churned with toasted buttered pecans.

name: Shrimp jambalaya
notes: A Creole one-pot rice dish of shrimp, andouille, the holy trinity of vegetables, and Cajun spices.

name: Strawberry nut bread
notes: A spiced quick bread folded with chopped fresh or frozen strawberries and walnuts — moist and lightly sweet.

name: Dutch apple pie
notes: A single-crust apple pie topped with a buttery brown-sugar-flour crumb (Dutch streusel) in place of a top crust.

name: Pecan cookies
notes: Drop or rolled butter cookies folded with finely chopped pecans — toasty, crisp, and lightly sweet.

name: Tomato salad
notes: Sliced or wedged ripe tomatoes drizzled with olive oil, vinegar, salt, and fresh herbs — a summer salad in its simplest form.

name: Yellow cake
notes: A classic American butter cake with whole eggs (the yolks give it the yellow color) and milk — the baseline for layer cakes.

name: Sausage pinwheels
notes: A biscuit-mix dough rolled out, spread with cooked breakfast sausage, rolled into a log, sliced into pinwheels, and baked.

name: Picadillo
notes: Ground beef simmered with tomatoes, raisins, olives, peppers, onions, and warm spices — a Cuban-Caribbean braise served over rice or in empanadas.

name: Cherry yum yum
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of graham crust, sweet cream cheese, cherry pie filling, and whipped topping — same family as cherry delight.

name: Pumpkin nut bread
notes: A spiced quick bread of pumpkin puree, eggs, oil, and warm spices folded with chopped walnuts or pecans.

name: Impossible cheeseburger pie
notes: Browned ground beef and onions baked under a Bisquick-and-egg crust with shredded cheese on top — the Bisquick "impossible pie" classic.

name: Champagne salad
notes: Crushed pineapple, strawberries, bananas, and pecans folded with sweetened whipped cream and cream cheese, frozen — sliced and served like ice cream.

name: Turkey dressing
notes: Stuffing-style dressing of cubed bread, onions, celery, sage, broth, and eggs baked alongside the turkey — Thanksgiving classic.

name: Pineapple dessert
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of graham crust, sweet cream cheese, pineapple pudding, and whipped topping.

name: Potato bake
notes: Sliced or shredded potatoes baked with sour cream, cheese, and butter — funeral-potatoes-style.

name: Garlic chicken
notes: Chicken pieces baked or pan-seared with a generous amount of garlic, olive oil, herbs, and lemon — sometimes finished in butter.

name: Beef barley soup
notes: Cubed beef and pearl barley simmered with onions, carrots, celery, and tomatoes in beef broth until thick and hearty.

name: Apple dapple cake
notes: A moist oil-based cake folded with diced apples and pecans, soaked after baking with a brown-sugar caramel glaze poured over the warm cake.

name: Coconut cookies
notes: A butter drop cookie folded with shredded coconut — sometimes with chopped almonds or chocolate chips.

name: Chinese chews
notes: A chewy date-and-nut bar of flour, sugar, eggs, chopped dates, and walnuts baked and cut into squares, rolled in powdered sugar.

name: Turkey pot pie
notes: Diced cooked turkey and vegetables in a creamy gravy baked under a flaky pastry or biscuit crust — Thanksgiving leftovers reborn.

name: Homemade yogurt
notes: Milk heated, cooled to body temp, inoculated with a yogurt starter, and held warm overnight until set — a homemade live-culture yogurt.

name: Falafel
notes: A Middle Eastern fritter of soaked dried chickpeas ground with herbs, onion, garlic, cumin, and coriander, formed into balls and deep-fried.

name: Chocolate fudge pie
notes: A thin crustless chocolate pie of butter, sugar, eggs, cocoa, and flour — brownie-like with a glossy fudge top.

name: Hot spiced cider
notes: Apple cider simmered with cinnamon sticks, cloves, and citrus — a hot non-alcoholic autumn drink (alcoholic versions add rum or brandy).

name: Homemade Irish cream
notes: Sweetened condensed milk, cream, Irish whiskey, and instant coffee blended with chocolate syrup and vanilla — a homemade Bailey's.

name: Barbecued ribs
notes: Pork ribs seasoned with a dry rub, slow-smoked or oven-baked, and basted with barbecue sauce — slip-from-the-bone tender.

name: Meat pie
notes: A generic name for a savory pastry filled with seasoned ground or chopped meat and vegetables — shepherd-pie, tourtière, or hand-pie family.

name: Venison roast
notes: A whole venison roast larded with bacon or covered with strips, slow-roasted with onions, broth, and herbs until tender.

name: Old-fashioned sugar cookies
notes: A classic rolled-and-cut sugar cookie of butter, sugar, egg, flour, and vanilla — crisp at the edges, often glazed.

name: English muffins
notes: Yeasted dough rounds griddled (not baked) until golden, with the signature nooks and crannies — split with a fork and toasted.

name: Dilly bread
notes: A cottage-cheese yeast bread folded with dill and onion — chewy, savory, and tangy.

name: Four layer dessert
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of pecan-shortbread crust, sweetened cream cheese, chocolate or vanilla pudding, and whipped topping.

name: Peanut butter chocolate chip cookies
notes: Drop cookies of peanut butter, butter, brown sugar, and eggs studded with chocolate chips — softer than classic peanut butter cookies.

name: Spritz cookies
notes: A butter-and-egg dough pressed through a cookie press into shapes (wreaths, trees, stars) and baked into crisp Scandinavian holiday cookies.

name: Cherries in the snow
notes: A trifle-style dessert of cubed angel food cake folded with sweetened cream cheese, whipped topping, and cherry pie filling.

name: Cheese strata
notes: Bread cubes layered with cheese and ham or sausage, soaked overnight in an egg-and-milk custard, baked into a puffy strata.

name: Macaroni & cheese (variant)
notes: Elbow macaroni in a cheddar-bechamel sauce — same as macaroni and cheese.

name: Chocolate eclair dessert
notes: A no-bake icebox cake of graham crackers layered with vanilla pudding, topped with chocolate frosting — softens to eclair-like texture overnight.

name: Banana nut muffins
notes: Tender muffins of mashed banana, eggs, butter, and chopped walnuts or pecans.

name: Corned beef salad
notes: A molded lemon-gelatin salad set with diced corned beef, hard-boiled egg, celery, and pickles — a retro Southern luncheon dish.

name: Fried apples
notes: Sliced tart apples cooked in butter with cinnamon and brown sugar until tender — a Southern breakfast side served with bacon and grits.

name: Company potatoes
notes: Frozen hash browns baked with sour cream, butter, cream of chicken soup, and shredded cheese under a cornflake topping — funeral potatoes variant.

name: Collard greens
notes: Tough leafy collards slow-cooked for an hour or more with smoked pork (ham hock, bacon, or fatback) and a touch of vinegar.

name: Pecan puffs (snowballs)
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar shortbread folded with finely chopped pecans, baked into balls and rolled in powdered sugar — Russian-tea-cake family.

name: Drop sugar cookies
notes: A soft, cake-like sugar cookie dropped from a spoon (no rolling and cutting) — often glazed with a powdered-sugar icing.

name: Cauliflower casserole
notes: Cauliflower florets baked in a cheese-and-cream sauce under a buttered cracker topping.

name: S'mores
notes: Toasted marshmallow and a square of chocolate sandwiched between two graham crackers — the campfire dessert.

name: Chicken fricassee
notes: Chicken pieces lightly browned, then braised in a white-wine-and-cream sauce with mushrooms, onions, and herbs.

name: Green tomato pie
notes: A double-crust pie of sliced unripe green tomatoes tossed with sugar, vinegar, and spices — eats like a mock apple pie.

name: Blackberry jam cake
notes: A spiced buttermilk layer cake with blackberry jam folded into the batter, often frosted with caramel icing — Appalachian classic.

name: Cherry pudding cake
notes: A self-saucing pudding cake — batter spread with cherries, topped with sugar and boiling water, baked so the cake rises while a cherry sauce sinks beneath.

name: Yogurt pie
notes: A no-bake pie of flavored yogurt folded with whipped topping, poured into a graham crust and chilled until set.

name: Sausage dip
notes: Browned breakfast sausage simmered with Velveeta and Rotel tomatoes — served warm with tortilla chips.

name: Never fail fudge
notes: A foolproof fudge of evaporated milk, sugar, butter, chocolate chips, and marshmallow creme — same family as million dollar fudge.

name: Lace cookies
notes: A thin, crisp drop cookie of butter, sugar, oats (or almonds), and a touch of flour — spreads to a lacy net as it bakes.

name: Fried corn
notes: Fresh corn kernels sautéed with butter and bacon, finished with cream and a touch of sugar — a Southern summer side.

name: Apple pudding cake
notes: A spiced apple batter baked in a pan and served warm with a butter-sugar sauce — a homey one-pan dessert.

name: Chocolate cupcakes
notes: Individual cocoa cakes baked in muffin tins, frosted with chocolate buttercream or ganache.

name: Banana oatmeal cookies
notes: Drop cookies of mashed banana, oats, brown sugar, butter, and warm spices — chewy and naturally sweet.

name: Potato rolls
notes: Soft yeasted dinner rolls enriched with mashed potato — extra tender, slightly sweet, with a long shelf life.

name: Pork roast
notes: A pork loin, shoulder, or rib roast seasoned with garlic, herbs, and brown sugar, oven-roasted until the crust is glazed and the meat tender.

name: Bagels
notes: Ring-shaped yeasted breads briefly boiled in malted water, then baked — chewy interior, glossy crust; the New York Jewish staple.

name: Cranberry mold
notes: A molded cranberry-gelatin salad set with whole-berry cranberry sauce, crushed pineapple, oranges, celery, and chopped nuts.

name: Vidalia onion pie
notes: Sliced sweet Vidalia onions sautéed in butter, layered in a pastry crust, and baked under an egg-and-cheese custard.

name: Molasses cake
notes: A dark spiced butter or oil cake leavened with baking soda and sweetened heavily with molasses — moist and gingerbread-like.

name: Greek pasta salad
notes: Cooked pasta tossed with cucumber, tomato, red onion, olives, feta, and oregano in a lemon-olive-oil dressing.

name: Fruitcake cookies (variant)
notes: Drop cookies of candied fruit, dates, raisins, and pecans bound by a buttermilk-and-bourbon-style spiced batter — fruitcake flavor in cookie form.

name: Chocolate chip muffins
notes: Tender muffins of butter, sugar, eggs, and milk folded with chocolate chips — a sweeter morning treat.

name: Sourdough biscuits
notes: A biscuit dough leavened in part by sourdough starter discard — tangy crumb with a flaky baking-powder lift.

name: Poor man's steak
notes: Ground beef mixed with crushed crackers, milk, and seasonings, chilled, sliced like steak, browned, and baked in cream of mushroom soup.

name: Porcupine meatballs (variant)
notes: Ground beef and uncooked rice meatballs simmered in tomato sauce — the rice grains poke out as they cook.

name: Broccoli soufflé
notes: Chopped broccoli folded into a cheese bechamel base, lightened with beaten egg whites, and baked until puffed.

name: Chicken Dijon
notes: Pan-seared chicken breasts finished in a cream-and-Dijon-mustard sauce with herbs — French bistro style.

name: Cinnamon buns
notes: Yeasted dough rolled around cinnamon-butter-sugar, sliced into pinwheels, baked, and drizzled with a powdered-sugar or cream-cheese glaze.

name: Rice Krispies treats
notes: Rice Krispies cereal stirred into melted butter and marshmallows, pressed into a pan, cooled, and cut into squares.

name: Fruit salad dressing (cooked)
notes: A cooked dressing of pineapple juice, egg, sugar, and butter (sometimes lemon) cooled and folded with whipped cream — for ambrosia-style fruit salads.

name: Candy cane cookies
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar dough divided in two, one half tinted red and peppermint-flavored, twisted into candy-cane shapes and baked.

name: Caramel cake
notes: A yellow butter layer cake frosted with a poured-and-set caramel icing made by cooking sugar to a dark amber and beating in cream and butter.

name: Pumpkin pancakes
notes: Buttermilk pancake batter folded with pumpkin puree and warm spices — served with maple syrup or cinnamon-butter.

name: Creamy chicken enchiladas
notes: Tortillas rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, baked in a sour-cream-and-green-chile bechamel sauce topped with more cheese.

name: Black beans and rice
notes: Black beans simmered with peppers, onions, garlic, and cumin, served over white rice — a Cuban-style "Moros y Cristianos" weeknight base.

name: Spice tea
notes: Black tea simmered with orange juice, cinnamon sticks, and cloves — sweetened and served hot; same family as Russian tea.

name: No-bake chocolate cookies
notes: Cocoa, sugar, milk, and butter boiled to a fudge, then stirred with peanut butter and oats and dropped onto wax paper to set.

name: Oven-fried potatoes
notes: Wedges or slices of potato tossed in oil and seasonings, then baked at high heat until crisp outside and tender inside.

name: Layered taco dip
notes: A cold layered dip of refried beans or seasoned sour cream, salsa, cheese, lettuce, and olives — served with tortilla chips.

name: Sour cream coconut cake
notes: A layered yellow cake split horizontally and saturated with a sour-cream-sugar-coconut mixture, then refrigerated for several days to mellow.

name: Cherry cake
notes: A butter cake studded with maraschino or fresh cherries, often topped with a cherry or vanilla glaze.

name: Zucchini lasagna
notes: Strips of zucchini in place of pasta sheets, layered with ricotta, mozzarella, marinara, and ground beef — a low-carb lasagna variant.

name: Pineapple pound cake
notes: A dense pound cake with crushed pineapple and its juice folded into the batter, often glazed with a pineapple-sugar syrup.

name: Chewy chocolate cookies
notes: Cocoa drop cookies of butter, eggs, brown sugar, and a little flour — baked just until the centers set for a chewy texture.

name: Rhubarb bread
notes: A spiced quick bread folded with chopped rhubarb, often topped with a brown-sugar-cinnamon streusel.

name: English pea salad
notes: Sweet green peas tossed with hard-boiled eggs, cheddar, sweet pickles, and a mayo-based dressing — a Southern picnic side.

name: Pecan balls
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar shortbread folded with finely chopped pecans, baked into balls and rolled in powdered sugar — same family as pecan puffs.

name: Raspberry Jello salad
notes: Raspberry gelatin set with frozen raspberries and crushed pineapple, layered with sour cream — a chilled Southern dessert salad.

name: Snack mix (Chex)
notes: Chex cereals, pretzels, and mixed nuts coated in a buttery Worcestershire-and-seasoning blend, baked until crisp — Chex party mix family.

name: Cream of tomato soup
notes: Tomatoes simmered with onion, butter, and herbs, blended smooth and enriched with milk and cream — often paired with grilled cheese.

name: Brownie pie
notes: A pecan-pie-style filling of eggs, butter, sugar, and flour, packed with chocolate chips and walnuts — like a gooey brownie in a pie shell.

name: Zucchini muffins
notes: Spiced muffins of grated zucchini, eggs, oil, and walnuts — moist with a tender crumb.

name: Reuben dip
notes: Cream cheese, sour cream, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and corned beef baked until bubbly — Reuben sandwich flavors as a hot dip.

name: Chiles rellenos
notes: Roasted poblano chiles stuffed with cheese, dipped in an egg-white batter, and fried golden — served in tomato sauce.

name: Chicken lasagna
notes: Layered lasagna noodles with shredded chicken, ricotta, mozzarella, mushrooms, and either a tomato or alfredo sauce.

name: Stuffed potatoes
notes: Baked russet potatoes split, scooped, mashed with butter, sour cream, cheese, and bacon, returned to the shells and baked again — twice-baked potatoes.

name: Chocolate peanut butter pie
notes: A no-bake pie of peanut butter whipped with cream cheese and folded into whipped topping, layered with chocolate pudding in an Oreo crust.

name: Cream cheese cake
notes: A baked cream-cheese cheesecake — same family as classic cheesecake but sometimes folded with whipped cream for lightness.

name: Pumpkin cake roll
notes: A thin pumpkin sponge cake baked on a sheet pan, rolled while warm with a tea-towel, then unrolled, spread with cream cheese filling, and re-rolled.

name: Party meatballs
notes: Pan-fried meatballs simmered in a sauce of grape jelly and chili sauce — held warm in a slow cooker for cocktail parties.

name: 7-Up cake (variant)
notes: A citrus pound cake made with a bottle of 7-Up, sometimes glazed with pineapple-coconut topping — Southern dessert.

name: Porcupine meatballs
notes: Ground beef and uncooked rice meatballs simmered in tomato sauce — the rice grains poke out as they cook, giving the "porcupine" look.

name: Margarita
notes: Tequila, lime juice, and triple sec (or Cointreau) shaken with ice and served in a salt-rimmed glass — Mexico's most-exported cocktail.

name: Scottish shortbread
notes: A traditional Scottish biscuit of just butter, sugar, and flour in a 1:2:3 ratio — pressed flat, pricked, baked low, and cut into wedges.

name: London broil
notes: A flank or top-round steak marinated in soy, garlic, and Worcestershire, broiled hot, and sliced thin across the grain.

name: Taco pizza
notes: A crescent-roll or pizza-dough crust spread with refried beans or seasoned beef, baked, then topped cold with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and salsa.

name: Potato cakes
notes: Leftover mashed potatoes mixed with egg, onion, and flour, formed into patties and pan-fried until golden — a thrifty leftover dish.

name: Peanut butter bread
notes: A simple quick bread with peanut butter creamed into the butter-sugar base — tender and lightly nutty.

name: Golden punch
notes: A non-alcoholic punch of pineapple juice, orange juice, lemon juice, sugar, and ginger ale — golden and sparkling.

name: Chicken teriyaki
notes: Chicken pieces marinated or glazed in a soy-mirin-sugar sauce, then grilled or pan-cooked until lacquered — served over rice.

name: Italian vegetable soup
notes: A minestrone-style soup of mixed vegetables, beans, pasta, and ground beef simmered in a tomato-and-broth base with Italian herbs.

name: Lemon pudding cake
notes: A self-saucing cake — batter separates as it bakes into a tender cake top over a tart lemon-curd pudding bottom.

name: Soft pretzels (homemade)
notes: Yeasted dough shaped into pretzels, briefly dipped in a baking-soda bath, salted, and baked until deep brown and chewy.

name: Sad cake
notes: A simple bar dessert with brown sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, coconut, and pecans baked in a Bundt or sheet pan — sinks and "looks sad" but tastes rich.

name: Chow mein
notes: Stir-fried noodles tossed with vegetables, soy sauce, and chicken, pork, or beef — Chinese-American restaurant style.

name: Yeast bread
notes: A basic enriched yeasted sandwich loaf of flour, milk, sugar, butter, and eggs — soft crumb, golden crust.

name: Fruitcake (holiday)
notes: A dense holiday cake packed with candied fruit, dried fruit, nuts, and warm spices — often soaked in brandy or bourbon and aged.

name: Chinese fried rice
notes: Day-old cold rice stir-fried in a hot wok with eggs, scallions, peas and carrots, soy sauce, and often diced pork or shrimp.

name: Tortilla pinwheels
notes: Tortillas spread with herbed cream cheese, peppers, and olives, rolled and sliced into pinwheel rounds — a chilled appetizer.

name: Spiced tea mix
notes: A pantry mix of instant tea, powdered Tang, sugar, and warm spices — stirred into hot water; non-alcoholic.

name: Popsicles
notes: Sweetened fruit juice or pudding frozen in molds with sticks — a kids' summer treat.

name: Potato dumplings
notes: Mashed or grated potato bound with egg, flour, and breadcrumbs, formed into balls and boiled — German Kartoffelknödel, served with roast meats.

name: Candied pecans
notes: Pecans tossed in an egg-white-and-sugar slurry with cinnamon and salt, baked slowly until crisp.

name: Cheese Danish
notes: Sweet enriched dough wrapped around a sweetened cream-cheese filling and baked, finished with a powdered-sugar glaze.

name: Saucy meatloaf
notes: A ground-beef loaf bound with crumbs, milk, and egg, glazed with a sweet ketchup-brown-sugar-mustard sauce, and baked.

name: Italian spaghetti sauce
notes: A long-simmered tomato sauce with ground beef or Italian sausage, onions, garlic, mushrooms, and Italian herbs — served over spaghetti.

name: Hot cocoa mix (pantry)
notes: A dry pantry mix of powdered milk, cocoa, sugar, and powdered creamer — stirred into hot water for instant cocoa.

name: Pumpkin chocolate chip cookies
notes: Soft cake-like drop cookies of pumpkin puree, butter, and warm spices folded with chocolate chips.

name: Stuffed baked potatoes (variant)
notes: Baked russets split, scooped, mashed with butter, sour cream, cheese, and herbs, returned to the shell and baked again — twice-baked potatoes.

name: Oreo cookie cake
notes: A no-bake icebox cake of crushed Oreos layered with sweetened cream cheese and chocolate pudding, topped with whipped topping.

name: Potato latkes
notes: Grated potato and onion mixed with egg, salt, and a little flour, pan-fried into crisp pancakes — Ashkenazi Jewish Hanukkah staple.

name: Blondies (variant)
notes: Brown-sugar-and-butter bars in the shape of brownies but with vanilla in place of chocolate — sometimes with butterscotch or chocolate chips.

name: Hobo dinner (foil packets)
notes: Ground beef patties, sliced potatoes, carrots, and onions sealed in foil packets and baked or grilled — a campfire-or-oven one-packet meal.

name: Homemade salami
notes: Ground beef mixed with Morton Tender Quick cure, seasonings, garlic, and liquid smoke, shaped into logs and slow-baked — a homemade summer-sausage-style salami.

name: Veggie dip
notes: Sour cream and mayo seasoned with dried dill, parsley, onion, and Beau Monde or ranch mix — served chilled with raw vegetables.

name: Orange delight
notes: Orange Jello set with mandarin oranges, crushed pineapple, and sweetened cream cheese — a Southern molded dessert salad.

name: Impossible quiche
notes: A blender custard of eggs, milk, Bisquick, cheese, and ham or sausage — self-crusts as it bakes; no pastry shell needed.

name: Coconut balls
notes: Sweetened coconut mixed with butter, sweetened condensed milk, and pecans, rolled into balls and dipped in melted chocolate — Martha Washington-style.

name: Ham salad
notes: Ground or finely chopped cooked ham bound with mayo, sweet pickle relish, mustard, and chopped egg — served as a sandwich filling or with crackers.

name: Sour cream biscuits
notes: A drop biscuit made tangy and tender by sour cream stirred into butter and self-rising flour — no rolling required.

name: Sauerkraut balls
notes: Sausage, sauerkraut, and cream cheese mixed and chilled, formed into balls, breaded, and fried — an Ohio cocktail-party appetizer.

name: Fruit slush
notes: Crushed fruit and juices sweetened and frozen in a container, then scooped slushy into glasses — sometimes topped with lemon-lime soda.

name: Baked potatoes
notes: Whole russet potatoes baked in their skins at high heat until tender, split open and topped with butter, sour cream, chives, and cheese.

name: Sweet sandwich spread
notes: A cooked sweet-tart spread of ground vegetables (cucumber, peppers, onion) bound with a flour-and-egg mayonnaise — spread on bread for "ladies' lunch" sandwiches.

name: Mexican wedding cakes (variant)
notes: A butter shortbread folded with finely ground nuts (almonds or pecans), baked into balls and rolled in powdered sugar — same family as Russian tea cakes.

name: Sausage breakfast casserole
notes: Browned breakfast sausage layered with bread, eggs, milk, and shredded cheese — assembled overnight and baked in the morning.

name: Oatmeal crispies
notes: Thin crisp drop cookies of butter, brown sugar, oats, and chopped nuts — like an oatmeal cookie pressed flat.

name: Crab bisque
notes: A rich seafood-broth-and-cream soup with lump crab, sherry, and aromatics, thickened with a buttery roux.

name: French toast casserole
notes: Cubed bread soaked overnight in an egg-cream-cinnamon custard, then baked into a strata-style breakfast — sometimes with a streusel topping.

name: Yum yum salad
notes: A molded orange-gelatin salad set with crushed pineapple, shredded cheese, and whipped topping — a Southern church-supper dish.

name: Sour cream pound cake
notes: A dense pound cake enriched with sour cream — tender, fine-crumbed, and slightly tangy.

name: Mincemeat
notes: A spiced preserve of chopped beef (or suet), apples, dried fruit, citrus, brandy or rum, and warm spices — used as pie filling at the holidays.

name: Zucchini cookies
notes: Soft drop cookies of grated zucchini, butter, brown sugar, oats or raisins, and warm spices.

name: Hot cocoa
notes: Cocoa, sugar, milk, and a pinch of salt heated until steaming — the from-scratch version of hot chocolate.

name: Mud pie
notes: Softened coffee or chocolate ice cream spread into a chocolate-cookie crust, frozen, then topped with fudge sauce and whipped cream.

name: Chili mac
notes: Cooked elbow macaroni mixed with chili (ground beef, beans, tomatoes, chili spices), often topped with shredded cheese — quick weeknight comfort.

name: Onion-roasted potatoes
notes: Potato chunks tossed with a packet of onion soup mix and oil, roasted hot until crisp and golden — Lipton recipe-card classic.

name: Friendship cake
notes: A cake baked using a "friendship starter" of brandy-soaked fermenting fruit passed between bakers — the fruit is folded into cake-mix batter with pecans.

name: Pineapple sheet cake
notes: A one-bowl sheet cake folded with crushed pineapple and its juice, often topped with cream cheese frosting.

name: Hot clam dip
notes: Cream cheese and butter melted with minced clams, lemon, and Worcestershire, baked until bubbly — served warm with crackers.

name: Cherry chocolate cake (dump)
notes: A chocolate cake mix combined with canned cherry pie filling and eggs (no oil or water), baked and topped with chocolate fudge frosting.

name: Mandarin salad
notes: Romaine and red leaf lettuce tossed with mandarin oranges, sugared almonds, scallions, and a sweet vinaigrette.

name: Green enchiladas
notes: Corn tortillas rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, baked in salsa verde (tomatillo-based green sauce), and topped with more cheese.

name: Cream pie
notes: A baked pastry shell filled with a cooked vanilla, chocolate, banana, or coconut custard pudding and topped with whipped cream.

name: Frozen peanut butter pie
notes: Peanut butter whipped with cream cheese and folded into whipped topping, poured into an Oreo crust, and frozen until firm.

name: Turkey meatballs
notes: Ground turkey bound with breadcrumbs, egg, herbs, and Parmesan, rolled into balls and baked or simmered in marinara — a leaner meatball.

name: Baked tomatoes
notes: Halved tomatoes topped with seasoned breadcrumbs, herbs, and Parmesan, drizzled with olive oil and baked until tender.

name: Divinity fudge
notes: A fluffy white candy of hot sugar syrup whipped into stiff egg whites with vanilla and pecans — dropped onto wax paper to set, between fudge and meringue.

name: Salmon casserole
notes: Canned salmon baked with egg noodles, peas, cream of mushroom soup, and cheese under a buttered breadcrumb topping.

name: One-dish skillet meal
notes: Ground beef browned with onions, peppers, potatoes, and tomato, then simmered with rice or noodles into a one-skillet weeknight dish.

name: Shrimp ball
notes: Cream cheese mixed with chopped shrimp, onion, and seasonings, shaped into a ball and rolled in chopped parsley or pecans — served with crackers.

name: Pot pie
notes: Diced chicken or beef and vegetables in a creamy gravy baked under a flaky pastry or biscuit crust.

name: Dried beef cheese ball
notes: Cream cheese mixed with sour cream, dried (chipped) beef, onion, and Worcestershire, shaped into a ball — served chilled with crackers.

name: Ham and potato casserole
notes: Cubed ham baked with sliced or shredded potatoes in a cream-of-chicken-soup-and-cheese sauce — a hands-off leftover-ham bake.

name: Kahlúa cake
notes: A chocolate Bundt cake from chocolate cake mix and chocolate pudding mix, with Kahlúa stirred into the batter and brushed on after baking.

name: Coconut cream cake
notes: A white cake poked and saturated with sweetened cream of coconut, topped with whipped topping and toasted coconut.

name: Orange slice cookies
notes: Drop cookies with chopped orange-slice candies (gumdrop-style) folded into the dough with coconut and oats.

name: Strawberry pudding
notes: Vanilla pudding folded with sliced strawberries and whipped topping, layered with vanilla wafers — Southern banana-pudding cousin.

name: Cheesy scalloped potatoes
notes: Thinly sliced potatoes layered with onions in a milk-and-cream bechamel with shredded cheddar, baked until bubbling and golden.

name: Shortcake biscuits
notes: Sweet split biscuits of flour, sugar, butter, eggs, and milk — the foundation for strawberry shortcake when layered with macerated berries and whipped cream.

name: Rice dressing (Cajun)
notes: Cooked rice mixed with browned ground beef, pork, and chicken livers, the trinity of vegetables, and Cajun seasoning — a Louisiana stuffing alternative.

name: Molasses crinkles
notes: Soft spiced cookies of molasses, brown sugar, butter, and warm spices rolled in granulated sugar — the surface crinkles as they bake.

name: Italian casserole
notes: A baked pasta with ground beef, peppers, mushrooms, ricotta, mozzarella, and marinara — a lasagna-style one-dish meal.

name: Buttermilk coconut pie
notes: A Southern custard pie of buttermilk, eggs, sugar, butter, and shredded coconut baked in a flaky shell — tangy and chewy.

name: Scalloped cabbage
notes: Shredded cabbage baked in a cheesy milk-and-roux bechamel under buttered cracker crumbs — a hearty Pennsylvania-Dutch side.

name: Frozen strawberry salad
notes: Sliced strawberries and crushed pineapple folded with sweetened cream cheese, sour cream, and chopped pecans, frozen in a pan and sliced.

name: Stuffed eggplant
notes: Halved eggplants hollowed and filled with seasoned breadcrumbs, herbs, and Parmesan (sometimes ground beef), baked until tender.

name: Oreo dessert
notes: A no-bake icebox dessert of crushed Oreos layered with whipped sweetened cream cheese, chocolate pudding, and whipped topping.

name: Homemade crescent rolls
notes: A buttery yeasted dough rolled out, cut into wedges, rolled up from the wide end, and baked into curved crescents.

name: Baked caramel corn
notes: Popped corn tossed with a butter-brown-sugar-corn-syrup caramel and slow-baked until crisp and shiny — same family as Cracker Jack.

name: Layered Mexican dip
notes: A cold layered dip of refried beans or seasoned sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, lettuce, and olives — served with tortilla chips.

name: Couscous salad
notes: Cooked couscous tossed with diced peppers, cucumber, tomato, herbs, lemon, and olive oil — sometimes with feta and chickpeas.

name: Navy bean soup
notes: Dried navy beans slow-simmered with a ham hock or bone, carrots, celery, and onion — the U.S. Senate dining-room classic.

name: Chicken with rice
notes: Chicken pieces baked or simmered with rice in seasoned broth or cream-soup gravy until both are tender — generic "chicken and rice".

name: Pavlova
notes: A crisp-edged, marshmallow-centered meringue base topped with whipped cream and fresh fruit (often kiwi and berries) — Australian/New Zealand dessert.

name: Diabetic spice cake
notes: A sugar-free spiced cake sweetened by raisins or applesauce instead of granulated sugar — a diabetic-friendly variant.

name: Mexican wedding cake (sheet)
notes: A one-bowl sheet cake of crushed pineapple, sugar, eggs, flour, and pecans, baked and topped with cream cheese frosting — the Southern "Mexican fruit cake".

name: Sherbet punch
notes: Scoops of orange or rainbow sherbet floated in a bowl of fruit juices and ginger ale — a creamy non-alcoholic party punch.

name: Cream cheese bars
notes: A yellow-cake-mix base topped with a sweetened cream cheese filling, baked and cut into bars — same family as gooey butter cake.

name: Apple dessert
notes: Spiced sliced apples baked under a butter-and-flour crumb topping — generic name for apple crisp / crumble / square.

name: Scalloped chicken
notes: Cooked chicken layered with herbed bread cubes and cream-of-chicken-soup gravy, baked into a moist Southern-style dressing-and-chicken bake.

name: Chocolate dessert
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of pecan-shortbread crust, sweetened cream cheese, chocolate pudding, and whipped topping.

name: Cocktail wieners
notes: Mini hot dogs (Lit'l Smokies) simmered in a sweet-tangy sauce of grape jelly and chili sauce or barbecue sauce — held warm in a slow cooker.

name: No-bake fruitcake
notes: Crushed graham crackers or vanilla wafers mixed with candied fruit, dates, nuts, and sweetened condensed milk — pressed in a pan and chilled.

name: Sawdust salad
notes: Layered lemon-and-orange Jello set with crushed pineapple, then topped with a cooked pudding-and-whipped-topping layer — the "sawdust" is shredded cheese sprinkled on top.

name: Red rice (Lowcountry)
notes: Long-grain rice cooked with tomato, bacon, peppers, and onions — a Charleston Gullah-Geechee Lowcountry side dish.

name: Mississippi mud
notes: A dense chocolate sheet cake or brownie base topped with marshmallow creme and a layer of chocolate-pecan frosting — gooey and sweet.

name: Pizza bread
notes: A loaf of bread split or sliced, spread with pizza sauce, topped with cheese and pepperoni, and baked — open-faced pizza on bread.

name: Potato skins
notes: Hollowed-out baked potato halves brushed with butter, filled with cheese, bacon, and chives, and broiled until crisp — bar-and-grill appetizer.

name: English muffin bread
notes: A no-knead yeasted bread baked in a loaf pan dusted with cornmeal — when toasted, slices have the nooks and crannies of English muffins.

name: Chinese chicken
notes: A generic Chinese-American stir-fry of chicken with peppers, onions, water chestnuts, and a soy-and-sugar sauce — served over rice.

name: Flourless chocolate cake
notes: A dense gluten-free torte of butter, dark chocolate, eggs, and sugar baked low — fudgy, intense, and naturally crackled on top.

name: Lemon fluff
notes: Lemon pudding folded with sweetened condensed milk and whipped topping, poured into a graham crust and chilled — same family as lemon icebox pie.

name: Cornflake cookies
notes: Drop cookies with cornflakes, coconut, and chopped pecans folded into a peanut-butter-and-sugar dough — chewy with crunch.

name: Seasoned snack crackers
notes: Saltines or oyster crackers tossed with oil, dry ranch mix, and seasonings, baked until aromatic — a seasoned party snack.

name: Beef vegetable soup
notes: Cubed beef simmered with potatoes, carrots, celery, tomato, and herbs in beef broth — a stockpot weeknight soup.

name: Lemon chiffon pie
notes: A lemon custard lightened with gelatin and beaten egg whites, poured into a baked crust and chilled — airier than lemon meringue.

name: Porcupine meatballs (variant)
notes: Ground beef and uncooked rice meatballs simmered in tomato sauce — the rice pokes out as it cooks.

name: Seafood pasta salad
notes: Cooked rotini or shells tossed with shrimp or imitation crab, broccoli, peppers, and a creamy or Italian dressing — chilled.

name: Chicken and dressing casserole
notes: Shredded chicken layered with cornbread or stuffing dressing and mushroom-soup gravy, baked into the Southern Thanksgiving-leftover staple.

name: Strawberry congealed salad
notes: Strawberry Jello set with frozen strawberries and crushed pineapple, layered with sour cream — a chilled Southern molded dessert.

name: Chicken Rotel
notes: Shredded chicken baked with cooked pasta or rice, Rotel tomatoes-and-chiles, mushroom soup, and Velveeta — same family as Rotel chicken / King Ranch.

name: Amish sugar cookies
notes: Soft cake-like sugar cookies made tender by both butter and oil with powdered sugar in the dough — light, pillowy, and easy.

name: Crabbies (crab melts)
notes: English-muffin halves topped with a mixture of crab, mayo, Old Bay, and shredded cheese, broiled or baked until bubbly.

name: Velveeta fudge
notes: A surprising fudge that melts Velveeta with butter, sugar, cocoa, and vanilla — the cheese acts as an emulsifier for a smooth set.

name: Rhubarb cream pie
notes: Chopped rhubarb baked in a sour-cream-and-egg custard within a single crust — silky and tart.

name: Shipwreck casserole
notes: Layered raw potatoes, onions, ground beef, rice, beans, and tomato soup baked slow until everything is tender — a Depression-era one-pan dinner.

name: Shrimp butter
notes: Cream cheese, butter, and chopped shrimp blended smooth with lemon and seasonings — a chilled spread for crackers.

name: Colcannon
notes: Mashed potatoes folded with sautéed kale or cabbage and scallions, enriched with milk and butter — Ireland's celebratory mash.

name: Stuffed artichokes
notes: Whole artichokes spread leaves filled with seasoned breadcrumbs, garlic, Parmesan, and olive oil, then steamed or braised — Italian-American.

name: Cowboy stew
notes: A hearty stew of ground beef, potatoes, beans, corn, and tomato seasoned with chili powder — campfire-friendly one-pot.

name: Sautéed mushrooms
notes: Whole or sliced mushrooms cooked hard in butter and oil until golden, then finished with garlic and herbs — a steakhouse side.

name: Scotch eggs
notes: Hard-boiled eggs wrapped in sausage meat, coated in breadcrumbs, and deep-fried or baked golden — a British pub snack.

name: Pink stuff
notes: Cherry pie filling folded with sweetened condensed milk, crushed pineapple, mini marshmallows, and whipped topping — a Southern dessert salad.

name: Four-bean salad
notes: Green, kidney, garbanzo, and wax beans tossed with onion, peppers, and a sweet vinegar dressing — chilled overnight.

name: Chicken and spaghetti
notes: Spaghetti baked with shredded chicken, peppers, onions, mushrooms, and Velveeta cheese sauce — Southern church-supper casserole.

name: Snowball cookies (variant)
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar shortbread folded with finely chopped pecans, baked into balls and rolled twice in powdered sugar.

name: Snickerdoodle cookies
notes: Soft butter cookies rolled in cinnamon-sugar before baking, with a slight tang from cream of tartar.

name: Stir-fry
notes: A generic name for vegetables and meat (chicken, beef, or shrimp) tossed quickly in a hot wok with soy-based sauce, served over rice or noodles.

name: Orange sherbet salad
notes: Orange Jello set with orange sherbet, mandarin oranges, and crushed pineapple — a chilled Southern dessert salad.

name: Refrigerator cookies
notes: A butter-sugar dough rolled into a log, chilled until firm, then sliced and baked — same as icebox cookies.

name: Maryland crab soup
notes: Lump crab and chopped vegetables simmered in a tomato-and-beef broth with Old Bay and a splash of sherry — Chesapeake-style.

name: Million dollar pound cake
notes: A classic pound cake with a high ratio of butter and eggs — exceptionally rich, fine-crumbed, and tall.

name: Marinated chicken wings
notes: Chicken wings marinated in soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and brown sugar, then baked until sticky and bronzed.

name: Hot chicken salad casserole
notes: Shredded chicken bound with mayo, celery, and water chestnuts, topped with crushed potato chips or cornflakes and cheese, baked hot.

name: Hamburger quiche
notes: A pastry shell filled with browned ground beef, onion, cheese, eggs, and cream, baked into a savory custard tart.

name: Chocolate chip banana bread
notes: Banana bread folded with chocolate chips — moist quick bread with melty chocolate pockets.

name: Peanut butter oatmeal cookies
notes: Drop cookies of peanut butter, oats, butter, and brown sugar — chewy and protein-rich.

name: Banana salad
notes: Sliced bananas tossed with a cooked custard dressing of egg, sugar, vinegar, and flour, topped with chopped peanuts — a Southern picnic dessert.

name: Mincemeat cookies
notes: Drop cookies of butter-sugar-and-egg dough folded with prepared mincemeat (spiced fruit-and-suet preserve) — holiday favorite.

name: Double chocolate brownies
notes: Fudgy brownies made with both cocoa and melted chocolate, often with chocolate chips folded in — three forms of chocolate in one bar.

name: Creamy potato salad
notes: Boiled potatoes tossed with mayo, mustard, eggs, celery, sweet pickle, and onion — the classic picnic potato salad.

name: Sour cream potatoes
notes: Potato cubes baked with sour cream, butter, cream of chicken soup, and shredded cheese — funeral-potatoes variant.

name: Barbecued pork chops
notes: Pork chops baked or grilled and basted with a sweet-tangy barbecue sauce until lacquered.

name: Sour cream tea cakes
notes: A simple sugar-butter cookie enriched with sour cream — soft, lightly sweet, and nutmeg-scented in the Southern tradition.

name: Angel pie
notes: A baked meringue shell filled with lemon curd and topped with sweetened whipped cream — sometimes with strawberries on top.

name: Layer salad (variant)
notes: Lettuce, peas, onion, eggs, bacon, and cheese layered in a glass bowl, sealed under a mayo-and-sugar topping — chilled overnight.

name: Strawberry rhubarb pie
notes: A double-crust pie of sliced strawberries and rhubarb tossed with sugar and a thickener — sweet-tart with a pink interior.

name: Chocolate pizza
notes: A round of melted chocolate poured onto parchment and topped with chopped nuts, dried fruit, and crispy cereal — broken into pieces.

name: Blueberry cheesecake
notes: A baked or no-bake cream-cheese cheesecake topped with blueberry pie filling on a graham crust.

name: Special K bars
notes: Special K cereal stirred into a hot peanut-butter-and-sugar syrup, pressed into a pan, and topped with melted chocolate and butterscotch.

name: Indian fry bread
notes: A leavened flour-and-baking-powder dough rolled flat and deep-fried until puffed and golden — Native American (Navajo) staple, served with savory or sweet toppings.

name: Chicken Divan (variant)
notes: Cooked chicken and steamed broccoli baked in a sherry-and-curry-laced cream sauce topped with cheese and breadcrumbs.

name: Baked corn casserole
notes: A spoon-bread-style bake of corn kernels, creamed corn, eggs, butter, and sour cream — sweet, custardy, almost pudding-like.

name: Fresh peach cobbler
notes: Sliced fresh peaches baked under a buttery cake or biscuit topping — a Southern dessert served warm with ice cream.

name: Skillet lasagna
notes: Broken lasagna noodles cooked in a skillet with ground beef, marinara, ricotta, and mozzarella — all the lasagna flavor in one pan.

name: Eggs Benedict
notes: Toasted English muffin halves topped with Canadian bacon, poached eggs, and hollandaise sauce — the brunch classic.

name: Chicken fried steak
notes: Cube steak dredged in seasoned flour and milk, pan-fried until crisp, and served smothered in milk-or-cream gravy — Texas comfort.

name: Zucchini squares
notes: Grated zucchini baked with eggs, flour, Parmesan, and herbs in a sheet pan, then cut into bite-size squares — appetizer family of zucchini appetizers.

name: Polenta
notes: Coarse cornmeal simmered slowly in water or stock with butter and Parmesan until thick and creamy — Italian cornmeal porridge.

name: Shoepeg corn casserole
notes: Canned white shoepeg corn baked with sour cream, butter, French-fried onions, and shredded cheese — a Midwestern potluck side.

name: Maryland crab cakes
notes: Lump blue-crab bound with mayo, egg, and a small amount of breadcrumb (very little filler), seasoned with Old Bay and broiled or pan-fried.

name: Pineapple chicken
notes: Chicken pieces simmered in a sweet-sour sauce of pineapple, soy, vinegar, and brown sugar — served over rice with peppers.

name: Noodle casserole
notes: Cooked egg noodles baked with ground beef, mushrooms, peppers, and cheese in a tomato or cream-soup sauce.

name: Steak Diane
notes: Pounded steaks pan-seared and finished in a pan sauce of butter, mushrooms, shallots, Worcestershire, mustard, cream, and brandy — flambéed tableside.

name: Salmon spread
notes: Canned salmon mixed with cream cheese, lemon, horseradish, and chopped onion — chilled as a cracker spread.

name: Potato leek soup
notes: Sliced leeks sweated in butter, simmered with potatoes and broth, then blended smooth and finished with cream — French country classic.

name: Barbecue cups
notes: Browned ground beef simmered with barbecue sauce, brown sugar, and onion, spooned into biscuit-dough-lined muffin cups, topped with cheese, and baked.

name: Onion dip
notes: Sour cream mixed with a packet of Lipton onion soup mix — the original chip-and-dip pairing.

name: Welsh rarebit
notes: A bechamel-based melted cheddar sauce flavored with beer, mustard, and Worcestershire, poured hot over toast and broiled.

name: Pineapple coconut pie
notes: A custard pie of eggs, sugar, butter, crushed pineapple, and shredded coconut baked in a single crust.

name: Strawberry nut salad
notes: Strawberry Jello set with crushed pineapple, frozen strawberries, and chopped pecans, layered with sour cream — Southern dessert salad.

name: Marinated shrimp
notes: Cooked shrimp tossed with sliced onions, capers, lemon, and an oil-and-vinegar marinade — chilled overnight as an appetizer.

name: Shoofly cake
notes: A Pennsylvania Dutch cake-style version of shoofly pie — molasses-and-water layer baked under a sandy crumb topping.

name: Corned beef hash
notes: Diced cooked potatoes and chopped corned beef pan-fried with onions and peppers until crisp — served with eggs at diner breakfast.

name: Shrimp mousse
notes: A molded appetizer of chopped shrimp folded into cream cheese, mayo, and gelatin, set in a fish-shaped mold and turned out — served with crackers.

name: Shrimp cocktail
notes: Poached chilled shrimp served with a horseradish-laced tomato-ketchup cocktail sauce — a classic appetizer.

name: Brown sugar pie
notes: A Quebec/Southern chess-pie variant of brown sugar, butter, eggs, flour, and a splash of milk or cream baked in a single crust — caramel-toned.

name: Shrimp curry
notes: Shrimp simmered in a curry-spiced cream or coconut sauce with peppers and onions — served over rice with chutney.

name: Ham delights
notes: Hawaiian sweet rolls split, filled with ham and Swiss, brushed with a butter-mustard-poppy-seed-onion glaze, and baked until melty.

name: French-fried onion rings
notes: Sliced onion rings dipped in a milk-and-egg batter, dredged in seasoned flour, and deep-fried until crisp and golden.

name: String bean casserole
notes: Green beans baked in cream-of-mushroom soup with milk and topped with crispy fried onions — the Campbell's green-bean casserole.

name: Chicken liver pâté
notes: Chicken livers sautéed with onions and herbs, then blended smooth with butter, brandy, and seasonings — chilled and served with toasts.

name: Indian pudding
notes: Cornmeal slow-baked in milk with molasses, butter, eggs, and warm spices — a New England colonial dessert served warm with cream or ice cream.

name: Wild rice salad
notes: Cooked wild and long-grain rice tossed with chicken or turkey, dried cranberries, pecans, peppers, and a citrus vinaigrette.

name: Glazed pecans
notes: Pecan halves coated in an egg-white-and-sugar slurry with cinnamon and salt, baked slowly until crisp — same family as candied/spiced pecans.

name: Banana pancakes
notes: Buttermilk pancake batter folded with mashed banana and a touch of cinnamon — served with maple syrup or fresh fruit.

name: Broccoli slaw (ramen)
notes: Bagged broccoli slaw tossed with crushed ramen noodles, slivered almonds, sesame seeds, and a soy-vinegar-sugar dressing — chilled.

name: Chex party mix (canonical)
notes: Chex cereals, pretzels, and mixed nuts coated in a buttery Worcestershire-and-seasoning blend, then baked until crisp — the canonical Chex Mix recipe.

name: Chicken vegetable soup
notes: Chicken simmered with mixed vegetables, herbs, and broth — a clear-broth weeknight soup, often with rice or noodles.

name: Apple pound cake
notes: A dense oil-based pound cake folded with diced fresh apples and pecans, often soaked with a caramel-brown-sugar glaze.

name: Busy day casserole
notes: A 1950s pantry casserole of ground beef, peppers, rice, mushroom soup, and tomato baked together with cheese on top — minimal prep.

name: Pumpkin pudding
notes: Pumpkin puree, eggs, sugar, evaporated milk, and warm spices baked in a dish without a crust — pumpkin pie filling, crustless.

name: Biscotti
notes: A twice-baked Italian almond cookie — dough baked in a log, sliced, then baked again until dry and crisp, made for dipping in coffee or wine.

name: Whipping cream pound cake
notes: A dense pound cake enriched with heavy whipping cream in place of butter — exceptionally moist, tender, and fine-crumbed.

name: Caramel apple salad
notes: Diced apples, crushed pineapple, and peanuts folded with a cooked egg-and-flour dressing (mimicking caramel-apple coating) and whipped topping.

name: Crabmeat casserole
notes: Lump crab mixed with mayonnaise, eggs, milk, and seasonings, baked under buttered cracker crumbs and cheese — a Chesapeake casserole.

name: Chicken Continental
notes: Chicken pieces baked with raw rice in cream of mushroom soup and onion soup mix — same family as no-peek chicken.

name: Pizza hot dish
notes: Cooked pasta layered with ground beef, pepperoni, marinara, and mozzarella, baked until bubbly — a Midwestern "hot dish" pizza casserole.

name: Pumpkin pie squares
notes: A pumpkin-pie filling poured over a yellow-cake-mix-and-butter crust, topped with cinnamon-streusel and chopped pecans, baked into bars.

name: Apricot Jello salad
notes: Orange Jello set with canned apricots, crushed pineapple, and miniature marshmallows, layered with a cream-cheese-and-whipped-topping topping.

name: Banana ice cream
notes: A custard ice cream churned with pureed ripe bananas, milk, cream, sugar, and egg yolks.

name: Creamy coleslaw
notes: Shredded cabbage and carrot dressed in a sweet mayo-and-vinegar dressing with celery seed — KFC-style classic.

name: Linguine salad
notes: Cooked linguine tossed with chopped peppers, onions, olives, and a Salad Supreme-seasoned Italian dressing — chilled overnight.

name: Mostaccioli
notes: Penne-style tubes baked with seasoned ground beef in marinara, layered with ricotta and topped with mozzarella — a Midwestern Italian-American casserole.

name: Fig cake
notes: A spiced oil-based cake folded with fig preserves and pecans — moist, jammy, with a brown-sugar glaze.

name: Southern potato salad
notes: Boiled potatoes tossed with mayo, mustard, chopped egg, sweet pickle relish, and onion — the classic Southern picnic dish.

name: Corn dip
notes: Canned corn (often shoepeg) mixed with sour cream, cheese, mayo, and diced jalapeños — served chilled with tortilla chips.

name: Sugar-free apple pie
notes: A double-crust apple pie sweetened by frozen apple-juice concentrate in place of granulated sugar — a diabetic-friendly variant.

name: Curry chicken
notes: Chicken pieces simmered in a curry-spiced sauce with peppers and onions — served over rice with chutney.

name: Sour cream potato salad
notes: Boiled potatoes tossed with sour cream and mayo, hard-boiled eggs, scallions, and bacon — tangier than mayo-only potato salad.

name: Broccoli and chicken casserole
notes: Cooked chicken and broccoli baked in a mayo, lemon, and cream-of-chicken-soup sauce under buttered breadcrumbs and cheese.

name: Chicken pasta salad
notes: Cooked rotini or shells tossed with diced chicken, vegetables, cheese, and Italian or ranch dressing — chilled.

name: Orange cookies
notes: Soft drop cookies of orange juice, zest, butter, and sugar — glazed with a tangy orange-sugar icing while still warm.

name: Tortilla pinwheels (variant)
notes: Flour tortillas spread with seasoned cream cheese, salsa, olives, and green chiles, rolled and sliced into pinwheels — a Tex-Mex appetizer.

name: Avocado salad
notes: Diced avocado tossed with tomato, onion, peppers, lime, and cilantro — a chunky guacamole-adjacent salad.

name: Breadsticks
notes: A buttery yeasted dough cut into long sticks, brushed with garlic butter and Parmesan, and baked until golden — Olive Garden style.

name: Apricot bread
notes: A sweet quick bread folded with chopped dried apricots, soaked first in orange juice, and finished with a citrus glaze.

name: Crab-stuffed mushrooms
notes: Mushroom caps filled with a mixture of lump crab, cream cheese, breadcrumbs, lemon, and Old Bay, baked until golden.

name: Lamb stew
notes: Cubed lamb shoulder slow-braised with potatoes, carrots, onions, and herbs in seasoned broth — Mediterranean comfort.

name: Rumaki
notes: Chicken livers and water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, marinated in soy and brown sugar, then broiled — a tiki-bar appetizer.

name: Zucchini bars
notes: A spiced sheet-pan version of zucchini cake folded with grated zucchini and chopped pecans, topped with cream cheese frosting.

name: Cinnamon coffee cake
notes: A tender butter or sour-cream cake swirled with a cinnamon-sugar-pecan streusel — served with morning coffee.

name: Noodle kugel (variant)
notes: Egg noodles baked in a sweet custard of cottage cheese, sour cream, eggs, butter, sugar, and raisins — the Ashkenazi Jewish noodle pudding.

name: Baked eggplant
notes: Sliced eggplant dipped in egg, breaded, layered with tomato and Parmesan, and baked — a lighter eggplant parm.

name: Cranberry tea
notes: Cranberry juice simmered with cinnamon sticks, cloves, lemon, and orange — a hot non-alcoholic holiday drink.

name: Split pea soup (variant)
notes: Dried split peas slow-simmered with a ham hock or bone, carrots, celery, and onion until thick and creamy.

name: Apple brown Betty
notes: Spiced sliced apples layered with buttered breadcrumbs and brown sugar, baked until the topping browns — a colonial American dessert.

name: Oven caramel corn
notes: Popped corn tossed with a butter-brown-sugar-corn-syrup caramel and slow-baked until crisp and shiny.

name: Ribbon Jello salad
notes: Layered colored Jello set with sweetened cream-and-cream-cheese layers between — chilled in a glass dish to show the colored ribbons.

name: Peaches and cream pie
notes: Sliced peaches baked in a pie pan with a butter-flour-egg cake-like base, finished with a cream-cheese-and-sugar topping.

name: Sock-it-to-me cake
notes: A yellow Bundt cake from cake mix and sour cream with a cinnamon-pecan streusel swirled through the middle — Duncan Hines original.

name: Salad dressing (mayonnaise) cake
notes: A Depression-era chocolate cake using salad dressing or mayonnaise in place of butter and eggs — the dressing carries the fat and emulsion.

name: Cheese garlic biscuits
notes: A Bisquick drop biscuit mixed with sharp cheddar, brushed after baking with garlic-parsley butter — Red Lobster style.

name: Oriental chicken
notes: Chicken pieces stir-fried or baked with a sweet-soy-and-ginger sauce, peppers, and onions — served over rice; a vintage Chinese-American name.

name: Wilted lettuce salad
notes: Leaf lettuce and scallions dressed with a hot bacon-fat-and-vinegar dressing — wilts the greens slightly; an Appalachian classic.

name: Chip dip
notes: A generic name for a chilled sour-cream-and-mayonnaise dip seasoned with herbs and onion — served with potato chips.

name: Cherry crisp
notes: Sweetened cherries baked under a crunchy oat-and-butter streusel — served warm with ice cream.

name: Kidney bean salad
notes: Drained kidney beans tossed with chopped eggs, sweet pickles, onion, celery, and a mayo-vinegar dressing — chilled.

name: Mexican dish (casserole)
notes: Layered seasoned ground beef, salsa, beans, cheese, and tortilla chips baked together — a generic Tex-Mex casserole.

name: Tuna macaroni salad
notes: Cooked elbow macaroni tossed with canned tuna, sweet pickle relish, celery, onion, and mayo — chilled as a picnic salad.

name: Sweet rolls
notes: Soft enriched yeasted dough rolled around butter, sugar, and cinnamon, sliced into spirals and baked — drizzled with a powdered-sugar glaze.

name: Barbecued beef (sandwich)
notes: Slow-cooked shredded beef (chuck or brisket) tossed in a sweet-tangy barbecue sauce — served on soft buns with coleslaw.

name: Chili soup
notes: A thinner, soupier version of chili — ground beef simmered with tomatoes, beans, peppers, and chili powder in more broth.

name: German pancakes (Dutch baby)
notes: A thin batter of eggs, milk, flour, and salt poured into a hot buttered skillet and baked until it puffs at the edges — served with lemon and powdered sugar.

name: Sugared pecans
notes: Pecan halves tossed in an egg-white-and-sugar slurry with cinnamon and salt, baked slowly until crisp.

name: Curried chicken
notes: Chicken pieces simmered in a curry-spiced cream sauce with peppers, onions, and a touch of fruit — served over rice with chutney.

name: Fruit bars
notes: A short butter-flour crust topped with dried-or-candied-fruit-and-nut filling, baked and cut into bars — fruitcake-bar family.

name: Rocky road fudge
notes: A microwave or stovetop chocolate fudge folded with mini marshmallows and chopped peanuts or almonds.

name: Japanese fruit cake (Southern)
notes: A Southern layer cake with spiced raisin-and-pecan layers alternating with white-coconut layers, filled with lemon-coconut filling — American despite the name.

name: Cherry Coke salad
notes: Cherry Jello dissolved in hot Coca-Cola, set with crushed pineapple, cherries, and chopped pecans — a Southern molded dessert.

name: Drop biscuits
notes: A quick biscuit dough dropped from a spoon (no rolling and cutting) — tender, slightly craggy, and ready in under 20 minutes.

name: Coca-Cola salad
notes: Cherry Jello dissolved in Coca-Cola, set with crushed pineapple, cherries, and pecans, layered with sweetened cream cheese — Southern dessert.

name: Succotash
notes: Lima beans (or butter beans) and sweet corn simmered with onion, peppers, butter, and a touch of cream — a Native-American-rooted Southern side.

name: Blueberry pancakes
notes: Buttermilk pancake batter folded with fresh blueberries — griddled until golden and served with maple syrup.

name: Turkey salad
notes: Diced cooked turkey bound with mayo, celery, grapes, and nuts — a Thanksgiving leftovers chicken-salad cousin.

name: Cinnamon swirl bread
notes: A soft enriched yeasted loaf with a cinnamon-sugar swirl rolled into the dough — sliceable for cinnamon toast.

name: Zucchini patties
notes: Grated zucchini mixed with eggs, flour, Parmesan, and seasonings, dropped into oil and pan-fried into golden patties.

name: Coconut bonbons
notes: Sweetened coconut mixed with butter, sweetened condensed milk, and pecans, rolled into balls and dipped in melted chocolate — Martha-Washington-style.

name: Fresh fruit salad
notes: Diced fresh fruit (pineapple, strawberries, grapes, oranges) lightly tossed in a citrus-honey syrup — a clean, juice-bound fruit salad.

name: Dream bars
notes: A butter-shortbread crust topped with a coconut, brown-sugar, and pecan custard, baked into bars — same family as magic cookie / hello dollies bars.

name: Hash browns
notes: Grated or diced potato fried hot in butter or oil until crisp and golden — a diner breakfast side.

name: Cream cheese dip
notes: Cream cheese whipped smooth with sour cream, peppers, onion, and seasonings — served chilled with crackers or chips.

name: Potato wedges
notes: Russet potatoes cut into wedges, tossed in oil and seasonings, and roasted hot until crisp outside and tender inside.

name: Nacho cheese dip
notes: Velveeta-style processed cheese melted with Rotel tomatoes and chiles, sometimes with seasoned ground beef — served warm with tortilla chips.

name: Strawberry cream pie
notes: A graham crust filled with sweetened cream cheese, sliced strawberries, and a strawberry-Jello-and-gelatin glaze — chilled until set.

name: Grilled chicken
notes: Chicken pieces marinated in oil, lemon, and herbs, then grilled hot over coals or a gas grill until charred and juicy.

name: Cherry winks
notes: Drop cookies of butter, sugar, eggs, and chopped maraschino cherries and pecans, rolled in crushed cornflakes and topped with a cherry before baking.

name: Zucchini parmesan
notes: Sliced zucchini breaded with Parmesan, baked or fried, and layered with marinara and mozzarella — eggplant-parm style with zucchini.

name: Zucchini appetizer squares
notes: Grated zucchini baked with eggs, flour, Parmesan, and herbs in a sheet pan, then cut into bite-size squares.

name: Tuna patties
notes: Canned tuna bound with egg, breadcrumbs, onion, and seasonings, formed into patties and pan-fried until golden.

name: Oyster dressing
notes: Cornbread or bread cubes mixed with sautéed onions, celery, oysters, and broth, baked into a Thanksgiving dressing — Southern coastal tradition.

name: Cornflake cookies (variant)
notes: Drop cookies with cornflakes, coconut, and pecans folded into a peanut-butter-and-sugar dough — chewy with crunch.

name: Turkey meatloaf (variant)
notes: Ground turkey bound with breadcrumbs, eggs, herbs, and seasonings, baked in a loaf with a ketchup glaze — a leaner meatloaf.

name: Mediterranean chicken
notes: Chicken pieces baked with tomatoes, olives, capers, garlic, and oregano in olive oil and lemon — a one-pan Mediterranean bake.

name: Asian chicken salad
notes: Shredded cabbage and lettuce tossed with chicken, crispy ramen or wonton strips, almonds, sesame seeds, and a soy-and-sesame-oil dressing.

name: Pinto beans
notes: Dried pinto beans slow-simmered with bacon or ham hock, onion, garlic, and chiles — a Southern and Southwestern staple.

name: Seasoned oyster cracker snack
notes: Oyster crackers tossed with oil, dry ranch mix, dill, garlic, and lemon pepper, baked until aromatic — a seasoned party snack.

name: Green bean bundles
notes: Groups of green beans wrapped in bacon strips, brushed with a brown-sugar-butter glaze, and baked until the bacon crisps.

name: Caramel apple dip
notes: Sweetened condensed milk and brown sugar whipped with cream cheese and vanilla — served with sliced apples for dipping.

name: Chocolate balls
notes: A no-bake confection of crushed graham crackers or vanilla wafers mixed with peanut butter, coconut, and pecans, rolled into balls and dipped in chocolate.

name: Pasta e fagioli (variant)
notes: A rustic Italian soup of small pasta and beans in a tomato-and-broth base with garlic, herbs, and a Parmesan rind.

name: Broccoli puff
notes: Frozen broccoli baked with eggs, milk, mayo, and cream of mushroom soup under a buttered crumb-and-cheese topping.

name: Gumdrop cookies
notes: Drop cookies with chopped gumdrops folded into a butter-and-oat batter — chewy and colorful.

name: Tortilla casserole
notes: Layered tortillas with seasoned beef or chicken, enchilada sauce, and cheese — a Tex-Mex stacked enchilada bake.

name: Pork fried rice
notes: Day-old cold rice stir-fried with diced pork, eggs, peas, scallions, and soy sauce — Chinese-American takeout style.

name: Sour cream cornbread (variant)
notes: A skillet cornbread enriched with sour cream and creamed corn — moist, slightly sweet, with a tender crumb.

name: Oat bran muffins
notes: A high-fiber muffin of oat bran, raisins, applesauce, and milk — slightly sweet and moist.

name: Creamed chicken
notes: Diced cooked chicken in a milk-and-butter bechamel with onions and peppers — served over biscuits, toast, or noodles.

name: Scotch shortbread (variant)
notes: A traditional Scottish biscuit of butter, sugar, and flour — pressed flat, pricked, baked low, and cut into wedges or fingers.

name: Salmon burgers
notes: Fresh or canned salmon bound with egg, breadcrumbs, lemon, dill, and onion, formed into patties and pan-fried — served on buns with tartar sauce.

name: Banana split sundae
notes: A split banana lengthwise served with three scoops of ice cream, hot fudge, strawberry, pineapple, whipped cream, nuts, and cherries — the ice-cream-parlor classic.

name: Beef tips and gravy
notes: Cubed sirloin browned and slow-simmered with mushrooms and onions in a brown gravy — served over rice or egg noodles.

name: Butter cake
