notes: A classic American layer cake with a high butter ratio, made with creamed butter, sugar, eggs, and milk — moist and yellow-tinted.

name: Chocolate peanut butter balls (buckeyes)
notes: Peanut butter and powdered sugar balls partially dipped in melted chocolate — same as buckeyes.

name: Cottage pie
notes: Ground beef simmered with onions, carrots, peas, and gravy, topped with mashed potatoes and baked — British shepherd-pie-with-beef.

name: Gingerbread men
notes: Rolled spiced cookies of butter, brown sugar, and molasses cut into human shapes, baked crisp, and decorated with royal icing.

name: Seven layer bars
notes: Graham crust topped with chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, and pecans, drizzled with sweetened condensed milk and baked — same as Hello Dollies / Magic Cookie Bars.

name: Breakfast quiche
notes: A pastry shell filled with eggs, cream, breakfast sausage or bacon, and cheese, baked until just set — a brunch staple.

name: Challah
notes: A braided egg-enriched yeasted bread of flour, eggs, oil, sugar, and yeast — the Jewish Sabbath and holiday loaf.

name: Cheese ring (Atlanta)
notes: Shredded sharp cheddar mixed with mayo, onion, garlic, and pecans, molded into a ring and filled with strawberry preserves — Southern cocktail-party appetizer.

name: Deer (venison) jerky
notes: Strips of venison marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, and spices, then slow-dried in a low oven or dehydrator until chewy.

name: Honey chicken
notes: Chicken pieces glazed with a sauce of honey, butter, mustard, and curry or paprika, baked until caramelized and sticky.

name: Strawberry butter
notes: Softened butter whipped with crushed fresh or frozen strawberries and powdered sugar — a sweet spread for scones, biscuits, and toast.

name: Sweet and sour pork chops
notes: Pork chops browned and braised in a sweet-tangy sauce of pineapple juice, vinegar, brown sugar, soy, and ketchup — served over rice.

name: Pork tenderloin
notes: A whole pork tenderloin rubbed with garlic, herbs, and spices, seared and roasted, or grilled — sliced into medallions.

name: Skillet cabbage
notes: Shredded cabbage sautéed in bacon fat with onions, peppers, and a touch of sugar — a Southern stovetop side.

name: Chicken and stuffing casserole
notes: Cooked chicken baked under herbed stuffing mix soaked in chicken broth and cream of mushroom soup — Thanksgiving-leftovers style.

name: Cream of asparagus soup
notes: Asparagus simmered in chicken broth with onion, blended smooth, and finished with cream and butter.

name: Baked salmon
notes: A salmon fillet baked with butter, lemon, herbs, and seasonings until the flesh just flakes — simple and lean.

name: Peanut butter kisses
notes: Peanut butter cookies rolled in sugar and pressed with a Hershey's Kiss right out of the oven — same as peanut butter blossoms.

name: Caponata
notes: Diced eggplant cooked with tomato, onion, celery, capers, olives, and a sweet-and-sour vinegar-and-sugar glaze — a Sicilian relish.

name: Creamy broccoli soup
notes: Broccoli simmered with onion in chicken broth, blended (or partially), and thickened with a milk-and-butter roux finished with cheddar.

name: Chicken and wild rice casserole
notes: Cooked chicken baked with a wild rice mix, mushrooms, and cream-of-mushroom-soup gravy — a Minnesota potluck staple.

name: Pecan bars
notes: A shortbread crust topped with pecan-pie custard, baked and cut into bars — pecan pie in finger-food form.

name: Boston cream pie
notes: Two yellow sponge layers sandwiched with vanilla pastry cream and topped with a thin chocolate glaze — Massachusetts state dessert.

name: Dirt cups
notes: Chocolate pudding portioned into cups, topped with crushed Oreos to look like dirt, and garnished with gummy worms — a kids' party dessert.

name: Tuna pasta salad
notes: Cooked rotini or shells tossed with canned tuna, peas, peppers, celery, and a creamy mayo-mustard dressing — chilled.

name: Marinated cucumbers
notes: Thinly sliced cucumber and onion tossed in a sweet vinegar dressing — chilled until crisp.

name: Oven-roasted potatoes
notes: Cubed potatoes tossed with oil, herbs, and seasonings, roasted hot until crisp outside and tender inside.

name: Raisin cookies
notes: Soft drop cookies of butter, brown sugar, eggs, flour, and plumped raisins — sometimes spiced, sometimes plain.

name: Hash brown potatoes
notes: Shredded hash brown potatoes baked with sour cream, cream of chicken soup, and shredded cheddar — also called funeral potatoes.

name: Ceviche
notes: Raw shrimp or white fish diced and "cooked" in lime juice, then tossed with tomato, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and avocado.

name: Egg and sausage casserole
notes: Browned breakfast sausage layered with bread, eggs, milk, and cheese — assembled overnight and baked in the morning.

name: Celery casserole
notes: Sliced celery baked with mushroom or chicken soup, water chestnuts, slivered almonds, and shredded cheese under a buttered cracker top.

name: Vanilla custard
notes: Eggs, milk, sugar, and vanilla cooked gently or baked in a water bath until softly set — silky and lightly sweetened.

name: Jello dessert
notes: Layered or molded gelatin desserts with fruit, cream cheese, and whipped topping — generic name for several Southern Jello desserts.

name: Cheese cookies (savory)
notes: A short cheddar-and-butter dough piped or sliced from a log into thin crisp savory rounds — same family as cheese straws.

name: Marinated slaw
notes: Shredded cabbage and peppers tossed with a sweet vinegar-and-oil dressing rather than mayo — chilled overnight, holds for days.

name: Smothered steak
notes: Round or cube steak dredged in flour and browned, then braised slowly with onions and gravy until fork-tender — Southern comfort.

name: Soft chocolate chip cookies
notes: Drop cookies leaning on brown sugar and extra egg yolk for chew, with chocolate chips folded in — pillowy and underbaked.

name: Vanilla pudding
notes: Sugar, cornstarch, milk, eggs, and vanilla cooked into a thick stovetop pudding, finished with butter — chilled before serving.

name: Hobo bread (coffee-can)
notes: A spiced quick bread of raisins, sugar, baking soda, flour, and oil baked in a coffee can — Depression-era road-cook bread.

name: Meatball stew
notes: Browned meatballs simmered with potatoes, carrots, onions, and tomato in seasoned broth — a thick, comforting one-pot.

name: Sausage and cheese balls
notes: Bite-size baked balls of breakfast sausage, shredded cheddar, and biscuit mix — same as sausage balls.

name: Beer cheese soup
notes: Vegetables sautéed in butter, simmered with beer and chicken broth, and finished with milk and shredded cheddar — a Wisconsin classic.

name: Seafood dip
notes: Cream cheese, mayo, and sour cream mixed with shrimp, crab, lemon, and seasonings — served chilled or warm with crackers.

name: Oriental chicken salad
notes: Shredded chicken and cabbage tossed with crushed ramen noodles, slivered almonds, sesame seeds, and a soy-vinegar-sugar dressing.

name: Hard candy
notes: Sugar, water, and corn syrup cooked to hard-crack stage (300°F), flavored with extract and food color, poured to set and broken into pieces.

name: Almond Joy cake
notes: A chocolate sheet cake topped with a coconut-and-marshmallow layer and a chocolate-almond ganache — Almond Joy candy flavors in cake form.

name: Venison chili
notes: Ground or cubed venison simmered with tomatoes, beans, peppers, onions, and chili spices — a leaner game-meat take on chili.

name: Chocolate meringue pie
notes: A baked pastry shell filled with cooked chocolate pudding and topped with a billowing toasted meringue.

name: Cheese krispies
notes: Sharp cheddar, butter, and flour mixed with Rice Krispies and cayenne, dropped and pressed, then baked into crisp savory bites — Southern.

name: BLT dip
notes: Sour cream and mayo mixed with crumbled bacon, diced tomato, and chopped lettuce — BLT-sandwich flavors as a chilled dip.

name: Butterscotch bars
notes: A brown-sugar-and-butter blondie packed with butterscotch chips and pecans — chewy and toffee-toned.

name: Cream puff cake
notes: A pâte-à-choux base baked in a sheet pan, then topped with vanilla pudding mixed with cream cheese and finished with whipped topping and chocolate drizzle.

name: Chile con queso
notes: Processed cheese melted with green chiles, tomatoes, onion, and cumin — served warm as a Tex-Mex dipping sauce for tortilla chips.

name: Cheese enchiladas
notes: Corn tortillas dipped in red chile sauce, rolled around shredded cheese and onion, baked in more sauce and topped with cheese — vegetarian Tex-Mex.

name: Salmon chowder
notes: Diced potatoes and salmon simmered in chicken broth with onions and dill, finished with milk and cream — Pacific-Northwest style.

name: Strawberry spinach salad
notes: Baby spinach tossed with sliced strawberries, red onion, and toasted almonds in a poppy-seed-and-balsamic vinaigrette.

name: Carnitas
notes: Pork shoulder slow-braised with citrus, onion, and Mexican spices until tender, then crisped — served in tortillas with onion, cilantro, and salsa.

name: Moroccan chicken
notes: Chicken braised with preserved lemon, olives, dried fruit (apricots or prunes), onion, and warm spices like cumin, cinnamon, and ginger — tagine-style.

name: Pizza cups
notes: Browned ground beef simmered in pizza sauce and pepperoni, spooned into biscuit-dough-lined muffin cups, topped with mozzarella, and baked.

name: Church windows
notes: A no-bake confection of melted chocolate stirred with colored mini marshmallows and chopped nuts, rolled into a log and sliced into stained-glass-pattern rounds.

name: Potatoes Romanoff
notes: Shredded or sliced cooked potatoes mixed with sour cream, cottage cheese, garlic, and shredded cheese, baked until hot and bubbly.

name: Squash soufflé
notes: Cooked yellow squash mashed with eggs, butter, sugar, and milk and baked under a buttered cracker top until puffed.

name: Three bean casserole
notes: Mixed beans baked with ground beef, bacon, brown sugar, and barbecue sauce — same family as calico beans / cowboy beans.

name: Chocolate mousse pie
notes: A chocolate cookie crust filled with an airy chocolate mousse of melted chocolate, whipped cream, and beaten egg whites — chilled and served with whipped cream.

name: Black magic cake
notes: A buttermilk-and-oil cocoa cake brought to extra moistness with strong brewed coffee in the batter — tall, tender, and intensely chocolate.

name: Impossible taco pie
notes: Seasoned ground beef and Tex-Mex toppings baked under a Bisquick-egg-milk crust that self-crusts as it bakes — taco flavors in pie form.

name: Instant spiced tea
notes: A pantry mix of instant tea, powdered Tang, sugar, and warm spices — stirred into hot water; same family as Russian/friendship tea.

name: Chicken loaf
notes: Ground or finely chopped cooked chicken bound with breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, and seasonings, baked in a loaf — a leftover-chicken meatloaf.

name: Turkey loaf
notes: Ground turkey bound with breadcrumbs, eggs, herbs, and onion, baked in a loaf with a ketchup glaze — a leaner meatloaf.

name: Italian spaghetti
notes: Spaghetti topped with a long-simmered tomato sauce of ground beef, onions, garlic, peppers, and Italian herbs — finished with Parmesan.

name: Cherry cream cheese pie
notes: A no-bake pie of sweetened cream cheese filling in a graham crust, topped with canned cherry pie filling.

name: Oreo delight
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of crushed Oreos, sweetened cream cheese, chocolate or vanilla pudding, and whipped topping — same family as dirt pudding.

name: Stuffed celery
notes: Celery stalks cut into pieces and filled with sweetened cream cheese, pimento cheese, or peanut butter — a retro relish-tray appetizer.

name: Pineapple cream pie
notes: A baked or no-bake pie of vanilla cream filling mixed with crushed pineapple, in a graham crust, topped with whipped cream.

name: Nanaimo bars
notes: A three-layer no-bake Canadian bar — a chocolate-coconut-graham crust, a vanilla custard buttercream middle, and a chocolate top.

name: Barbecue spareribs
notes: Pork spareribs slow-roasted or grilled and basted with a sweet-tangy barbecue sauce until the meat pulls cleanly from the bone.

name: Zucchini brownies
notes: A moist cocoa brownie made with oil and grated zucchini — chewy, dairy-free, and packed with chocolate chips and walnuts.

name: Asparagus soup
notes: Asparagus simmered with onion and broth, blended smooth, and finished with cream and butter — a springtime classic.

name: Flour tortillas (homemade)
notes: Soft unleavened wheat flatbreads of flour, salt, water, and shortening or lard — rolled thin and griddled.

name: Zucchini chocolate cake
notes: A moist cocoa cake folded with grated zucchini and chocolate chips — vegetable garden meets chocolate dessert.

name: Chicken corn chowder
notes: Sweet corn and diced chicken simmered in a milk-or-cream base with potatoes, onion, and herbs.

name: Italian bread
notes: A crusty oval yeasted loaf of flour, water, yeast, salt, and a touch of olive oil and sugar — pliable interior, deep golden crust.

name: Pumpkin dip
notes: Cream cheese whipped with pumpkin puree, powdered sugar, and warm spices — served with ginger snaps or apple slices.

name: Crustless quiche
notes: Eggs, cream, cheese, and fillings (ham, broccoli, mushrooms) baked in a buttered pie dish without a pastry crust — a low-carb quiche.

name: Fish stew
notes: Cubed white fish simmered with tomatoes, onions, peppers, potatoes, and herbs in broth — a Mediterranean coastal stew.

name: Armadillo eggs
notes: Cream cheese-stuffed jalapeños wrapped in seasoned ground sausage, coated in shake-and-bake or breadcrumbs, and baked — Texan tailgate appetizer.

name: Roasted chicken
notes: A whole chicken seasoned inside and out with salt, herbs, and butter, then roasted hot until the skin is crisp and golden.

name: Tamale casserole
notes: Seasoned ground beef and corn baked under a cornmeal batter or layered with tamales — Tex-Mex casserole adaptation of tamale pie.

name: Cabbage and noodles
notes: Shredded cabbage and onion sautéed in butter until softened, tossed with cooked egg noodles — a Hungarian/Polish comfort dish (haluski).

name: Cream cheese squares (sopapilla)
notes: Crescent-roll dough sandwiched around a sweetened cream-cheese filling, topped with cinnamon-sugar butter, and baked — sopapilla cheesecake bars.

name: No-bake peanut butter cookies
notes: Sugar, milk, butter, and peanut butter cooked to a fudge, stirred with oats, and dropped onto wax paper to set.

name: New Orleans barbecue shrimp
notes: Whole shrimp baked in a buttery-garlicky-Worcestershire-pepper sauce — served peel-on with crusty bread for sopping; "barbecue" in name only.

name: Turkey stuffing
notes: Cubed bread mixed with sautéed onions, celery, sage, broth, and butter, sometimes with sausage — stuffed in the bird or baked separately.

name: Scalloped potatoes and ham
notes: Sliced potatoes and cubed ham baked in a milk-and-cheese sauce — a leftover-ham one-dish meal.

name: Barbecue brisket
notes: A whole beef brisket rubbed with spices, slow-smoked or oven-braised at low heat, sliced against the grain and served with barbecue sauce.

name: Turkey soup
notes: Leftover turkey carcass simmered into broth with vegetables, herbs, and rice or noodles — a Thanksgiving-leftover stockpot soup.

name: Brandy slush
notes: Frozen fruit-juice-and-tea concentrate spiked with brandy, then topped with lemon-lime soda at serving — a Midwestern party slushie.

name: Leek and potato soup
notes: Sliced leeks sweated in butter and simmered with potatoes in chicken stock, then blended smooth and finished with cream — French country classic.

name: Frog eye salad
notes: Cooked acini di pepe pasta folded with crushed pineapple, mandarin oranges, marshmallows, and whipped topping — a Mormon-Midwest dessert salad.

name: Lemon cheesecake (variant)
notes: A cream-cheese cheesecake brightened with lemon juice and zest, set on a graham crust and topped with lemon curd or whipped cream.

name: Banana chocolate chip muffins
notes: Tender muffins of mashed banana, butter, eggs, and flour folded with chocolate chips — banana bread's portion-control cousin.

name: Sour cream banana bread
notes: Banana bread made extra moist by sour cream stirred into the batter, often folded with chopped walnuts or pecans.

name: Sweet potato bake
notes: Mashed sweet potatoes whipped with eggs, butter, sugar, and milk, baked under a brown-sugar-pecan streusel — the Ruth's Chris style.

name: Apple torte
notes: A short-crust base topped with sliced apples and a butter-sugar-cinnamon syrup, baked into a thin layered cake.

name: Tomatillo salsa (salsa verde)
notes: Tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, garlic, cilantro, and lime blended into a tangy green salsa — Mexican style.

name: Marinated chicken
notes: Chicken pieces marinated in Italian dressing or a soy-garlic-citrus mixture and then grilled, baked, or broiled.

name: Caramelized onions
notes: Sliced onions cooked low and slow in butter and oil until deeply golden and jammy — a topping for burgers, pizza, soups, and steaks.

name: Basil pesto
notes: Fresh basil, pine nuts, garlic, Parmesan, and olive oil pounded or blended into a green sauce — a Genoese classic for pasta or bread.

name: Peanut butter cream pie
notes: A baked pastry shell filled with vanilla pastry cream blended with peanut butter, topped with whipped cream and chopped peanuts.

name: Cabbage patch stew
notes: Ground beef simmered with shredded cabbage, kidney beans, tomatoes, peppers, and chili spices — a stovetop pantry stew.

name: No-crust coconut pie
notes: A blender custard of eggs, milk, sugar, butter, coconut, and a touch of flour — self-crusts as it bakes; no pastry shell needed.

name: Pink punch
notes: A non-alcoholic pink punch of cranberry or strawberry juice with pineapple juice and ginger ale — for showers and weddings.

name: Vichyssoise
notes: A cold leek-and-potato soup blended smooth and enriched with heavy cream — Louis Diat's French-by-way-of-New-York creation.

name: Blueberry crisp
notes: Sweetened fresh blueberries baked under a crunchy oat-and-butter streusel — served warm with ice cream.

name: Rye bread
notes: A yeasted loaf of rye flour blended with bread flour, often flavored with caraway seeds and molasses — dense, tangy, and slice-friendly.

name: Honey butter
notes: Softened butter whipped with honey and a pinch of salt — a sweet spread for biscuits, cornbread, and pancakes.

name: Pecan squares
notes: A shortbread crust topped with pecan-pie custard, baked and cut into squares — pecan pie in finger-food form.

name: Layered bean dip
notes: Refried beans layered with sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, lettuce, olives, and onions — served chilled with tortilla chips.

name: Chicken rolls
notes: Crescent-roll dough wrapped around a chicken-and-cream-cheese filling, baked, and served with a cream-soup gravy.

name: Sweet and sour carrots (copper pennies)
notes: Sliced cooked carrots ("pennies") tossed with bell peppers and onion in a tangy tomato-soup-and-vinegar marinade — chilled overnight.

name: Hamburger vegetable soup
notes: Ground beef simmered with mixed vegetables, tomato, and pasta or barley in beef broth — a stockpot weeknight soup.

name: Okra and tomatoes
notes: Sliced okra stewed with tomatoes, onions, peppers, and bacon — a Southern summer side, also a base for gumbo.

name: Spring salad
notes: A light salad of seasonal greens, citrus, herbs, and a bright vinaigrette — meant to capture the freshness of early-season vegetables.

name: Poor man's cake
notes: A Depression-era spice cake with no eggs, milk, or butter — boiled raisins, brown sugar, water, shortening, and warm spices make a moist, frugal cake.

name: Tuna dip
notes: Canned tuna whipped with cream cheese, mayo, lemon, onion, and seasonings — served chilled with crackers or vegetables.

name: No-bake chocolate oatmeal cookies
notes: Cocoa, sugar, milk, and butter boiled to a fudge, stirred with peanut butter and oats, and dropped onto wax paper to set.

name: Texas sheet cake (variant)
notes: A thin chocolate-buttermilk sheet cake topped warm with a poured cocoa-pecan icing that sets to a fudge-like crust.

name: Chocolate chip pudding cookies
notes: Drop cookies of butter, brown sugar, eggs, instant pudding mix, and chocolate chips — the pudding keeps the cookies soft for days.

name: Green rice casserole
notes: Cooked rice baked with broccoli or spinach, cream of mushroom soup, butter, and processed cheese — a Southern potluck side.

name: Gnocchi
notes: Soft Italian dumplings of mashed potato, flour, and egg — boiled briefly and sauced with butter-sage, marinara, or pesto.

name: Pineapple drop cookies
notes: A soft drop cookie made with crushed pineapple folded into a butter-sugar-egg batter, sometimes glazed.

name: Salmon salad
notes: Canned or cooked salmon tossed with celery, sweet pickles, eggs, and a lemon-mayo dressing — served chilled on greens or in sandwiches.

name: Doughnuts
notes: A leavened or cake-style ring of dough deep-fried and finished with glaze, sugar, or cinnamon-sugar.

name: Ice cream sandwiches
notes: Softened ice cream sandwiched between two cookies (chocolate wafers, oatmeal cookies, or brownies), then frozen until firm.

name: Pineapple zucchini bread
notes: A spiced quick bread folded with grated zucchini, crushed pineapple, raisins, and walnuts — moist with a tender crumb.

name: Rhubarb upside-down cake
notes: A skillet cake baked over rhubarb arranged in a brown-sugar-butter glaze with strawberry Jello — inverted to serve.

name: Coffee punch
notes: Cold strong coffee mixed with milk, sugar, and vanilla, ladled over scoops of vanilla ice cream — a Southern shower punch.

name: Scotcheroos
notes: Rice Krispies stirred into a peanut-butter-and-corn-syrup mixture, pressed into a pan, and topped with melted chocolate and butterscotch.

name: Chicken Florentine
notes: Chicken breasts sautéed and served over sautéed spinach in a cream-and-Parmesan sauce — the "Florentine" of any sautéed-spinach preparation.

name: Rocky road candy
notes: Melted chocolate stirred with mini marshmallows and chopped peanuts or almonds, poured to set, and cut into squares.

name: Risotto
notes: Short-grain rice (Arborio or Carnaroli) toasted in butter, then simmered slowly with warm broth and white wine until creamy — finished with Parmesan.

name: Beef and noodles
notes: Cubed or shredded beef simmered with mushrooms and onions in a brown gravy, served over wide egg noodles or mashed potatoes — Midwestern comfort.

name: Spinach and artichoke dip
notes: Chopped spinach and artichoke hearts baked with cream cheese, sour cream, mayo, and Parmesan until bubbling — served warm with bread or chips.

name: Pastitsio
notes: A Greek baked-pasta dish of tubular pasta layered with cinnamon-and-clove-spiced ground beef in tomato sauce, topped with a thick bechamel and Kefalotyri.

name: White sangria
notes: White wine mixed with brandy, fruit juices, and sliced fresh fruit, sweetened lightly and chilled — topped with sparkling water at serving.

name: Cream puff dessert
notes: A pâte-à-choux base baked in a sheet pan, topped with vanilla pudding and cream cheese, finished with whipped topping and chocolate drizzle.

name: Southwestern chili
notes: Ground beef simmered with tomatoes, beans, peppers, onions, and chili powder — a generic American chili.

name: Wedding cookies
notes: A butter-shortbread folded with finely chopped nuts (almonds or pecans), baked into balls and rolled in powdered sugar — Russian-tea-cake family.

name: Fresh tomato salsa
notes: Diced ripe tomato, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime, and salt — a fresh chunky salsa for chips and tacos.

name: Beef noodle casserole
notes: Browned ground beef and egg noodles baked with cream cheese, sour cream, and cottage cheese under shredded cheddar — a Midwestern hot dish.

name: Sausage stuffing
notes: Cubed bread mixed with cooked breakfast or Italian sausage, onions, celery, sage, and broth, baked into a Thanksgiving dressing.

name: Carrot cookies
notes: Soft drop cookies of mashed cooked carrots, butter, sugar, and eggs — often glazed with an orange-citrus icing.

name: Oven barbecued chicken
notes: Chicken pieces baked in a sweet-tangy barbecue sauce until tender and glazed — a low-effort indoor alternative to grilling.

name: Frozen cherry salad
notes: Cherry pie filling folded with crushed pineapple, sweetened condensed milk, and whipped topping, frozen in a pan and sliced.

name: Baked lasagna
notes: Layered lasagna noodles with ricotta, ground beef in marinara, and mozzarella, baked until bubbly — the classic Italian-American casserole.

name: Spaghetti pizza
notes: Cooked spaghetti bound with eggs and milk pressed into a pan to form a "crust," topped with marinara, pepperoni, and mozzarella, then baked.

name: Caramel bars
notes: A brown-sugar-oat crumb crust topped with melted caramels and chocolate chips, then more crumb, baked and cut into bars.

name: Breakfast soufflé
notes: A make-ahead bake of bread cubes soaked overnight in an egg-and-milk custard with sausage or ham, cheese, and spinach — puffed when baked.

name: Chicken Marengo
notes: Chicken pieces sautéed with tomatoes, mushrooms, onions, garlic, and white wine in olive oil — Napoleon's reputed post-victory dinner.

name: Stuffed acorn squash
notes: Halved acorn squash hollowed and filled with apples, cranberries, sausage, or wild rice — baked until the squash is tender and the filling browns.

name: Mayonnaise biscuits
notes: A three-ingredient quick biscuit of self-rising flour, mayonnaise, and milk — patted out and baked into tender drop biscuits.

name: Creamy tomato soup
notes: Tomatoes simmered with onion, broth, and herbs, blended smooth and enriched with cream and butter — often paired with grilled cheese.

name: Russian salad (American dessert variant)
notes: A molded gelatin dessert of crushed pineapple, oranges, cream cheese, and nuts — closer to a Southern Jello salad than the Russian Olivier salad.

name: Sugar cream pie
notes: A Hoosier-Indiana custard of sugar, butter, cream, and a touch of cornstarch and vanilla baked in a single crust — the state pie of Indiana.

name: Lemon poppy seed bread
notes: A sweet citrus-bright quick bread with poppy seeds, finished with a tart lemon-sugar glaze.

name: Breakfast bake (generic)
notes: A generic breakfast casserole of eggs, milk, sausage or bacon, cheese, and bread — a placeholder for several variants in the corpus.

name: Rocky road brownies
notes: Fudge brownies topped with marshmallows, chopped nuts, and chocolate chips during the last few minutes of baking — gooey and stretched.

name: Crab rangoon
notes: Wonton wrappers filled with cream cheese, crab (or imitation crab), and scallions, folded and deep-fried — Chinese-American takeout appetizer.

name: Carrot muffins
notes: Spiced muffins of grated carrot, oil, eggs, raisins, and pecans — a single-portion form of carrot cake.

name: Coconut rice
notes: Jasmine or long-grain rice cooked in coconut milk with a touch of salt and sugar — a Southeast Asian and Caribbean side.

name: Steak au poivre
notes: A beef steak pressed with cracked black peppercorns, pan-seared, and finished in a cognac-cream pan sauce — French bistro classic.

name: Mojito
notes: White rum, fresh mint, lime juice, simple syrup, and a splash of soda water muddled and shaken — Cuba's emblematic cocktail.

name: Blueberry cream pie
notes: A graham crust filled with sweetened cream cheese, topped with blueberry pie filling and whipped topping — chilled until set.

name: Fresh broccoli salad
notes: Raw broccoli florets tossed with bacon, raisins, red onion, and cheese in a sweet mayonnaise dressing.

name: Pork chop sheet-pan dinner
notes: Pork chops baked on a sheet pan with potato wedges, carrots, and onions — a one-pan weeknight meal.

name: Baked cabbage
notes: Shredded cabbage baked in a cheesy milk-and-roux bechamel under buttered cracker crumbs — similar to scalloped cabbage.

name: Strawberry mousse
notes: Crushed sweetened strawberries folded into whipped cream and stabilized with a little gelatin — an airy chilled dessert.

name: Steamed broccoli (cheese sauce)
notes: Steamed broccoli florets topped with a cheese-and-mushroom-soup sauce — generic "broccoli" recipe from the corpus.

name: Pita bread
notes: A round flat yeasted bread baked very hot so it puffs and forms a hollow pocket — Middle Eastern staple for dipping or stuffing.

name: Marinated vegetable salad
notes: Mixed cooked or raw vegetables tossed in a sweet vinaigrette and chilled overnight — a make-ahead picnic salad.

name: Hot fudge sundae cake
notes: A self-saucing chocolate cake — batter spread in a pan, topped with cocoa-sugar and boiling water; cake rises and a fudge sauce sinks beneath.

name: Mushroom barley soup
notes: Sliced mushrooms and pearl barley simmered with onions, carrots, celery, and herbs in beef broth — a Jewish/Eastern-European stockpot soup.

name: Wine cake
notes: A yellow Bundt cake made from cake mix and instant pudding with a half-cup of cream sherry or other sweet wine stirred into the batter.

name: Hot beef dip
notes: Cream cheese mixed with chipped beef, peppers, onion, and sour cream, baked or microwaved until bubbly — served warm with crackers.

name: Tater tot hot dish
notes: Ground beef and vegetables baked in cream-of-mushroom-soup gravy under a layer of frozen tater tots — a Minnesota / Upper-Midwest hot dish.

name: Apple bars
notes: A short butter-flour crust topped with spiced sliced apples and a butter-sugar streusel, baked and cut into bars.

name: Pickled shrimp
notes: Cooked shrimp layered with sliced onions and lemon, then marinated in an oil-vinegar-pickling-spice brine — a Southern coastal cocktail dish.

name: Salmon dip
notes: Smoked or canned salmon mixed with cream cheese, sour cream, dill, lemon, and onion — served chilled with crackers or rye toasts.

name: Crunchy pea salad
notes: Frozen sweet peas tossed with chopped cauliflower, peanuts, bacon, and sour-cream-mayo dressing — chilled.

name: Parker House rolls
notes: Soft enriched yeasted rolls shaped as a folded-over half, brushed with butter, and baked — created at Boston's Parker House Hotel.

name: Cheddar cheese soup
notes: Diced vegetables sautéed in butter, simmered with chicken broth, then thickened with milk, flour, and shredded cheddar.

name: Deviled crab
notes: Lump crab folded with breadcrumbs, mayo, mustard, lemon, Worcestershire, and a hint of cayenne, baked in shells or ramekins until golden.

name: Mexican roll-ups
notes: Flour tortillas spread with seasoned cream cheese, salsa, olives, and green chiles, rolled and sliced into pinwheels — chilled appetizer.

name: Chicken crunch
notes: Diced chicken baked with rice, peas, mushrooms, and water chestnuts in a cream-soup sauce, topped with crushed potato chips or chow-mein noodles.

name: Pork barbecue (sandwich)
notes: Slow-cooked shredded pork shoulder tossed in a vinegar-or-tomato-based barbecue sauce — served on a soft bun with coleslaw, Carolina style.

name: Lime punch
notes: A green non-alcoholic punch of lime sherbet, pineapple juice, and ginger ale — for showers and birthday parties.

name: Banana fritters
notes: Sliced or mashed banana folded into a leavened batter, dropped into hot oil, fried golden, and dusted with powdered sugar.

name: Lemon poppy seed muffins
notes: Tender muffins flavored with lemon zest, juice, and poppy seeds — often finished with a tart lemon-sugar glaze.

name: Thai beef salad
notes: Sliced grilled beef tossed with cucumber, shallot, mint, cilantro, and a lime-fish-sauce-chili dressing — Thai street-food classic.

name: Meatloaf (recipe variant)
notes: A ground-beef loaf bound with breadcrumbs and egg, seasoned with onions and herbs, glazed with ketchup, and baked.

name: Carrot bars
notes: A sheet-pan version of carrot cake — spiced oil-and-egg batter folded with grated carrots, baked and frosted with cream cheese.

name: Chocolate chip cookie (singular)
notes: A drop cookie of brown-and-white sugar butter dough studded with semisweet chocolate chips and pecans — Toll House standard.

name: Linguini salad (variant)
notes: Cooked linguini tossed with chopped peppers, onions, olives, and a Salad Supreme-seasoned Italian dressing — chilled overnight.

name: Savory pot roast
notes: A chuck or round roast seared and slow-braised with onions, mushrooms, and root vegetables in seasoned broth until fork-tender.

name: Cheesy chicken casserole
notes: Cooked chicken baked with vegetables and cheese in a creamy soup-based sauce — generic comfort casserole.

name: Ladyfingers
notes: A sponge-cake batter piped into fingers and baked into light, dry biscuits — used as the base for tiramisu and trifle.

name: Oreo cake
notes: A vanilla butter cake folded with crushed Oreos and frosted with cookies-and-cream buttercream — chocolate-cookie pieces throughout.

name: Chicken enchilada
notes: A tortilla rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, baked in a red or green chile sauce, and topped with more cheese.

name: Banana bars
notes: A sheet-pan version of banana cake — moist banana butter-and-egg batter baked and frosted with cream cheese icing.

name: Creamy fruit salad
notes: Mixed fruit folded with sweetened cream cheese and whipped topping or marshmallow fluff — a Southern picnic dessert salad.

name: Stewed tomatoes
notes: Canned or fresh tomatoes simmered with onion, sugar, and butter, sometimes thickened with bread cubes — a Southern side.

name: Hello Dolly bars
notes: Graham crust topped with chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, and pecans, drizzled with sweetened condensed milk and baked.

name: Fruit cookies (candied fruit)
notes: Drop cookies of butter-sugar dough folded with candied cherries, citron, dates, raisins, and pecans — fruitcake-flavored cookies.

name: Chicken à la king
notes: Diced cooked chicken in a cream sauce with mushrooms, pimientos, and sherry — served over toast points or rice.

name: Buttermilk rolls
notes: A soft yeasted roll made tangy and tender by buttermilk in the dough — pulled apart warm with butter at dinner.

name: Deep dish pizza
notes: A Chicago-style pizza baked in a tall buttered pan with cheese on the bottom, fillings in the middle, and chunky tomato sauce on top.

name: French breakfast puffs
notes: Soft butter-and-sugar muffins baked plain, then dunked in melted butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar — like a baked donut.

name: Broccoli and cheese soup
notes: Broccoli simmered in chicken broth with onion, blended (or partially), and thickened with a milk-and-butter roux finished with cheddar or Velveeta.

name: Honey baked chicken
notes: Chicken pieces brushed with a butter-honey-mustard-curry glaze and baked until caramelized — a Sandra Lee semi-homemade staple.

name: Broccoli chicken casserole (variant)
notes: Cooked chicken and broccoli baked in mayo-lemon-cream-of-chicken-soup sauce under cheese and buttered breadcrumbs.

name: Chicken and dumplings (variant)
notes: Chicken simmered in broth with vegetables, finished with soft dough dumplings dropped on top to steam-cook.

name: Vegetarian lasagna
notes: Layered lasagna noodles with ricotta, sautéed vegetables (zucchini, mushrooms, spinach), mozzarella, and marinara — the meatless lasagna.

name: Sour cream chocolate cake
notes: A cocoa cake enriched with sour cream — moist, tangy crumb that pairs especially well with chocolate buttercream.

name: Overnight coffee cake
notes: A spiced butter cake batter mixed the night before, refrigerated, then topped with cinnamon-pecan streusel and baked in the morning.

name: Ranch beans
notes: Pinto beans simmered with ground beef, bacon, brown sugar, barbecue sauce, and chili powder — a Tex-Mex cowboy-bean side.

name: Frozen fruit dessert
notes: Mixed fruit folded with sweetened condensed milk and whipped topping, frozen in a pan and sliced — Southern frozen-salad style.

name: Dutch apple cake
notes: A tender butter-and-egg cake topped with sliced apples and a cinnamon-sugar streusel before baking.

name: Blue cheese dip
notes: Crumbled blue cheese folded into sour cream, mayo, and a touch of buttermilk — served chilled with Buffalo wings, celery, or chips.

name: Blueberry pound cake
notes: A dense pound cake folded with fresh or frozen blueberries — sometimes finished with a lemon-sugar glaze.

name: Chocolate crinkle cookies
notes: Fudgy chocolate cookies rolled twice (granulated then powdered sugar) before baking — the powdered sugar cracks into a "crinkle" pattern.

name: Banana smoothie
notes: Frozen banana blended with milk or yogurt, a touch of honey, and ice — sometimes with peanut butter or cocoa.

name: Chocolate torte
notes: A dense, often flourless chocolate cake leaning on butter, dark chocolate, eggs, and ground nuts — fudgy and intense.

name: Chicken spaghetti casserole
notes: Spaghetti baked with shredded chicken, peppers, mushrooms, and Velveeta-style cheese sauce — Southern church-supper casserole.

name: Creamy lemon pie
notes: A no-bake pie of lemon juice whipped into sweetened condensed milk and folded into whipped topping or whipped cream, set in a graham crust.

name: Mexican hot chocolate
notes: Milk warmed with bittersweet chocolate (or cocoa), cinnamon, vanilla, and a pinch of chili powder — frothy and spiced.

name: Pink lemonade pie
notes: Frozen pink lemonade concentrate folded with sweetened condensed milk and whipped topping, set in a graham crust — chilled until firm.

name: Fettuccine alfredo (variant)
notes: Fresh fettuccine tossed with butter and grated Parmesan until emulsified into a creamy sauce — American versions add heavy cream.

name: Sausage stuffed mushrooms
notes: Mushroom caps filled with cooked Italian sausage, cream cheese, and Parmesan, baked until bubbling.

name: Tabouli
notes: Cracked bulgur wheat tossed with finely chopped parsley, tomato, mint, scallions, lemon juice, and olive oil — Levantine herb salad.

name: Peanut butter bonbons
notes: Peanut butter, butter, and powdered sugar mixed with Rice Krispies, rolled into balls, and dipped in melted chocolate.

name: Fruit dessert
notes: A generic name for chilled fruit dishes — sweetened mixed fruit folded with whipped topping, pudding, or Jello.

name: Chicken Italiano
notes: Chicken pieces baked or simmered in Italian dressing or marinara with mozzarella, peppers, and herbs — served over pasta.

name: Coconut bonbons (variant)
notes: Sweetened coconut mixed with butter, sweetened condensed milk, and pecans, rolled into balls and dipped in chocolate — Martha-Washington-style.

name: Breakfast pie
notes: A pastry shell filled with eggs, sausage or bacon, cheese, and vegetables, baked into a savory breakfast tart.

name: Turtle brownies
notes: Fudge brownies layered with melted caramel and chopped pecans, baked into a turtle-candy-style bar.

name: Escalloped corn
notes: Corn kernels baked in a custard of eggs, milk, butter, and sugar under a buttered cracker top — a Midwest church-supper side.

name: Chess bars
notes: A yellow-cake-mix base topped with a cream-cheese-egg-and-powdered-sugar filling that bakes into a gooey center — same family as gooey butter cake.

name: White trash candy
notes: Chex, pretzels, peanuts, Cheerios, and M&Ms tossed with melted white chocolate and almond bark, spread to set and broken into pieces.

name: Asparagus salad
notes: Blanched asparagus tossed with lemon vinaigrette, almonds, and Parmesan — sometimes folded with hard-boiled egg.

name: Seven layer bars (variant)
notes: Graham crust topped with chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, and pecans, drizzled with sweetened condensed milk and baked.

name: Fried eggplant
notes: Sliced eggplant dipped in egg and milk, dredged in seasoned flour, and pan-fried in oil until golden.

name: Mushroom casserole
notes: Sliced mushrooms baked with onions, butter, eggs, milk, and bread cubes under shredded cheese — a hearty mushroom strata.

name: Beef and broccoli
notes: Strips of beef stir-fried with broccoli florets in a soy-garlic-ginger sauce thickened with cornstarch — served over rice.

name: Southern pecan pie
notes: A custard of eggs, sugar, butter, and corn syrup or molasses studded with pecan halves, baked in a flaky crust until set.

name: Breaded pork chops
notes: Pork chops dipped in egg and milk, dredged in seasoned breadcrumbs or crushed crackers, and pan-fried until crisp.

name: Pierogi
notes: Dough pockets filled with potato-and-cheese, sauerkraut, or sweet farmer cheese, boiled and then pan-fried in butter with onions.

name: Sweet potato fries
notes: Sweet potato wedges or strips tossed in oil and salt, baked or fried until crisp — often dusted with smoked paprika or cinnamon.

name: Strawberry lemonade
notes: Fresh-squeezed lemon juice and pureed strawberries with sugar and water — served cold over ice.

name: Shrimp bisque
notes: A creamy seafood-broth soup of shrimp, aromatics, and tomato simmered with sherry, blended smooth, and finished with heavy cream.

name: Panzanella
notes: Stale bread cubes toasted and tossed with ripe tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, basil, and a red-wine vinaigrette — Tuscan bread salad.

name: Spaghetti bolognese
notes: Spaghetti topped with ragù alla bolognese — beef and pork slow-simmered with onion, carrot, celery, tomato, milk, and wine.

name: Blackberry pie
notes: A double-crust or lattice pie of fresh blackberries tossed with sugar and a thickener — sweet-tart with deep purple juice.

name: French fries
notes: Russet potato strips deep-fried in two stages — once at lower heat to cook through, then hot to crisp the outside — salted while hot.

name: Fried apple pies
notes: Hand-held pastry rounds filled with spiced cooked apples, sealed, and deep-fried until golden — McDonald's-original style.

name: Raw vegetable dip
notes: Sour cream and mayo seasoned with dried herbs, dill, garlic, and onion — served chilled with raw vegetables.

name: Barbecue pork chops
notes: Pork chops baked or grilled and basted with a sweet-tangy barbecue sauce until lacquered.

name: Applesauce bread
notes: A spiced quick bread made moist by applesauce in place of much of the fat — often with raisins and chopped walnuts.

name: Berry cobbler
notes: Mixed berries baked under a buttery cake or biscuit topping — served warm with ice cream.

name: Oatmeal scotchies
notes: Oatmeal drop cookies studded with butterscotch chips — chewy and toffee-sweet.

name: Mulligatawny soup
notes: A British-Indian curry soup of chicken, vegetables, lentils, and apple in a curry-spiced broth — Madras-style.

name: Southern pumpkin pie
notes: A custard pie of pumpkin puree, eggs, evaporated milk, brown sugar, and warm spices baked in a flaky shell — a Thanksgiving classic.

name: Elephant ears
notes: A yeasted dough rolled flat, fried, and coated in cinnamon-sugar — large, flat fair-style pastries.

name: Sweet and sour cabbage
notes: Shredded cabbage cooked with onions, bacon, sugar, and vinegar — a German-Pennsylvania-Dutch braised side.

name: Sour cream chicken
notes: Chicken breasts baked in a sauce of sour cream, mushroom soup, and seasonings — served over rice or noodles.

name: Chocolate caramel bars
notes: A brown-sugar-oat crumb crust topped with melted caramels and chocolate chips, then more crumb, baked and cut into bars.

name: Baby food cake
notes: A spiced oil-based cake using jars of pureed baby food (carrots, prunes, or plums) in place of mashed fresh fruit — easy and moist.

name: American goulash
notes: Ground beef simmered with elbow macaroni, tomato, onion, peppers, and paprika — a one-pot stovetop dish (unlike Hungarian goulash).

name: Buffalo chicken wings
notes: Deep-fried chicken wings tossed in Frank's RedHot and butter — Buffalo, NY style; served with celery and blue cheese.

name: No-bake cheesecake (variant)
notes: Cream cheese whipped with sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, and whipped topping, poured into a graham crust and chilled until set.

name: Chile verde
notes: Pork shoulder slow-simmered with tomatillos, green chiles, onion, garlic, and cumin until tender — served with tortillas or over rice.

name: Double chocolate chip cookies
notes: Drop cookies of cocoa-and-butter dough studded with chocolate chips — chocolate from both the dough and the chips.

name: Chinese casserole
notes: Ground beef or chicken baked with rice, water chestnuts, celery, mushrooms, mushroom soup, and soy sauce, topped with chow-mein noodles.

name: Sweet potato crunch
notes: Mashed sweet potatoes baked under a brown-sugar-flour-butter-pecan streusel — same family as sweet potato casserole.

name: Dill weed dip
notes: Sour cream and mayo seasoned with fresh or dried dill, parsley, onion, and Beau Monde — served chilled with vegetables in a bread bowl.

name: Baked potato casserole
notes: Cubed potatoes baked with sour cream, bacon, cheese, and chives — loaded-baked-potato flavors in casserole form.

name: Unbaked cookies (no-bake)
notes: Cocoa, sugar, milk, and butter boiled to a fudge, stirred with peanut butter and oats, and dropped onto wax paper to set.

name: Chicken Caesar salad
notes: Romaine tossed with grilled or roasted chicken, Caesar dressing (egg-anchovy-Parmesan), croutons, and shaved Parmesan.

name: Breakfast cookies
notes: Oat-based drop cookies folded with dried fruit, banana, nuts, and warm spices — a portable breakfast.

name: Christmas cake (fruitcake)
notes: A dense holiday cake packed with candied fruit, dried fruit, nuts, and warm spices — often soaked in brandy or rum and aged.

name: Crispy chicken
notes: Chicken pieces dipped in milk or buttermilk and dredged in seasoned flour or crushed cornflakes, then baked or pan-fried until crisp.

name: Cheeseburger soup
notes: Ground beef simmered with potatoes, carrots, celery, and onion in a milk-and-cheese-thickened broth — cheeseburger flavors as soup.

name: Cream of cauliflower soup
notes: Cauliflower simmered with onion and chicken broth, blended smooth, and finished with milk, cream, and a touch of cheddar or nutmeg.

name: Pineapple punch
notes: A non-alcoholic punch of pineapple juice, frozen lemonade, and ginger ale or sherbet — for showers and birthday parties.

name: Shrimp and grits
notes: Sautéed shrimp with bacon, peppers, and tasso ham over creamy cheese grits — a Lowcountry Southern classic.

name: BBQ chicken pizza
notes: A pizza crust spread with barbecue sauce in place of marinara, topped with shredded chicken, red onion, cilantro, and smoked gouda — California Pizza Kitchen original.

name: Chili con queso dip
notes: Velveeta-style processed cheese melted with Rotel tomatoes and chiles — served warm with tortilla chips.

name: Sunshine cake
notes: A bright yellow chiffon-style cake made with orange juice and zest, sometimes from cake mix with mandarin oranges folded in.

name: Crab meat dip
notes: Cream cheese, mayo, and lemon whipped with chopped crab, scallions, and Worcestershire — served chilled or warm with crackers.

name: Chicken Creole
notes: Chicken simmered in a Louisiana sauce of tomato, onion, peppers, celery, garlic, and Creole spices — served over rice.

name: Butterhorns
notes: Soft enriched yeast dough rolled into wedges, brushed with butter and cinnamon-sugar, and rolled into crescents — pulled-apart with a drizzle.

name: Oysters Rockefeller
notes: Half-shell oysters topped with sautéed spinach, butter, herbs, breadcrumbs, and Pernod or absinthe, then baked or broiled — Antoine's of New Orleans.

name: Baked Brie
notes: A wheel of Brie wrapped in puff pastry with fruit preserves and pecans, baked until the pastry is golden and the cheese melts inside.

name: Barbecued beans (variant)
notes: Canned beans simmered with ground beef, bacon, onions, brown sugar, and barbecue sauce — thick and sweet, cowboy-style.

name: Blueberry bread
notes: A sweet quick bread folded with fresh or frozen blueberries, finished with a tart lemon-sugar glaze.

name: Hawaiian fruit salad
notes: Tropical fruits (pineapple, mandarin oranges) folded with mini marshmallows, coconut, and sour cream or whipped topping — same family as ambrosia.

name: Marinated tomatoes
notes: Sliced ripe tomatoes layered with red onion in a sweet vinaigrette with fresh herbs — chilled briefly and served as a summer salad.

name: Pecan rolls (sticky buns)
notes: Yeasted dough rolled with cinnamon-sugar, baked over a brown-sugar-butter syrup with pecans, and inverted to serve.

name: Jewish coffee cake (sour cream)
notes: A sour-cream Bundt cake swirled with cinnamon-sugar-pecan streusel — Bubbe's coffee cake.

name: Fruit crisp
notes: Sweetened sliced fruit (apples, peaches, berries) baked under a crunchy oat-and-butter streusel — served warm with ice cream.

name: Angel cookies
notes: A buttery sugar cookie of butter, oil, sugars, eggs, and cream of tartar — soft, lightly sweet, and topped with sugar.

name: Date nut bars
notes: Cooked dates and nuts in a butter-egg batter, baked and cut into squares, dusted with powdered sugar — chewy and rich.

name: Percolator punch
notes: A hot punch of cranberry and pineapple juice "brewed" in a coffee percolator with brown sugar and warm spices in the basket.

name: Butter balls (snowballs)
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar shortbread folded with finely chopped pecans, baked into balls and rolled in powdered sugar — Russian-tea-cake family.

name: Mexican lasagne (variant)
notes: Layered tortillas with seasoned ground beef, enchilada or salsa sauce, beans, and cheese — baked lasagna-style.

name: Peaches and cream cake
notes: A vanilla cake base topped with sliced peaches and a sweet cream-cheese custard, baked into a fruit-and-cream square.

name: Cottage potatoes
notes: Cubed cooked potatoes baked with milk, cheese, and bread cubes or crackers — a Pennsylvania-Dutch potato casserole.

name: Garlic shrimp (gambas al ajillo)
notes: Shrimp sautéed hot in olive oil with sliced garlic, chiles, and a splash of sherry or white wine — Spanish tapa.

name: Barbecued shrimp (New Orleans)
notes: Whole shrimp baked in a buttery-garlicky-Worcestershire-pepper sauce — served peel-on with crusty bread; "barbecue" in name only.

name: Pizza snacks
notes: English muffins or biscuit-dough rounds topped with pizza sauce, pepperoni, and mozzarella, baked until bubbly — bite-size pizzas.

name: Baked lima beans
notes: Lima beans baked with bacon, brown sugar, ketchup, and mustard — a sweet-savory Southern bean side.

name: Mrs. Fields cookies (copycat)
notes: A copycat of the Mrs. Fields chocolate chip cookie — butter, brown sugar, oats ground fine, chocolate chips and chopped chocolate, and pecans.

name: Sausage biscuits
notes: Bite-size baked balls of breakfast sausage, shredded cheddar, and biscuit mix — same family as sausage balls.

name: Greek chicken
notes: Chicken pieces marinated in lemon, olive oil, garlic, oregano, and red wine vinegar, then roasted or grilled — sometimes finished with feta and olives.

name: Mexican chicken soup (caldo de pollo)
notes: Chicken simmered with onions, garlic, carrots, potatoes, and corn in a tomato-and-chile broth — finished with cilantro, lime, and avocado.

name: Strawberry muffins
notes: Tender muffins of chopped fresh strawberries, butter, sugar, eggs, and flour — often topped with a sugar streusel.

name: Roasted asparagus
notes: Trimmed asparagus tossed with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roasted hot until tender and slightly charred — sometimes finished with lemon and Parmesan.

name: Mayonnaise rolls
notes: A three-ingredient muffin-tin roll of self-rising flour, mayonnaise, and milk — quick, tender, drop-style.

name: Dirt pie
notes: A graham crust filled with chocolate pudding mixed with cream cheese and whipped topping, topped with crushed Oreos to look like dirt.

name: Cheese sticks (cheese straws)
notes: A short cheddar-and-butter dough piped or sliced from a log and baked into thin crisp savory sticks — Southern.

name: Sweet and sour chicken wings
notes: Battered chicken wings tossed in a sweet-and-sour sauce of pineapple, vinegar, ketchup, and brown sugar — Chinese-American restaurant style.

name: Bacon roll-ups
notes: Crustless bread rolled around cream cheese and asparagus or pickles, wrapped in bacon, and broiled until crisp.

name: Fruit delight
notes: A no-bake layered fruit dessert of pineapple, oranges, cherries, and bananas folded with sweetened cream cheese, whipped topping, and nuts.

name: Old-fashioned bread pudding
notes: Cubed stale bread soaked overnight in a custard of eggs, milk, sugar, butter, cinnamon, and raisins — baked until set and served warm with a vanilla or bourbon sauce.

name: Cranberry pie (Nantucket)
notes: Whole cranberries layered in a buttered pan with sugar and walnuts, topped with a simple butter-flour-egg batter, baked until golden.

name: Five flavor pound cake
notes: A pound cake flavored with extracts of vanilla, lemon, coconut, rum, and butter, soaked after baking with a five-flavor sugar glaze.

name: Pumpkin cheesecake bars
notes: Pumpkin-spiced cheesecake baked on a yellow-cake-mix or gingersnap crust, cut into bars after chilling.

name: Baked fruit compote
notes: Mixed canned and dried fruits (pineapple, peaches, pears, cherries, prunes) baked with brown sugar and warm spices — served warm as a side.

name: Peach dessert
notes: A peach pie filling baked under a yellow-cake-mix-and-butter streusel — same family as peach dump cake.

name: Toffee squares
notes: A brown-sugar-and-butter shortbread topped with melted chocolate while warm, sometimes dusted with chopped nuts — cut into squares.

name: Melting moments
notes: A short butter-and-cornstarch cookie that melts on the tongue — Scottish/New Zealand classic, sometimes sandwiched with lemon buttercream.

name: Green chili
notes: Pork or beef simmered with roasted green chiles, onions, garlic, and tomatillos — served as a stew or as a topping for burritos.

name: Cucumbers in sour cream
notes: Thinly sliced cucumber and onion folded into a sour cream-and-vinegar dressing with dill and sugar — chilled briefly before serving.

name: Sauerkraut casserole
notes: Drained sauerkraut baked with kielbasa or smoked sausage, apples, onions, and brown sugar — a Pennsylvania-Dutch hot pot.

name: Pork chop bake
notes: Pork chops baked over rice or sliced potatoes with mushrooms, onions, and cream of mushroom soup — a hands-off oven dinner.

name: Pierogi lasagna
notes: Layers of lasagna noodles, mashed potatoes, cheddar, and caramelized onions baked together — pierogi flavors as a casserole.

name: Mint julep
notes: Bourbon whisky stirred with simple syrup and bruised mint, served over crushed ice in a frosty silver cup — the Kentucky Derby cocktail.

name: Poppy seed chicken casserole
notes: Shredded chicken baked in sour cream and cream of chicken soup under a buttery Ritz-cracker-and-poppy-seed topping.

name: Breakfast muffins
notes: Tender muffins of flour, sugar, eggs, milk, and butter — a generic base for fruit, oat, or savory breakfast muffins.

name: Strawberry pretzel dessert
notes: A crushed-pretzel crust topped with sweetened cream cheese and strawberry-Jello-with-frozen-strawberries — chilled and cut into squares.

name: Date loaf candy
notes: A cooked candy of sugar, milk, butter, and chopped dates, beaten and shaped into a log with pecans, then sliced into rounds.

name: Chewy cake (brookie)
notes: A dense, brownie-textured cake of butter, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, flour, and pecans — somewhere between brownie and blondie.

name: Hot crabmeat dip
notes: Cream cheese, mayo, and lump crab seasoned with Worcestershire, lemon, and horseradish, baked until bubbling and served with crackers.

name: Shoney's strawberry pie (copycat)
notes: Fresh strawberries piled into a baked pie crust and set with a strawberry-Jello-and-cornstarch glaze — a Shoney's restaurant copycat.

name: Antipasto platter
notes: A mixed Italian appetizer plate of cured meats (salami, prosciutto), olives, marinated artichokes, peppers, cheeses, and anchovies.

name: Fettuccine alfredo (variant)
notes: Fresh fettuccine tossed with butter and grated Parmesan until emulsified into a creamy sauce — American versions add heavy cream.

name: Egg custard pie
notes: A baked pastry shell filled with a sweet egg-milk-sugar-vanilla custard, dusted with nutmeg — same as custard pie.

name: Venison jerky
notes: Strips of venison marinated in soy sauce, Worcestershire, brown sugar, and spices, then slow-dried in a low oven or dehydrator until chewy.

name: Frito pie
notes: Chili spooned over corn chips and topped with shredded cheese, onions, and pickled jalapeños — sometimes served right in the chip bag.

name: Apple tart
notes: A thin butter-pastry shell topped with sliced apples and sugar, baked until the apples caramelize — French or Dutch style.

name: Stuffed jalapeños (poppers)
notes: Halved jalapeños filled with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon or breaded, and baked or fried until crisp.

name: Chicken mole
notes: Chicken simmered in a complex Mexican sauce of dried chiles, tomatoes, nuts, seeds, dried fruit, warm spices, and a square of bitter chocolate.

name: Empanadas
notes: Folded pastry turnovers filled with seasoned ground beef, raisins, olives, and onion, then baked or fried — a Latin American hand-pie.

name: Dream pie
notes: A no-bake pie of vanilla pastry cream or pudding folded with whipped topping, set in a graham crust and topped with fruit or nuts.

name: Cream cheese squares (variant)
notes: A yellow-cake-mix base topped with a sweetened cream-cheese-egg filling and cinnamon-sugar butter, baked into bars — sopapilla cheesecake style.

name: Cinnamon twists
notes: Yeasted dough rolled with cinnamon-sugar, cut into strips, twisted, and baked — drizzled with a powdered-sugar glaze.

name: Seafoam salad
notes: Lime Jello whipped with sweetened cream cheese, crushed pineapple, and whipped topping, chilled until set — a Southern molded dessert salad.

name: Whole wheat banana bread
notes: Banana bread made with whole-wheat flour for a denser, nuttier crumb — sweetened with honey or brown sugar.

name: Bing cherry salad
notes: A molded gelatin salad of cherry Jello set with Bing cherries, crushed pineapple, cream cheese, and chopped pecans.

name: Chewy chocolate chip cookies
notes: A version of chocolate chip cookies leaning on brown sugar and extra egg yolk for chew, with chocolate chips folded in.

name: Zucchini pineapple bread
notes: A spiced quick bread folded with grated zucchini, crushed pineapple, raisins, and walnuts — moist and tropical.

name: Chicken squares
notes: Crescent-roll dough folded around a chicken-and-cream-cheese filling, brushed with butter and breadcrumbs, and baked into single-serving squares.

name: Black walnut pound cake
notes: A dense pound cake folded with finely chopped black walnuts — earthier than English walnut versions.

name: Chocolate peanut butter cookies
notes: Chocolate-cocoa drop cookies with peanut butter chips or with chocolate-and-peanut-butter swirled in the dough.

name: Black-eyed peas (slow-cooked)
notes: Dried black-eyed peas slow-simmered with a ham hock or bacon, onion, garlic, and a touch of vinegar — a Southern New Year's tradition.

name: Buttermilk fried chicken
notes: Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, and deep-fried until golden — the Southern Sunday-supper standard.

name: Orange congealed salad
notes: Orange Jello set with mandarin oranges, crushed pineapple, and cottage cheese, layered with sweetened cream cheese — a Southern molded dessert.

name: Apple spice cake
notes: A spiced oil-or-butter cake folded with grated or diced apples — moist with warm cinnamon-clove-nutmeg notes.

name: Striped delight
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of graham crust, sweetened cream cheese, chocolate pudding, and whipped topping — Oreo-pudding family.

name: Lemonade cake
notes: A yellow cake poked all over and saturated with frozen lemonade concentrate whisked into sweetened condensed milk — chilled and topped with whipped topping.

name: Chicken enchilada soup
notes: Shredded chicken simmered in a tomato-and-enchilada-sauce broth with hominy or corn, masa, and chili spices — Chili's copycat-style.

name: Crispy baked chicken
notes: Chicken pieces dipped in milk or buttermilk and dredged in seasoned flour or crushed cornflakes, then baked until crisp.

name: Tuna ball
notes: Cream cheese mixed with canned tuna, lemon, onion, and seasonings, shaped into a ball and rolled in chopped parsley or pecans — served with crackers.

name: No-peek beef stew
notes: Cubed beef and vegetables sealed in a Dutch oven with tomato juice, tapioca, and onion soup mix — baked low for hours without lifting the lid.

name: Pozole (posole)
notes: A Mexican stew of pork or chicken with hominy in a red or green chile broth, garnished with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, and oregano.

name: Hot cranberry punch
notes: Cranberry and pineapple juice simmered with cinnamon sticks, cloves, and citrus — a hot non-alcoholic holiday drink.

name: Pineapple cheese salad
notes: Pineapple Jello set with crushed pineapple, shredded cheddar, and whipped topping — a Southern molded dessert salad.

name: Rouladen
notes: Thinly sliced beef wrapped around bacon, onion, pickle, and mustard, then browned and slow-braised in red wine and broth — German classic.

name: Chicken croquettes
notes: Diced cooked chicken bound with a thick bechamel, chilled, shaped into cones or balls, breaded, and deep-fried — sometimes served with a sherry-mushroom sauce.

name: Linguine with white clam sauce
notes: Linguine tossed with clams, garlic, parsley, white wine, butter, and olive oil — Italian-American classic, no tomato.

name: Tomato basil soup
notes: Roasted or canned tomatoes simmered with onion, garlic, basil, and broth, blended smooth and enriched with cream.

name: Seven layer dip
notes: Refried beans layered with seasoned sour cream or guacamole, salsa, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and olives — served chilled with tortilla chips.

name: Iced coffee
notes: Strong brewed coffee chilled and served over ice with milk, cream, or sugar — sometimes sweetened with vanilla syrup.

name: Strawberry smoothie
notes: Frozen strawberries blended with yogurt or milk, banana, and a touch of honey or sugar — sometimes with protein powder.

name: Honey cake (Lekach)
notes: A spiced honey-and-coffee cake of flour, eggs, oil, and warm spices — a Rosh Hashanah Jewish tradition.

name: Almond roca
notes: A buttery toffee cooked to hard-crack stage, poured over chopped almonds, and topped with melted chocolate — a Tacoma, Washington original.

name: Potato cheese casserole
notes: Cubed or shredded potatoes baked with sour cream, butter, cream of chicken soup, and shredded cheddar — funeral-potatoes-style.

name: Pecan sandies
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar shortbread cookie folded with finely chopped pecans — sandy, melt-in-the-mouth crumb.

name: Harvey Wallbanger cake
notes: A yellow Bundt cake from cake mix and instant vanilla pudding with orange juice and a generous splash of vodka and Galliano — the cocktail in cake form.

name: Banana bran muffins
notes: High-fiber muffins of wheat bran, mashed banana, buttermilk, and brown sugar — moist with fruit-and-grain heartiness.

name: Tomato pudding
notes: A Pennsylvania-Dutch baked side of tomato puree, sugar, and butter poured over cubed bread — sweet, savory, and pudding-textured.

name: Southern chocolate pie
notes: A baked pastry shell filled with a cooked chocolate-pudding custard and topped with meringue or whipped cream — Southern diner classic.

name: The best cookies
notes: A loaded drop cookie of butter, oats, cornflakes, coconut, and chocolate chips — sometimes folded with chopped pecans or potato chips.

name: Peanut butter chews
notes: A no-bake bar of corn syrup, sugar, and peanut butter cooked to soft-ball, stirred with cornflakes or Rice Krispies and pressed into a pan.

name: Swedish nut cake
notes: A one-bowl cake of crushed pineapple, eggs, flour, sugar, and chopped pecans, baked and topped with cream cheese frosting and more pecans.

name: Hamburger dip
notes: Browned ground beef simmered with Velveeta processed cheese and Rotel tomatoes-and-chiles — served warm with tortilla chips.

name: Chicken fingers
notes: Strips of chicken breast dipped in egg and milk, dredged in seasoned flour or breadcrumbs, and pan-fried or baked until golden.

name: Carrot raisin salad
notes: Shredded carrots tossed with raisins, crushed pineapple, and a mayonnaise-and-sugar dressing — chilled before serving.

name: Baked acorn squash
notes: Halved acorn squash baked with butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon in the cavity — a simple sweet-savory side.

name: Baked eggs
notes: Eggs baked in ramekins with cream, cheese, and herbs (oeufs en cocotte) — sometimes with ham or sausage on the bottom.

name: Snow ice cream
notes: Fresh clean snow folded with sweetened condensed milk (or milk and sugar) and vanilla — a winter kids' treat.

name: Caramel apple pie
notes: A double-crust or streusel-topped apple pie with caramel sauce or chopped caramels stirred into the spiced apple filling.

name: Brownie pudding cake
notes: A self-saucing cake — chocolate batter spread in a pan, topped with cocoa-sugar and boiling water, baked so a brownie top sits over fudge sauce.

name: Seafood lasagna
notes: Layered lasagna noodles with shrimp, crab, or scallops in a sherry-cream-and-Parmesan sauce, baked under mozzarella.

name: Heath bars (toffee bars)
notes: A brown-sugar-and-butter shortbread topped with melted chocolate and crushed Heath bars or pecans — cut into bars.

name: Mongolian beef
notes: Sliced flank steak stir-fried in a hot wok with scallions in a glossy soy-ginger-brown-sugar-and-sherry sauce — Chinese-American restaurant classic.

name: Italian salad
notes: Mixed greens with peperoncini, olives, salami or pepperoni, mozzarella, peppers, and Italian dressing.

name: Linguine with clam sauce
notes: Linguine tossed with clams, garlic, parsley, white wine, butter, and olive oil — sometimes with tomato (red sauce) or without (white sauce).

name: Seafoam candy (honeycomb)
notes: Sugar, corn syrup, water, and vinegar cooked to hard-crack, then baking soda whisked in to create airy bubbles — set firm and broken into pieces.

name: Black bean chili
notes: Black beans simmered with ground beef or turkey, onions, peppers, tomatoes, and chili spices — a southwestern chili variant.

name: Fresh blueberry pie
notes: Whole fresh blueberries piled in a baked crust and set with a cooked sugar-and-cornstarch glaze — chilled and topped with whipped cream.

name: German slaw
notes: Shredded cabbage and onions tossed with a sweet-tart vinegar-oil-and-mustard-seed dressing — keeps for days in the fridge.

name: Lemon supreme cake
notes: A yellow Bundt cake from lemon cake mix and lemon pudding mix, sometimes with apricot nectar — soaked with lemon glaze.

name: Cream cheese Danish
notes: Crescent-roll dough wrapped around a sweetened cream-cheese filling, baked, and drizzled with a powdered-sugar glaze.

name: Salmon mousse
notes: A molded appetizer of canned or smoked salmon blended with cream cheese, mayo, lemon, and gelatin — turned out and served with crackers.

name: Lemon poppy seed cake
notes: A bright lemon-scented Bundt cake folded with poppy seeds and yogurt or sour cream, soaked with a tart lemon glaze.

name: Date and nut bread
notes: A spiced quick bread folded with chopped dates and walnuts — moist and lightly sweet, traditionally served with cream cheese.

name: Tourtière
notes: A French-Canadian meat pie of finely ground pork (and sometimes beef) seasoned with cinnamon, clove, and allspice, baked in a double crust.

name: Kentucky Derby pie
notes: A baked pie of eggs, butter, sugar, and flour packed with chocolate chips, pecans, and a splash of bourbon — May-Derby-Day tradition.

name: Ham and cheese sliders
notes: Hawaiian sweet rolls split, filled with ham and Swiss, brushed with a poppy-seed-onion-mustard butter, and baked until melty.

name: Butter tarts
notes: Mini pastry shells filled with a runny brown-sugar-butter-egg-and-raisin filling, baked into Canadian-style mini tarts.

name: Chicken alfredo
notes: Sliced grilled chicken tossed with fettuccine in a butter-and-Parmesan alfredo sauce, often enriched with heavy cream.

name: Mediterranean pasta salad
notes: Cooked pasta tossed with diced cucumber, tomato, red onion, olives, feta, herbs, and a lemon-olive-oil vinaigrette.

name: Roasted tomato soup
notes: Tomatoes roasted with onion, garlic, and olive oil until charred, then simmered with broth, blended, and finished with cream and basil.

name: Beer biscuits
notes: A three-ingredient drop biscuit of self-rising flour, sugar, and a bottle of beer — quick, tender, and lightly hopped.

name: Chocolate silk pie
notes: A chocolate mousse-style pie of butter, sugar, eggs, and melted chocolate whipped until airy, poured into a baked crust and chilled.

name: Hamburger hot dish
notes: Ground beef baked with potatoes or noodles, vegetables, and mushroom soup — a Minnesota / Upper-Midwest one-pan dinner.

name: Crab mold
notes: Cream cheese, mayo, and chopped crab blended with gelatin, set in a decorative mold, and unmolded — served with crackers.

name: Praline cookies
notes: Drop cookies of brown sugar, butter, and pecans — sometimes a thin shortbread topped with praline icing.

name: Baked rice pudding
notes: Cooked rice baked slowly with milk, eggs, sugar, raisins, and warm spices until the top browns and the pudding sets.

name: Jello punch
notes: Fruit-flavored Jello dissolved in hot water, mixed with pineapple juice and lemonade, chilled and topped with ginger ale — a brightly-colored party punch.

name: Kentucky pound cake
notes: A pound cake folded with crushed pineapple and pecans, baked in a Bundt pan and finished with a pineapple-sugar glaze.

name: Italian meatball soup
notes: A clear broth with tiny meatballs, acini di pepe pasta, spinach, and Parmesan — a meatball-based wedding-soup variant.

name: Lobster bisque
notes: A rich seafood-broth-and-cream soup of lobster, aromatics, brandy, and tomato, thickened with a buttery roux and finished with cream.

name: Chicken and sausage gumbo
notes: Chicken and andouille sausage simmered in a dark-roux broth with the trinity of vegetables, file powder, and Creole spices — served over rice.

name: Cranberry muffins
notes: Tender muffins folded with fresh or frozen cranberries and orange zest — a tart-bright morning bake.

name: Hershey bar cake
notes: A chocolate-buttermilk cake baked with melted Hershey almond bars folded into the batter — frosted with chocolate buttercream.

name: Mexican soup
notes: A spiced beef or chicken soup with hominy or beans, peppers, tomato, and chili powder — generic name for Mexican-style soups.

name: Corn flake candy
notes: Corn flakes stirred into a hot peanut-butter-and-sugar syrup or melted chocolate, dropped onto wax paper to set into clusters.

name: Chicken breast casserole
notes: Chicken breasts baked with mushrooms and sour cream — a generic weeknight bake.

name: Italian sausage soup
notes: Italian sausage simmered with tomatoes, peppers, beans, pasta, and herbs in broth — a hearty stockpot soup.

name: Breakfast sausage casserole
notes: Browned breakfast sausage layered with bread, eggs, milk, and cheese — assembled overnight and baked in the morning.

name: Lemon bisque
notes: A chilled lemon dessert of evaporated milk whipped to a froth and folded with lemon Jello, sugar, and crushed graham crackers.

name: Butterfinger ice cream
notes: A custard ice cream churned with crushed Butterfinger candy bars — peanut butter, chocolate, and toffee in every bite.

name: Orange bread
notes: A sweet quick bread bright with orange zest and juice, sometimes folded with cranberries or nuts and finished with an orange glaze.

name: Chocolate peanut butter fudge
notes: Two layers (chocolate and peanut butter) of fudge cooked separately and poured to set on top of each other — peanut-butter cup in fudge form.

name: Baked zucchini
notes: Sliced zucchini baked with butter, eggs, Parmesan, and breadcrumbs until tender and lightly browned.

name: Chuck wagon beans
notes: A mix of canned beans baked with ground beef, bacon, brown sugar, and barbecue sauce — same family as calico / cowboy / ranch beans.

name: Chicken corn soup
notes: Chicken simmered with sweet corn, hard-boiled egg, and rivels (small dumplings) in broth — a Pennsylvania-Dutch farmhouse soup.

name: Raspberry bars
notes: A short butter-oat-and-flour crumb crust topped with raspberry jam and more crumb, baked and cut into bars.

name: Sweet iced tea
notes: Black tea brewed strong, sweetened heavily with sugar while hot, then cooled and served over ice with lemon — the Southern table drink.

name: Chimichangas
notes: A burrito (seasoned meat, rice, beans, cheese) wrapped tightly in a flour tortilla and deep-fried until crisp — Sonoran-Arizona-style.

name: Cowboy caviar
notes: Black-eyed peas and corn tossed with diced bell peppers, tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, and Italian-style vinaigrette — served as a chip dip.

name: Focaccia
notes: A flat yeasted Italian bread baked with olive oil, sea salt, and rosemary on top — tender interior, dimpled crust.

name: Chicken saltimbocca
notes: Pounded chicken cutlets topped with prosciutto and sage, dredged in flour, sautéed, and finished with a white-wine-butter pan sauce.

name: Hello Dolly bars (variant)
notes: A graham crust topped with chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, and pecans, drizzled with sweetened condensed milk and baked.

name: Strawberry fluff
notes: Crushed sweetened strawberries folded with whipped cream or whipped topping — a quick chilled "fluff" dessert.

name: Butter rolls
notes: A buttery yeasted dough shaped into rolls, brushed with melted butter before baking, and pulled apart warm.

name: Barbecue ribs (generic)
notes: Pork ribs rubbed with spices and slow-smoked or baked low, basted with barbecue sauce — generic "ribs" recipe.

name: Green bean bake (casserole)
notes: Green beans baked in cream-of-mushroom soup with milk, topped with crispy fried onions — the Campbell's Thanksgiving side.

name: Spaghetti bake
notes: Cooked spaghetti tossed with ground beef, mushrooms, and tomato sauce, baked under shredded mozzarella.

name: Buttermilk cornbread
notes: A skillet cornbread of cornmeal, flour, eggs, and buttermilk — tender, slightly tangy, with a crisp bottom from a hot buttered pan.

name: O'Henry bars
notes: A baked oat-and-brown-sugar bar topped with melted chocolate and peanut butter — chewy, peanut-butter-cup-flavored.

name: Dried beef casserole
notes: Cooked noodles baked with chopped dried (chipped) beef, mushrooms, and milk-and-butter sauce under shredded cheese.

name: Rotel dip
notes: Velveeta processed cheese melted with ground beef or sausage and Rotel tomatoes-and-chiles — served warm with tortilla chips.

name: White bean soup
notes: Cannellini or great northern beans simmered with ham hock or pancetta, onions, carrots, celery, and herbs in broth.

name: Sweet and sour green beans
notes: Cooked green beans tossed warm with crisp bacon, onion, and a sweet vinegar-bacon-fat dressing.

name: Cream of carrot soup
notes: Carrots simmered with onion in chicken broth, blended smooth, and finished with milk, cream, and a touch of nutmeg.

name: Oatmeal drop cookies
notes: Drop cookies of butter, brown sugar, oats, and warm spices — sometimes with raisins or chopped nuts; chewier than rolled oatmeal cookies.

name: Chicken jambalaya
notes: Chicken and andouille sausage cooked with rice, the trinity of vegetables, tomato, and Cajun seasoning into a one-pot dish.

name: Oven fries
notes: Potato wedges or sticks tossed in oil and seasonings, baked hot until crisp outside and tender inside — a healthier alternative to deep-fried fries.

name: Unstuffed cabbage
notes: Shredded cabbage simmered in a pot with ground beef, rice, tomato, onion, and seasonings — cabbage-roll flavors without the rolling.

name: Veal Marsala
notes: Pounded veal cutlets dredged in flour, browned in butter, and finished in a Marsala-wine and mushroom pan sauce.

name: Shrimp chowder
notes: Diced potatoes and shrimp simmered in a milk-and-cream base with onion, peppers, and herbs — Pacific-Northwest or New England style.

name: Baked Alaska
notes: A cake base topped with ice cream, sealed under a thick layer of meringue, and briefly baked or torched so the meringue browns without melting the ice cream.

name: Tapioca pudding
notes: Small tapioca pearls cooked in milk with sugar, eggs, and vanilla until thickened — chilled to a soft, beaded pudding.

name: Stuffed grape leaves (dolmas)
notes: Grape leaves wrapped around a rice filling with herbs, lemon, and sometimes ground lamb or beef, then braised in lemon broth — Greek/Mediterranean.

name: Ho Ho cake
notes: A chocolate sheet cake filled with a flour-based whipped buttercream and topped with chocolate ganache — Hostess Ho Ho flavors in cake form.

name: Sugarless cookies
notes: Drop cookies sweetened by raisins or apples and dates instead of added sugar — a diabetic-friendly oat cookie.

name: Stuffed squash
notes: Halved acorn or summer squash hollowed and filled with seasoned breadcrumbs, herbs, sausage, or rice, then baked until tender.

name: Mushroom rice
notes: Long-grain rice baked with sliced mushrooms, onions, beef consommé, and butter — a hands-off oven pilaf.

name: Cauliflower and broccoli salad
notes: Raw cauliflower and broccoli florets tossed with red onion, bacon, and a sour-cream-mayo-sugar dressing — chilled overnight.

name: One-bowl brownies
notes: Brownies mixed in a single bowl — melted butter and cocoa stirred with sugar, eggs, vanilla, flour, and nuts; baked into chewy bars.

name: Meringue cookies
notes: Beaten egg whites whipped with sugar to stiff glossy peaks, piped onto sheets, and baked very slowly until crisp and dry.

name: Overnight French toast
notes: Thick slices of bread soaked overnight in an egg-cream-cinnamon custard, then baked into a strata-style breakfast in the morning.

name: Stuffed manicotti
notes: Pasta tubes filled with a ricotta-Parmesan-and-egg mixture (sometimes with ground beef), nested in marinara with mozzarella, baked until bubbling.

name: Candied carrots
notes: Sliced or baby carrots cooked in butter, brown sugar, and a touch of ginger or cinnamon until glazed and tender.

name: Chocolate candy (fudge)
notes: A long-cooked chocolate fudge of sugar, butter, evaporated milk, chocolate chips, and marshmallow creme with chopped nuts.

name: Raspberry pie
notes: A double-crust or lattice pie of fresh raspberries tossed with sugar and a thickener — sweet-tart with deep ruby juice.

name: Chickpea salad
notes: Chickpeas tossed with diced cucumber, tomato, red onion, parsley, lemon, and olive oil — a Mediterranean lunch salad.

name: Avocado salsa
notes: Diced avocado folded with tomato, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime — chunkier than guacamole.

name: Chocolate chunk cookies
notes: Drop cookies of butter-and-brown-sugar dough with hand-chopped chocolate chunks (rather than uniform chips) and pecans.

name: Sesame noodles
notes: Cold or warm noodles tossed in a sauce of toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, peanut butter or tahini, sugar, and rice vinegar — Chinese-American.

name: Tomato salsa
notes: Diced ripe tomato, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime — a fresh chunky salsa for chips and tacos.

name: Italian meatloaf (variant)
notes: A ground-beef loaf with Italian breadcrumbs, Parmesan, herbs, and marinara, baked under mozzarella — lasagna-flavor meatloaf.

name: Marshmallows
