notes: Sugar syrup whipped into a bloomed-gelatin base with vanilla until thick and airy, set in a pan and cut into pillowy squares.

name: Bible cake (Scripture cake)
notes: A spiced fruit-and-nut cake whose ingredients are named by their Bible references (Jeremiah's figs, Genesis's butter, etc.) — a Victorian church-supper novelty.

name: Miniature cheesecakes
notes: Individual cheesecakes baked in muffin tins over a vanilla-wafer crust, topped with fruit pie filling — single-portion party desserts.

name: Roasted pumpkin seeds
notes: Pumpkin seeds rinsed clean, tossed with melted butter and salt, and roasted at low heat until crisp — a fall snack from Halloween pumpkins.

name: Chicken and wild rice
notes: Diced chicken baked with a wild rice blend in mushroom-soup-and-broth gravy with onion and celery.

name: Mexican layered dip (variant)
notes: Refried beans layered with seasoned sour cream or guacamole, salsa, shredded cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and olives — chilled.

name: Cherry Jello salad
notes: Cherry gelatin set with canned cherries, crushed pineapple, and pecans — sometimes layered with sweetened cream cheese.

name: Chinese chicken salad (variant)
notes: Shredded cabbage and lettuce tossed with chicken, crispy ramen or wonton strips, almonds, sesame seeds, and a soy-sesame-sugar dressing.

name: French silk chocolate pie
notes: A chocolate-mousse pie of butter, sugar, eggs, and melted chocolate whipped until airy, poured into a baked crust and chilled.

name: Onion bread
notes: A quick or yeasted bread enriched with sautéed onions and butter — moist and savory, sometimes with dill or cheese.

name: Coconut pies (impossible)
notes: A blender batter of eggs, milk, sugar, butter, coconut, and Bisquick poured into pie pans — bakes self-crusted with a custard middle and toasted coconut top.

name: Cheesecake cookies
notes: A graham-cracker-and-butter crust topped with sweetened cream-cheese-egg-and-lemon filling, baked and cut into squares.

name: Fruited chicken salad
notes: Diced chicken tossed with mandarin oranges, pineapple, grapes, and chopped pecans in a creamy mayo dressing — served chilled.

name: Cold strawberry soup
notes: Crushed sweetened strawberries blended with sour cream, white wine, and citrus — a chilled summer dessert soup.

name: Chocolate no-bake cookies
notes: Cocoa, sugar, milk, and butter boiled to a fudge, then stirred with peanut butter and oats and dropped onto wax paper to set.

name: Fiesta dip
notes: A cold layered Tex-Mex dip of seasoned sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, olives, and tomatoes — served with tortilla chips.

name: Key lime pie
notes: Lime juice whisked into sweetened condensed milk and egg yolks, poured into a graham crust, baked briefly, and chilled — Florida classic.

name: Cheesecake pie
notes: A slimmer cheesecake set in a pie pan — sweetened cream cheese, eggs, and vanilla baked in a graham crust, topped with sour cream and fruit.

name: Breakfast bake (variant)
notes: A make-ahead casserole of eggs, milk, sausage or bacon, cheese, and bread cubes — assembled overnight and baked in the morning.

name: Jello pie
notes: Fruit-flavored Jello dissolved in hot water, whisked with ice cream and folded with fruit, poured into a graham crust and chilled until set.

name: Unbaked fruitcake
notes: Crushed graham crackers or vanilla wafers mixed with candied fruit, dates, nuts, and sweetened condensed milk — pressed in a pan and chilled.

name: Cranberry cake
notes: A butter cake folded with fresh cranberries and orange zest — a Thanksgiving dessert sometimes served with a warm butter sauce.

name: Chinese almond cookies
notes: Shortbread-style cookies with whole almonds pressed into the center — a Chinese-bakery and Lunar-New-Year staple.

name: Potato puffs
notes: Mashed potatoes mixed with eggs and flour, piped or scooped onto sheets, and baked into golden puffed mounds.

name: Oyster casserole
notes: Shucked oysters layered with crushed crackers, butter, and seasonings, soaked in milk or cream and baked until just set.

name: Apple turnovers
notes: Squares of puff pastry filled with spiced cooked apples, folded and sealed, baked until golden, and drizzled with a sugar glaze.

name: Make-ahead mashed potatoes
notes: Mashed potatoes whipped with cream cheese, sour cream, butter, and seasonings, refrigerated, then reheated in the oven — party-potatoes-style.

name: Calzone
notes: Pizza dough folded around fillings of ricotta, mozzarella, cured meats, and vegetables, sealed and baked until golden — a Neapolitan stuffed pizza.

name: Cupcakes
notes: Individual portion cakes baked in muffin tins (butter or oil base) and topped with frosting — vanilla, chocolate, red velvet, or flavored.

name: Mashed sweet potatoes
notes: Boiled or baked sweet potatoes mashed with butter, brown sugar, and warm spices — sometimes finished with maple syrup or pecans.

name: Chicken burritos
notes: Flour tortillas wrapped around shredded chicken, rice, beans, cheese, and salsa — Tex-Mex/Mission-style.

name: Banana split salad
notes: Sliced bananas, strawberries, and pineapple folded with chopped pecans and a sweet whipped-cream-and-cream-cheese dressing.

name: Mulled wine
notes: Red wine warmed with sugar, cinnamon sticks, cloves, orange peel, and a splash of brandy — Glühwein in the German tradition.

name: Crème de menthe brownies
notes: Fudge brownies topped with a layer of buttercream tinted with crème de menthe, then a layer of melted chocolate.

name: Pecan pies
notes: A custard of eggs, sugar, butter, and corn syrup studded with pecan halves, baked in a flaky crust — Southern Thanksgiving classic.

name: Hardee's biscuits (copycat)
notes: A copycat of the Hardee's drop biscuit — self-rising flour, shortening, and buttermilk; tall, tender, and slightly sweet.

name: Texas potatoes
notes: Frozen hash browns baked with sour cream, cream of chicken soup, butter, and cheddar — funeral-potatoes-style.

name: Autumn soup
notes: Ground beef simmered with potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, and tomato in beef broth — a hearty stockpot soup for chilly months.

name: Pear cake
notes: A spiced oil-based cake folded with diced ripe pears and pecans — moist with warm cinnamon-clove notes.

name: Homemade peppermint patties
notes: A fondant of powdered sugar, butter, sweetened condensed milk, and peppermint extract rolled flat and dipped in melted chocolate.

name: Hopping John (variant)
notes: Black-eyed peas simmered with rice, smoked pork (ham hock or bacon), onion, and peppers — a Carolina-Lowcountry New Year's dish.

name: Chicken and rice bake
notes: Raw rice and chicken pieces baked together in mushroom-soup-and-broth gravy with onions and peppers — hands-off oven dinner.

name: Chocolate peanut butter bars
notes: A peanut-butter shortbread base topped with melted chocolate and a peanut-butter-powdered-sugar drizzle — cut into bars.

name: Fudge brownie pie
notes: A fudgy brownie batter baked in a pie pan with chocolate chips and walnuts — served wedge-cut with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: Buttered toasted pecans
notes: Pecan halves tossed with melted butter and salt, then slow-roasted in the oven until aromatic and crisp.

name: Ham and cheese quiche
notes: A pastry shell filled with diced ham, Swiss cheese, eggs, and cream — baked into a savory custard tart.

name: Lemon Jello salad
notes: Lemon gelatin set with crushed pineapple, cottage cheese or cream cheese, and whipped topping — a Southern molded dessert salad.

name: Fried catfish
notes: Catfish fillets soaked in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned cornmeal, and pan- or deep-fried until crisp — Southern fish-fry standard.

name: Pineapple pudding
notes: Vanilla pudding folded with crushed pineapple, layered with vanilla wafers and whipped topping — a Southern banana-pudding cousin.

name: Mexican layer dip (variant)
notes: A cold layered dip of refried beans or seasoned sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, lettuce, olives, and onions — same as 7-layer dip.

name: Yankee pot roast
notes: A chuck or round roast seared, then slow-braised in beef broth with onions, carrots, potatoes, and herbs until fork-tender.

name: Baked sweet potatoes
notes: Whole sweet potatoes baked in their skins at high heat until tender, split open and topped with butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon.

name: Hamburgers
notes: Ground beef patties seasoned with salt and pepper, seared or grilled, served on a soft bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle, and condiments.

name: Orange pound cake
notes: A dense pound cake bright with orange zest and juice, often soaked or glazed with an orange-sugar syrup.

name: Candy bar pie
notes: Melted Snickers or Mars bars folded with cream cheese and whipped topping, poured into an Oreo or chocolate-cookie crust and frozen.

name: Homemade sausage patties
notes: Ground pork mixed with sage, thyme, salt, pepper, and a touch of brown sugar or maple, formed into patties and pan-fried.

name: Spaghetti with meat sauce
notes: Cooked spaghetti topped with a long-simmered tomato sauce of ground beef, onions, garlic, mushrooms, and Italian herbs.

name: Smoked salmon dip
notes: Smoked salmon blended with cream cheese, sour cream, lemon, dill, capers, and onion — served chilled with crackers or bagel chips.

name: Pumpkin pecan pie
notes: A layered pie of pumpkin custard topped with a pecan-pie corn-syrup-and-pecan layer, baked together until set.

name: 7 layer dip (variant)
notes: Refried beans layered with seasoned sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, lettuce, olives, and tomato — served chilled with chips.

name: Glazed carrots (side)
notes: Sliced or baby carrots cooked tender in butter and brown sugar with a splash of orange juice — generic "carrots" side.

name: Chicken satay
notes: Strips of chicken marinated in coconut milk, soy, and curry spices, threaded on skewers and grilled — served with peanut sauce.

name: Chocolate mousse cake
notes: A chocolate cake or flourless chocolate base topped with airy chocolate mousse, chilled until set — sometimes ganache-glazed.

name: Calzones (variant)
notes: Pizza dough folded around fillings of ricotta, mozzarella, cured meats, and vegetables, sealed and baked until golden.

name: Garlic roasted potatoes
notes: Quartered potatoes tossed with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, and salt, then roasted hot until crisp outside and tender inside.

name: Fish cakes
notes: Cooked white fish mixed with mashed potato, egg, onion, lemon, and herbs, formed into patties and pan-fried — British/Atlantic-Coast classic.

name: Buttered popcorn
notes: Popcorn kernels popped in oil or a hot-air popper, tossed with melted butter and salt — the classic movie snack.

name: Clams casino
notes: Half-shell clams topped with a savory mix of bacon, peppers, onion, garlic, butter, and breadcrumbs, then broiled until the bacon crisps.

name: Garlic soup
notes: Many cloves of garlic sautéed in olive oil, simmered with bread and broth, blended smooth — Spanish sopa de ajo or French Provençal style.

name: Red lentil soup
notes: Red lentils simmered with onion, carrot, tomato, and warm spices (cumin, paprika, ginger), blended (or partially) and finished with lemon.

name: Quinoa salad
notes: Cooked quinoa tossed with diced cucumber, tomato, herbs, lemon, and olive oil — a Mediterranean-inflected grain salad.

name: Red velvet cupcakes
notes: Red-tinted cocoa-buttermilk cupcakes (with vinegar for the chemical reaction with cocoa), topped with cream cheese frosting.

name: Diabetic cookies
notes: Drop cookies sweetened by dried fruit (raisins, dates) and apples in place of granulated sugar — diabetic-friendly oat cookies.

name: Butterscotch squares
notes: A brown-sugar-and-butter blondie packed with butterscotch chips and pecans — chewy and toffee-toned.

name: Oreo pie
notes: Crushed Oreos mixed with melted butter for a crust, filled with sweetened cream cheese, chocolate pudding, and whipped topping.

name: Bread stuffing
notes: Cubed bread mixed with sautéed onions, celery, sage, parsley, and broth, baked into the Thanksgiving stuffing.

name: Oatmeal bars
notes: Oats, brown sugar, butter, and eggs baked into bars — sometimes layered with jam, chocolate chips, or dates.

name: Peanut butter temptations
notes: Peanut butter cookies baked in muffin tins and pressed warm with a Reese's mini peanut butter cup — same family as peanut butter blossoms.

name: Ugly Duckling cake
notes: A yellow cake mix combined with crushed pineapple and a box of instant pudding, topped with a coconut-pecan-butter broiled glaze.

name: Garlic cheese grits
notes: Stone-ground grits cooked in broth or milk, then folded with butter, eggs, garlic, and sharp cheddar — baked or held creamy.

name: Cheese crisps
notes: Sharp cheddar, butter, flour, and Rice Krispies mixed and shaped into thin discs, baked into crisp savory bites — Southern.

name: Rolled sugar cookies
notes: A butter-sugar dough chilled, rolled flat, and cut into shapes — decorated with royal icing or sprinkles.

name: Hot beef dip
notes: Cream cheese mixed with chipped beef, peppers, onion, and sour cream, baked until bubbly — served warm with crackers.

name: Pizzelles
notes: A thin, crisp Italian waffle cookie of butter, eggs, sugar, flour, and anise (or vanilla) — pressed in a pizzelle iron into intricate patterns.

name: Instant hot chocolate mix
notes: A dry pantry mix of powdered milk, cocoa, sugar, and powdered creamer — stirred into hot water for instant cocoa.

name: Lasagna casserole
notes: Broken lasagna noodles or rotini layered with ground beef, marinara, ricotta, and mozzarella, baked until bubbly — lasagna without the rolling.

name: Date nut cake
notes: A spiced butter cake folded with chopped dates and walnuts or pecans, soaked or glazed with a brown-sugar caramel.

name: Hot bean dip
notes: Refried beans warmed with sour cream, salsa, cream cheese, and shredded cheddar — baked until bubbly, served with tortilla chips.

name: Chocolate chip brownies
notes: Fudge brownies with chocolate chips folded into the batter — double-chocolate, baked just until the center sets.

name: Sour cream muffins
notes: Tender muffins enriched with sour cream — soft, tangy crumb that bakes light and slightly sweet.

name: Pineapple cheesecake
notes: A baked or no-bake cream-cheese cheesecake topped with crushed pineapple cooked with sugar and a thickener.

name: Steak soup
notes: Cubed beef sirloin simmered with vegetables and a tomato-broth base, thickened with a flour-and-butter roux — Plaza-III Kansas City classic.

name: Hot tamale pie
notes: A seasoned beef-and-corn-chili filling topped with cornbread batter and baked — a one-pan Tex-Mex casserole, slightly spicier.

name: Brown rice casserole
notes: Cooked brown rice baked with browned beef or chicken, mushrooms, vegetables, and mushroom soup — a hands-off oven dinner.

name: Cauliflower au gratin
notes: Steamed cauliflower florets layered in a milk-and-cheese bechamel and baked under buttered breadcrumbs and more cheese.

name: Golden Parmesan potatoes
notes: Potato wedges tossed in flour, salt, paprika, and Parmesan, then roasted in butter on a hot sheet pan until golden and crisp.

name: Vegetable quiche
notes: A pastry shell filled with an egg-and-cream custard, sautéed vegetables (broccoli, mushrooms, peppers), and cheese — meatless quiche.

name: Beer can chicken
notes: A whole chicken seasoned and propped upright on a half-full can of beer, then grilled or roasted — the beer steams the bird from the inside.

name: Belgian waffles
notes: A yeasted or chemically-leavened batter cooked in a deep-grid Belgian-style waffle iron — light, crisp, with deep pockets for syrup or fruit.

name: Spice cookies
notes: Drop or rolled cookies of butter, brown sugar, eggs, and warm spices (cinnamon, ginger, cloves, allspice).

name: Hot fudge pudding cake
notes: A self-saucing chocolate cake — batter spread in a pan, topped with cocoa-sugar and boiling water, baked so a fudge sauce sinks beneath.

name: Old-fashioned rice pudding
notes: Cooked rice simmered slowly in milk with sugar, eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, and raisins — baked or stovetop until thick and creamy.

name: Potato gnocchi
notes: Soft Italian dumplings of mashed potato, flour, and egg — boiled briefly and tossed with butter-sage, marinara, or pesto.

name: Tunnel of fudge cake
notes: A walnut Bundt cake with a flour-frosting-mix center that bakes into a soft fudge tunnel — Pillsbury Bake-Off original.

name: Four layer delight
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of pecan-shortbread crust, sweetened cream cheese, chocolate or vanilla pudding, and whipped topping.

name: Energy bars (homemade granola)
notes: Oats, dried fruit, nuts, seeds, and chocolate chips bound with peanut butter and honey or corn syrup, pressed into a pan and chilled.

name: New England boiled dinner
notes: A whole corned-beef brisket simmered with cabbage, potatoes, carrots, and turnips — Yankee-Irish-American St. Patrick's tradition.

name: Chiles rellenos (variant)
notes: Roasted poblano chiles stuffed with cheese, dipped in an egg-white batter, and fried golden — served in tomato sauce.

name: Corned beef
notes: A brined beef brisket simmered with cabbage, carrots, and potatoes — Irish-American St. Patrick's Day staple.

name: BBQ chicken
notes: Chicken pieces brushed with barbecue sauce as they grill or roast, often after a dry rub of paprika, brown sugar, and garlic powder.

name: Peanut butter cup cookies
notes: Peanut butter cookies baked in muffin tins and pressed warm with a Reese's mini peanut butter cup — same family as peanut butter blossoms.

name: Hobo stew
notes: A simple stockpot stew of ground beef, potatoes, carrots, onions, and tomato — Depression-era one-pot.

name: Potluck potatoes
notes: Frozen hash browns baked with sour cream, cream of chicken soup, butter, and cheddar under a cornflake topping — funeral-potatoes-style.

name: Spätzle
notes: A soft German egg-noodle dough scraped or pressed into boiling water, then tossed with butter or browned in butter with crumbs.

name: Taco salad dip
notes: A cold layered dip of seasoned sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and olives — served with tortilla chips.

name: Hot taco dip
notes: Cream cheese spread topped with taco-seasoned ground beef, salsa, and shredded cheese, baked or warmed until bubbly — chip dip.

name: Banana pudding cake
notes: A yellow cake mix combined with mashed banana, vanilla pudding, eggs, and oil, baked into a moist banana-flavored cake.

name: Heavenly hash cake
notes: A chocolate sheet cake topped warm with marshmallows, then drizzled with chocolate-cocoa-pecan frosting — Mississippi-Mud-Cake cousin.

name: Copper penny carrots
notes: Sliced cooked carrots ("pennies") tossed with bell pepper and onion in a tangy tomato-soup-and-vinegar marinade — chilled overnight.

name: Italian wedding cookies
notes: Soft anise-scented butter cookies, sometimes ricotta-based, dipped in a powdered-sugar glaze and topped with sprinkles — Italian-American holiday bake.

name: Frozen punch
notes: Sweetened fruit juices frozen until slushy, then scooped into a punch bowl and topped with lemon-lime soda or ginger ale.

name: Rhubarb cobbler
notes: Chopped rhubarb baked under a tender biscuit or batter topping — served warm with ice cream.

name: Saltine cracker candy (Christmas crack)
notes: Saltine crackers laid on a sheet pan, topped with a hot brown-sugar-butter caramel, sprinkled with chocolate chips that melt into a layer.

name: Cheesy garlic bread
notes: A loaf of Italian bread split, brushed with butter, garlic, and herbs, topped with mozzarella and Parmesan, baked until bubbly.

name: Blueberry Jello salad
notes: Blackberry or grape Jello set with crushed pineapple and blueberries, layered with sweetened cream cheese-and-sour-cream topping — a Southern molded dessert.

name: Polish mistakes
notes: Browned ground beef and Italian sausage mixed with Velveeta and oregano, spread on cocktail rye slices and baked or broiled — a tailgate appetizer.

name: Fried ice cream
notes: Scoops of ice cream rolled in crushed cornflakes or cookie crumbs, refrozen hard, and briefly deep-fried so the coating crisps without melting the ice cream.

name: Chocolate sheath cake (Texas)
notes: A thin chocolate-buttermilk sheet cake topped warm with a poured cocoa-pecan icing that sets to a fudge-like crust — same as Texas sheet cake.

name: Okra gumbo
notes: A Louisiana stew thickened with sliced okra (instead of roux), with chicken, andouille, and the trinity of vegetables — served over rice.

name: Millionaires (candy)
notes: Pecans tossed in a hot caramel, dropped onto wax paper into clusters, then dipped in melted chocolate — a Southern turtle-candy cousin.

name: Cream cheese cupcakes
notes: Mini cheesecakes baked in muffin tins over a vanilla-wafer crust, topped with fruit pie filling — same family as mini cheesecakes.

name: Smoked salmon spread
notes: Smoked salmon blended with cream cheese, sour cream, lemon, capers, and dill — served chilled with bagel chips or crackers.

name: Vegetable chili
notes: A bean-and-vegetable chili of black, kidney, and pinto beans simmered with tomatoes, peppers, corn, and chili spices — meatless and hearty.

name: Lasagna roll-ups
notes: Cooked lasagna noodles spread with a ricotta-spinach filling, rolled into individual portions, sauced with marinara, and baked under mozzarella.

name: Barbecue meatloaf
notes: A ground-beef loaf bound with breadcrumbs and egg, glazed with barbecue sauce instead of ketchup, and baked.

name: Cornbread stuffing
notes: Crumbled cornbread mixed with sautéed onions, celery, sage, broth, and eggs, baked into a Southern Thanksgiving dressing.

name: Irish potato casserole
notes: Mashed potatoes whipped with cream cheese, sour cream, butter, and seasonings, baked under shredded cheese — funeral-potatoes-style with an Irish name.

name: Pecan cake
notes: A spiced butter cake folded with chopped pecans and dried or candied fruit, baked in a Bundt or tube pan — a fruitcake-cousin.

name: Bacon wrapped water chestnuts
notes: Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon strips, baked or broiled, and served with a sweet soy or barbecue glaze — a retro cocktail-party appetizer.

name: Frittata
notes: Eggs whisked with cheese and seasonings, poured over sautéed vegetables in a skillet, finished in the oven — an Italian open-face omelet.

name: Fruit smoothie
notes: Frozen fruit blended with yogurt or milk, ice, and a touch of sweetener — sometimes with protein powder or greens.

name: Cocoa brownies
notes: Brownies made with cocoa powder instead of melted chocolate — a streamlined butter-and-cocoa-based bar.

name: Sausage and peppers
notes: Italian sausage links browned and braised with sliced peppers and onions in tomato sauce — served on a hoagie or over pasta.

name: Crab puffs
notes: Pâte à choux mounds filled with crab salad, or English-muffin halves topped with cream cheese, crab, and cheese, broiled until puffed and golden.

name: Grilled vegetables
notes: Mixed vegetables (zucchini, peppers, eggplant, onions, mushrooms) tossed in oil and herbs, then grilled hot until charred and tender.

name: Sticky toffee pudding
notes: A dense date-cake baked tender and served warm with a hot toffee sauce and whipped cream or ice cream — the British classic.

name: Pecan kisses (meringue)
notes: Beaten egg whites and sugar folded with chopped pecans, dropped onto sheets and baked into crisp meringue cookies.

name: Chicken cheese ball
notes: Cream cheese mixed with chopped cooked chicken, peppers, and seasonings, shaped into a ball and rolled in chopped pecans — served with crackers.

name: Apricot cake
notes: A yellow oil-based cake folded with chopped dried apricots, soaked after baking with an apricot-juice-and-sugar glaze.

name: White chocolate cake
notes: A vanilla layer cake folded with melted white chocolate and coconut or almonds, often filled with a white-chocolate buttercream.

name: French dip sandwiches
notes: Sliced roast beef piled on a long roll with Swiss cheese, served with a small bowl of beef au jus for dipping.

name: Apricot nut bread
notes: A sweet quick bread folded with chopped dried apricots and walnuts, brightened with orange zest — moist with a tender crumb.

name: Lazy daisy cake
notes: A simple buttermilk butter cake topped warm with a broiled brown-sugar-coconut-pecan glaze — a Depression-era one-pan dessert.

name: Hearty vegetable soup
notes: Mixed vegetables, beans, and sometimes ground beef simmered with tomatoes and herbs in broth — a stockpot weeknight soup.

name: Strawberry slush cocktail
notes: Frozen strawberries and lemonade concentrate blended with vodka or rum, frozen in a container, then scooped slushy with lemon-lime soda.

name: Sour cream chocolate cake (Southern)
notes: A cocoa cake enriched with sour cream — moist, tangy crumb that pairs especially well with chocolate fudge frosting.

name: Raisin oatmeal cookies
notes: Drop cookies of butter, brown sugar, oats, raisins, and warm spices — chewy and homey.

name: Pear bread
notes: A spiced quick bread folded with chopped fresh pears and walnuts — moist and lightly sweet, fall and winter favorite.

name: Skillet dinner
notes: Ground beef browned with onions, peppers, and tomato, then simmered with rice or noodles into a one-skillet weeknight dish.

name: English pea casserole (variant)
notes: Sweet green peas baked with mushrooms, water chestnuts, mushroom soup, and cheese under buttered cracker crumbs.

name: Russian tea mix
notes: A pantry mix of instant tea, powdered Tang, sugar, and warm spices — stirred into hot water for a non-alcoholic spiced hot drink.

name: Buffalo chip cookies
notes: A giant kitchen-sink drop cookie packed with oats, cornflakes, coconut, chocolate chips, and chopped pecans — chewy with crunch.

name: Homemade Reese's peanut butter cups
notes: A peanut butter, powdered sugar, and graham-cracker filling sandwiched between layers of melted chocolate in muffin cups.

name: Lazy lasagna
notes: Cooked rotini or shell pasta tossed with ground beef, marinara, ricotta, and mozzarella, then baked — lasagna without rolling the noodles.

name: Marinated flank steak
notes: Flank steak marinated in soy sauce, oil, garlic, and a sweetener, then grilled hot and sliced thin across the grain.

name: Cheesy hash browns
notes: Frozen hash browns baked with sour cream, cream of chicken soup, butter, and cheddar — funeral-potatoes-style breakfast.

name: Polynesian chicken
notes: Chicken pieces baked or simmered in a sweet-tangy pineapple-soy-and-ginger sauce with bell peppers — served over rice.

name: Fried pies
notes: Hand-held pastry rounds filled with spiced cooked fruit (apple, peach, apricot), sealed, and deep-fried until golden — Southern.

name: Filled (raisin) cookies
notes: Rolled sugar-cookie dough cut into rounds, filled with a cooked raisin-or-date filling, sealed, and baked into stuffed cookies.

name: Cottage cheese pancakes
notes: Eggs whisked with cottage cheese and a small amount of flour, cooked thin on a griddle — high-protein, blintz-like pancakes.

name: Salmon stew
notes: Canned or cooked salmon simmered with diced potatoes, onion, butter, and milk into a chowder-like stew.

name: Stir-fry chicken
notes: Diced chicken stir-fried in a hot wok with peppers, onions, broccoli, and a soy-sugar-cornstarch sauce — served over rice.

name: Taffy apple dip
notes: Cream cheese whipped with brown sugar, vanilla, and chopped peanuts or toffee bits — served with sliced apples for dipping.

name: Corn soup
notes: Sweet corn simmered with onion, potato, and broth, blended (or partially) and finished with milk or cream — a creamy corn chowder.

name: Chile verde (variant)
notes: Pork shoulder slow-simmered with tomatillos, green chiles, onion, and cumin until tender — served with tortillas or over rice.

name: Mushroom chicken
notes: Chicken breasts simmered with sliced mushrooms and onions in a cream-of-mushroom-soup gravy or sour-cream sauce.

name: Seven layer casserole
notes: Layers of rice, corn, ground beef, peppers, onions, tomato sauce, and bacon strips baked together — a Pennsylvania-Dutch hot dish.

name: Chicken and rice soup
notes: Chicken simmered with rice, carrots, celery, onion, and herbs in broth — a stockpot weeknight cold-fighter.

name: Chile relleno casserole
notes: Whole green chiles split open and layered with cheese, poured over with an egg-and-milk batter and baked — deconstructed chile relleno.

name: Cherries jubilee
notes: Pitted cherries simmered in a sugar-and-orange syrup, flambéed tableside with kirsch or brandy, and ladled over vanilla ice cream.

name: Piña colada
notes: Coconut cream, pineapple juice, and white rum blended with ice into a creamy frozen cocktail — Puerto Rican.

name: Cheesy chicken enchiladas
notes: Tortillas rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, baked in enchilada sauce, topped with more cheese and broiled bubbly.

name: Strawberry banana smoothie
notes: Frozen strawberries and ripe banana blended with milk or yogurt and a touch of honey — a classic breakfast or post-workout drink.

name: Heavenly pie
notes: A meringue shell filled with whipped cream folded with lemon curd and crushed pineapple — chilled and topped with chopped pecans.

name: Baked chicken Reuben
notes: Chicken breasts layered with sauerkraut and Swiss cheese, drizzled with Thousand Island dressing, and baked — Reuben sandwich as a dinner.

name: Teriyaki chicken wings
notes: Chicken wings marinated and baked in a soy-mirin-brown-sugar-ginger glaze until sticky and bronzed.

name: Orange glazed sweet potatoes
notes: Sliced sweet potatoes baked in a butter-brown-sugar-orange-juice glaze — sticky and bright with citrus.

name: Pork chops supreme
notes: Pork chops baked in a sweet-tangy sauce of ketchup, brown sugar, lemon, and onion — a 1960s entertaining dish.

name: Barbecue baked beans
notes: Canned beans baked with ground beef, bacon, brown sugar, and barbecue sauce — thick and sweet cowboy-style.

name: Cracker salad
notes: Crushed saltines tossed with diced tomatoes, onion, hard-boiled egg, and mayo — a Southern picnic side, somewhere between salad and stuffing.

name: Layered nacho dip
notes: Refried beans layered with seasoned sour cream, salsa, cheese, jalapeños, and olives — served chilled with tortilla chips.

name: Chicken dish (mushroom)
notes: Generic name for a baked or sautéed chicken with mushrooms and onions in a creamy sauce — a placeholder for several variants.

name: Cream of spinach soup
notes: Chopped spinach simmered in chicken broth with onion, then blended and finished with milk, cream, and a touch of nutmeg.

name: White trash candy (variant)
notes: Chex, pretzels, peanuts, Cheerios, and M&Ms tossed with melted white chocolate and almond bark, spread to set and broken into pieces.

name: Chili pie
notes: Layered chili, cheese, and tortilla chips or cornmeal-batter topping, baked together — a Tex-Mex casserole / Frito-pie variant.

name: Pepperoni pizza dip
notes: Cream cheese spread topped with marinara, mozzarella, pepperoni, and Italian seasoning, baked until melty — served with breadsticks or chips.

name: Tiger butter
notes: White chocolate and peanut butter melted together, drizzled with melted dark chocolate and swirled with a knife, then broken into pieces.

name: Date nut roll
notes: Cooked dates folded with nuts and crushed graham crackers, rolled into a log and chilled, then sliced into rounds — Southern cookie-candy.

name: Pumpkin spice cake
notes: A spice cake mix combined with pumpkin puree, eggs, and oil, baked into a moist spiced cake — often frosted with cream cheese icing.

name: Sour cream cookies (Southern)
notes: Soft, cake-like sugar cookies made tender by sour cream and a touch of nutmeg — often glazed with vanilla icing.

name: Herb bread
notes: A loaf of bread split, brushed with herbed butter (parsley, dill, garlic), and broiled until golden — Italian-restaurant style.

name: Ham and noodle casserole
notes: Cooked egg noodles baked with cubed ham, peas, cheese, and a cream-soup sauce — a leftover-ham one-dish meal.

name: Frogmore stew (Lowcountry boil)
notes: Shrimp, smoked sausage, corn on the cob, and red potatoes boiled with Old Bay in a big pot — a Carolina Lowcountry one-pot.

name: Chicken and sausage jambalaya
notes: Chicken and andouille sausage cooked with rice, the trinity of vegetables, and Cajun seasoning — a Louisiana one-pot.

name: Ants on a log
notes: Celery sticks filled with peanut butter and topped with raisins — a kids' classic snack.

name: Pimiento cheese
notes: Shredded sharp cheddar bound with mayo and diced pimentos, seasoned with cayenne — the Southern "caviar" spread for sandwiches or crackers.

name: Cream of crab soup
notes: Lump crab simmered in a milk-and-butter-roux base with a splash of sherry, Old Bay, and herbs — Maryland-style.

name: Seasoned oyster cracker snacks
notes: Oyster crackers tossed with oil, dry ranch mix, dill, and lemon pepper, baked until aromatic — a seasoned party snack.

name: Party dip
notes: Generic name for a chilled sour cream and mayo dip seasoned with dried herbs, onion, and Worcestershire — served with chips or vegetables.

name: Mystery pie (Ritz cracker)
notes: A meringue-style pie of beaten egg whites, sugar, vanilla, and crushed Ritz crackers folded with chopped pecans — bakes into a chewy nut-pie.

name: Pan-seared steak
notes: A beef steak (ribeye, New York strip, or sirloin) seasoned and seared in a hot pan with butter, garlic, and herbs.

name: Baked onions
notes: Whole sweet onions hollowed and stuffed with butter, herbs, and cheese, then slow-baked until tender and caramelized.

name: Steak and gravy
notes: Cube steak or round steak dredged in flour and browned, then braised slowly with onions and mushrooms in a brown gravy.

name: Lemon cream pie
notes: A baked pastry shell filled with a cooked lemon-pudding custard and topped with whipped cream — chilled until set.

name: Spanish chicken
notes: Chicken pieces braised with onions, peppers, tomatoes, paprika, and saffron — Spanish-style with rice.

name: Lemon cheese bars
notes: A yellow cake-mix base topped with a sweetened lemon-cream-cheese filling, baked into bars — chess-square-style with lemon.

name: Puppy chow (people)
notes: Chex cereal coated in melted chocolate and peanut butter, then tossed with powdered sugar — same as muddy buddies.

name: Marinated olives
notes: Mixed olives tossed with olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, herbs, and red pepper flakes — chilled and served as an antipasto.

name: Russian chicken
notes: Chicken pieces baked over a sauce of Russian dressing, apricot preserves, and onion soup mix — a retro pantry casserole.

name: Gingerbread pancakes
notes: Spiced buttermilk pancake batter with molasses, ginger, cinnamon, and cloves — a holiday breakfast.

name: Banana cookies
notes: Soft drop cookies of mashed banana, butter, sugar, eggs, and oats or flour — sometimes spiced, sometimes with raisins or chocolate chips.

name: Summer pasta salad
notes: Cooked rotini or shells tossed with diced cucumber, tomato, peppers, onion, and Italian dressing — chilled.

name: Roasted cauliflower
notes: Cauliflower florets tossed with olive oil, garlic, and salt, roasted hot until tender and lightly charred — sometimes finished with Parmesan.

name: Breakfast burrito
notes: A flour tortilla wrapped around scrambled eggs, breakfast sausage or bacon, cheese, and potatoes — sometimes salsa and beans too.

name: BLT salad
notes: Romaine, diced tomatoes, crisp bacon, and croutons tossed with mayo or ranch dressing — BLT sandwich flavors as a salad.

name: Cherry torte
notes: A graham crust topped with sweetened cream cheese, cherry pie filling, and whipped topping — same family as cherry delight.

name: Yeast buns
notes: A soft enriched yeasted dough mixed and proofed, shaped into rolls, and baked until golden — for hamburgers, hot dogs, or dinner.

name: Mini cheesecakes (variant)
notes: Individual cheesecakes baked in muffin tins over a vanilla-wafer crust, topped with fruit pie filling.

name: Blond brownies (blondies)
notes: Brown-sugar-and-butter bars in brownie shape but with vanilla in place of chocolate — sometimes with butterscotch or chocolate chips.

name: Chocolate cherry bars
notes: A chocolate cake mix combined with canned cherry pie filling and eggs, baked and topped with a chocolate-fudge frosting — cut into bars.

name: Buttermilk brownies (Texas sheet cake)
notes: A thin chocolate-buttermilk sheet "brownie" topped warm with a poured cocoa-pecan icing — same as Texas sheet cake.

name: Hanky panky
notes: Browned ground beef and Italian sausage mixed with Velveeta and oregano, spread on cocktail rye and baked — same as Polish mistakes.

name: Anadama bread
notes: A yeasted New England loaf sweetened with molasses and enriched with cornmeal — soft, brown, and faintly sweet.

name: Buttered corn
notes: Fresh or frozen sweet corn cooked tender and tossed with butter, salt, and pepper — a simple side.

name: Lime congealed salad
notes: Lime gelatin set with crushed pineapple, cottage cheese, whipped topping, and chopped pecans — a Southern molded dessert salad.

name: Macaroni and cheese (variant)
notes: Elbow macaroni in a cheddar-bechamel sauce — generic "macaroni" recipe is typically mac and cheese.

name: Italian potato salad
notes: Boiled potatoes tossed with olive oil, white wine vinegar, garlic, herbs, capers, and red onion — no mayo, served warm or chilled.

name: Coca-Cola cake (variant)
notes: A buttermilk-and-cocoa sheet cake with a bottle of Coca-Cola stirred into the batter, finished with a warm cola-pecan icing.

name: Sautéed zucchini
notes: Sliced zucchini sautéed in olive oil with garlic, salt, and Parmesan — a simple summer side.

name: Marinated mushrooms (variant)
notes: Whole button mushrooms tossed in a herb-and-vinegar marinade with oil, lemon, and seasonings — chilled as an appetizer.

name: Old-fashioned tea cakes
notes: A simple Southern butter-sugar-flour cookie scented with vanilla and nutmeg — soft, cake-like, traditionally served with tea.

name: Marble cake
notes: A butter cake batter split in two and tinted dark with cocoa, then swirled together for a marbled chocolate-and-vanilla effect.

name: Paprika chicken
notes: Chicken pieces browned and simmered in a sour-cream-and-paprika sauce — a Hungarian-American variant of paprikash.

name: Chocolate truffles
notes: Chocolate ganache (chocolate and warm cream) chilled, scooped into balls, and rolled in cocoa, nuts, or coatings.

name: Marinated chicken breasts
notes: Chicken breasts marinated in Italian dressing or a soy-citrus mixture and then grilled, baked, or pan-cooked.

name: Walnut pie
notes: A pecan-pie-style filling of eggs, sugar, butter, and corn syrup studded with walnut halves instead of pecans — toasty and rich.

name: Chicken broccoli (Divan-style)
notes: Cooked chicken and broccoli baked in a mayo-and-mushroom-soup sauce with curry powder, topped with cheese and breadcrumbs.

name: Pecan crispies (sandies)
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar shortbread folded with finely chopped pecans — same family as pecan sandies and snowballs.

name: Almond crescents
notes: A butter-shortbread folded with ground almonds, shaped into crescents and baked, then rolled in powdered sugar — German Vanillekipferl style.

name: Strawberry Jello cake (poke)
notes: A baked white cake poked all over and saturated with strawberry Jello, then chilled and topped with whipped topping and fresh strawberries.

name: Almond cake
notes: A dense butter cake folded with ground almonds and almond extract, often soaked or glazed with a sugar-almond syrup.

name: Margaritas (pitcher)
notes: Tequila, lime juice, and triple sec or Cointreau mixed with ice and served in salt-rimmed glasses — Mexico's most-exported cocktail.

name: Mexican pinwheels
notes: Tortillas spread with seasoned cream cheese, salsa, olives, and green chiles, rolled into a log and sliced into pinwheels.

name: 7-Up salad (variant)
notes: Lemon-lime Jello set with crushed pineapple, mandarin oranges, and a bottle of 7-Up, folded with whipped topping and pecans.

name: Hot milk sponge cake
notes: A foam-leavened cake of beaten eggs and sugar whisked with hot scalded milk and melted butter — moist, fine-crumbed, served plain or with fruit.

name: Beef pot roast
notes: A chuck or round roast seared and slow-braised in beef broth with onions, carrots, potatoes, and herbs until fork-tender.

name: Cheese potato casserole
notes: Cubed or shredded potatoes baked with sour cream, butter, cream of chicken soup, and shredded cheddar — funeral-potatoes-style.

name: Dilly casserole bread
notes: A cottage-cheese yeast bread folded with dill and onion, baked in a casserole dish — chewy, savory, and tangy.

name: Peanut butter roll
notes: Mashed potato kneaded with powdered sugar into a pliable dough, rolled around peanut butter, and sliced into pinwheels — Appalachian.

name: Churros
notes: A piped pâte-à-choux-like dough deep-fried into ridged sticks and tossed in cinnamon sugar — served with chocolate dipping sauce.

name: Vegetable pie
notes: A pastry shell or crustless pan filled with mixed vegetables baked in an egg-and-cheese custard — meatless quiche-style.

name: Dream cake
notes: A yellow cake mix with crushed pineapple, vanilla pudding, eggs, and oil — finished with cream cheese frosting and chopped pecans.

name: Veggie casserole
notes: A mix of vegetables baked with cheese, mayo, and a buttery cracker or breadcrumb topping.

name: Bourbon slush
notes: Frozen tea-and-fruit-juice concentrate spiked with bourbon, then topped with lemon-lime soda at serving — a slushy Kentucky cocktail.

name: Butter pecan cake
notes: A butter cake mix combined with vanilla pudding and toasted pecans, baked into a Bundt cake — sometimes glazed with caramel.

name: Pistachio pudding salad
notes: Instant pistachio pudding mix folded with crushed pineapple, mini marshmallows, and whipped topping — same family as Watergate salad.

name: Canadian cheese soup
notes: Cubed potatoes simmered with chicken broth, milk, and shredded cheddar — sometimes with carrots and onion; Wisconsin/Canadian-border style.

name: Raisin bars
notes: Plumped raisins folded into a spiced butter-sugar-egg-and-flour batter, baked into bars — sometimes glazed with powdered sugar.

name: Watermelon feta salad
notes: Cubed watermelon tossed with crumbled feta, mint, red onion, lime, and olive oil — a bright summer salad.

name: Bulgogi
notes: Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, and Asian pear, then grilled or pan-cooked hot — Korean classic.

name: Potato chowder
notes: Diced potatoes simmered in broth with onion and bacon, finished with milk and cream — sometimes topped with cheddar and chives.

name: Chicken nachos
notes: Tortilla chips piled with shredded chicken, salsa or enchilada sauce, melted cheese, jalapeños, and sour cream.

name: Mexican pie
notes: Layered ground beef, beans, salsa, and cheese baked over a cornbread or biscuit crust — same family as tamale pie / impossible taco pie.

name: Chunky guacamole
notes: Mashed ripe avocados mixed with diced tomato, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime, and salt — chunky rather than smooth.

name: Sweet potato soup
notes: Roasted sweet potatoes simmered with onion, ginger, and chicken broth, blended smooth and finished with cream and warm spices.

name: Grilled shrimp
notes: Shrimp marinated in olive oil, lemon, garlic, and herbs, then threaded on skewers and grilled hot until just opaque.

name: Vermicelli salad
notes: Cooked vermicelli or fine pasta tossed with diced peppers, olives, and Italian-style dressing — chilled overnight.

name: Texas trash (party mix)
notes: Chex cereals, pretzels, and mixed nuts coated in a buttery Worcestershire-and-seasoning blend, baked until crisp — Chex-mix Texas variant.

name: Peanut blossom cookies (variant)
notes: Peanut butter cookies rolled in sugar and pressed with a Hershey's Kiss as soon as they come out of the oven.

name: Mashed potato cake
notes: A spiced sweet cake with mashed potato folded into the batter for moistness, often with raisins, nuts, and chocolate.

name: Cherry fluff
notes: Cherry pie filling folded with sweetened condensed milk, crushed pineapple, mini marshmallows, and whipped topping — a Southern dessert salad.

name: Marshmallow treats (Rice Krispies)
notes: Rice Krispies stirred into melted butter and marshmallows, pressed into a pan, and cut into squares.

name: Pineapple cheese casserole
notes: Canned pineapple chunks baked with sharp cheddar, sugar, and a buttery cracker topping — a Southern sweet-savory side.

name: Drop cookies
notes: A generic name for any butter-sugar-egg-flour cookie dough dropped from a spoon onto a sheet (no rolling and cutting).

name: Seafood pasta
notes: Linguine or fettuccine tossed with shrimp, scallops, or crab in a garlic-butter-olive-oil sauce with white wine and herbs.

name: Apple pie cake
notes: A moist butter cake folded with chopped apples, sometimes with pecans — eats more like a pie filling baked into a cake.

name: Johnny Marzetti casserole
notes: Cooked elbow macaroni mixed with ground beef, mushrooms, onions, peppers, and tomato sauce, topped with cheese and baked — an Ohio classic.

name: Baked chicken parmesan
notes: Breaded chicken breasts baked, then topped with marinara and mozzarella and broiled briefly to melt — a lighter chicken parm.

name: Dessert pizza
notes: A sugar-cookie crust spread with sweetened cream cheese and topped with sliced fresh fruit and a citrus glaze.

name: Cheese pinwheels
notes: Tortillas or crescent dough spread with seasoned cream cheese and shredded cheddar, rolled and sliced into pinwheels.

name: Hearty potato soup
notes: Diced potatoes simmered with onion and chicken broth, blended (or partially mashed), and finished with milk, cream, and butter.

name: Cherry cream pie
notes: A no-bake pie of sweetened cream cheese filling in a graham crust, topped with canned cherry pie filling.

name: Corn pie
notes: Sweet corn kernels baked in a custard of eggs, milk, sugar, and butter in a single crust — a Pennsylvania-Dutch sweet-savory pie.

name: Butterscotch cake
notes: A yellow cake mix combined with butterscotch pudding mix, baked into a Bundt and finished with butterscotch glaze.

name: Gingersnap cookies
notes: Crisp spiced cookies of molasses, butter, brown sugar, and ginger — rolled in sugar and baked until they crackle on top.

name: Venison stroganoff
notes: Strips of venison sautéed with mushrooms and onion in a sour-cream-and-mustard sauce, served over egg noodles.

name: Party fruit salad
notes: A no-bake fruit salad of pineapple, mandarin oranges, and bananas folded with cream cheese, marshmallows, and whipped topping.

name: Strawberry surprise
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of pretzel or cake-mix crust, sweetened cream cheese, and strawberry-Jello-with-frozen-strawberries.

name: Orange muffins
notes: Tender muffins bright with orange juice and zest, sometimes folded with raisins or cranberries — finished with an orange glaze.

name: Cherry coffee cake
notes: A tender butter cake topped with canned cherry pie filling and a buttery streusel — served with morning coffee.

name: Crazy chocolate cake (wacky)
notes: A Depression-era one-bowl cocoa cake with no eggs, butter, or milk — leavened by vinegar reacting with baking soda; mixed right in the pan.

name: Buttermilk fudge
notes: Sugar, butter, buttermilk, and baking soda cooked to soft-ball and beaten until creamy — a tangy white fudge often with pecans.

name: Mounds cake
notes: A chocolate sheet cake topped warm with a coconut-and-marshmallow layer and a chocolate-almond ganache — Mounds candy bar flavors.

name: Caramel pecan pie
notes: A pecan pie with melted caramels stirred into the egg-sugar-corn-syrup custard — extra-chewy and toffee-sweet.

name: Braised short ribs
notes: Beef short ribs seared, then slow-braised in red wine and broth with carrots, onion, garlic, and herbs until the meat falls off the bone.

name: Pumpkin torte
notes: A no-bake layered dessert of graham-cracker crust, sweetened cream cheese, spiced pumpkin pudding, and whipped topping.

name: Hot punch
notes: Cranberry and pineapple juice simmered with cinnamon sticks, cloves, and citrus — a hot non-alcoholic holiday drink.

name: Pineapple bake
notes: Crushed pineapple folded with eggs, sugar, butter, and bread cubes, baked into a sweet-savory side served with ham — same as scalloped pineapple.

name: Squash puppies
notes: Grated yellow squash mixed with cornmeal, eggs, and onion, dropped into oil and fried — hush-puppy variant with summer squash.

name: Mexican fudge
notes: A savory bake of layered Monterey Jack and cheddar with chopped chiles, bound by an egg custard — baked and cut into squares like fudge.

name: Fluffy pancakes
notes: A baking-soda-leavened buttermilk batter cooked on a hot griddle with butter — extra fluffy from beaten egg whites folded in.

name: Grilled salmon
notes: A salmon fillet brushed with oil and lemon, seasoned with salt and herbs, and grilled hot until just flaking.

name: Frozen fruit cups
notes: Mixed fruit and juice frozen in muffin cups or paper cups — a chilled summer treat, half snack and half dessert.

name: Southern biscuits
notes: A flaky quick bread of self-rising flour, cold butter or shortening, and buttermilk — patted, cut, and baked until tall.

name: Chinese cabbage salad
notes: Shredded napa or green cabbage tossed with crushed ramen noodles, slivered almonds, sesame seeds, and a soy-sesame-sugar dressing.

name: Butter pecan cookies
notes: Drop cookies of brown sugar, butter, and toasted pecans — chewy and toffee-toned, often glazed with brown-butter icing.

name: Chocolate eclairs
notes: Pâte-à-choux fingers baked hollow, filled with vanilla pastry cream, and topped with a chocolate glaze.

name: Hawaiian meatballs
notes: Pan-fried meatballs simmered in a sweet-and-sour sauce of pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, and soy — served over rice or as an appetizer.

name: Spring rolls
notes: Wheat or rice wrappers rolled around shredded vegetables (and sometimes pork or shrimp), deep-fried crisp or served fresh — Chinese/Vietnamese.

name: Rosemary chicken
notes: Chicken pieces marinated in olive oil, lemon, garlic, and fresh rosemary, then roasted or grilled until the skin is crisp.

name: Rhubarb muffins
notes: Tender muffins folded with chopped rhubarb, brown sugar, and cinnamon — often topped with a sugar-cinnamon streusel.

name: Brown sugar brownies (blondies)
notes: Brown-sugar-and-butter bars in the shape of brownies — chewy with toffee notes and chopped pecans.

name: Skillet cornbread
notes: A buttermilk cornmeal batter poured into a hot bacon-fat- or butter-greased cast-iron skillet — crisp-edged Southern cornbread.

name: Mock pecan pie (oatmeal)
notes: A pecan-pie-style filling using oats instead of pecans — eggs, sugar, butter, corn syrup, and oats baked in a single crust.

name: Hash browns casserole
notes: Frozen hash browns baked with sour cream, cream of chicken soup, and shredded cheddar under a cornflake topping — funeral-potatoes-style.

name: Peppermint bark
notes: White chocolate melted and poured over a layer of dark chocolate, topped with crushed peppermint candy canes — Christmas candy.

name: Prime rib
notes: A whole standing rib roast of beef seasoned and slow-roasted at low heat, then seared at high heat for a crust — served with horseradish cream.

name: Naan
notes: A leavened flatbread of flour, yogurt, and yeast, slapped against a hot tandoor (or skillet) and finished with butter — Indian.

name: Fried onion rings
notes: Sliced onions dipped in milk-and-egg batter, dredged in seasoned flour, and deep-fried until crisp and golden.

name: Stuffed chicken breast
notes: Pounded chicken breasts rolled around herbed stuffing, spinach-and-feta, or ham-and-cheese, then breaded and baked or pan-fried.

name: Hot dish
notes: A Midwestern catch-all casserole of ground beef, vegetables, and cream-of-soup gravy, often topped with tater tots or potato chips.

name: Copper penny salad
notes: Sliced cooked carrots ("pennies") tossed with bell pepper and onion in a tangy tomato-soup-and-vinegar marinade — chilled overnight.

name: Tuna spread
notes: Canned tuna mixed with cream cheese, mayo, lemon, and seasonings — served chilled with crackers or as a sandwich filling.

name: Walnut cake
notes: A buttery layer cake folded with finely chopped walnuts and often frosted with cream cheese or maple icing.

name: Scandinavian fruit soup
notes: A sweet "soup" of mixed dried fruit (prunes, apricots, raisins) simmered with sugar, tapioca, cinnamon, and lemon — chilled or warm.

name: Lefse
notes: A thin Norwegian potato flatbread cooked on a hot griddle — rolled with butter and sugar (or jam) for a sweet snack.

name: Old-fashioned pound cake
notes: A classic pound cake of equal parts butter, sugar, eggs, and flour — dense, fine-crumbed, baked in a tube or loaf pan.

name: Honey wheat bread
notes: A yeasted sandwich loaf of whole-wheat and bread flour sweetened with honey — soft crumb, nutty wheat-flour flavor.

name: Sausage roll
notes: Seasoned sausage meat wrapped in puff pastry and baked into a sliceable log — a British pub snack.

name: Sausage pie
notes: Browned breakfast sausage layered with eggs, cheese, and peppers in a pastry shell, baked into a savory quiche-style pie.

name: Ham and bean soup
notes: Dried navy or great northern beans slow-simmered with a ham hock or cubed ham, onion, carrots, celery, and herbs in broth.

name: Tortilla pinwheels (variant)
notes: Flour tortillas spread with seasoned cream cheese, salsa, olives, and green chiles, rolled and sliced into pinwheels.

name: Marinated broccoli
notes: Blanched broccoli florets tossed in an oil-and-vinegar marinade with garlic, herbs, and red pepper — chilled overnight.

name: Banana loaf
notes: A moist quick bread sweetened by mashed ripe bananas, with butter, eggs, and flour — same as banana bread.

name: Pea casserole
notes: Sweet peas baked with mushrooms, water chestnuts, mushroom soup, and butter — sometimes with shrimp folded in.

name: Nut roll
notes: A sweet yeasted dough rolled around a ground-walnut-and-sugar filling, baked into a log, sliced into spirals — Eastern European holiday bread.

name: Sunday chicken
notes: Chicken pieces baked with rice and cream of mushroom soup in a covered pan — a hands-off Sunday-dinner casserole.

name: Saucy pork chops
notes: Pork chops simmered in a sweet-tangy sauce of ketchup, brown sugar, and Worcestershire — served over rice or noodles.

name: Chicken broccoli bake
notes: Cooked chicken and broccoli baked in a mayo-lemon-cream-of-chicken-soup sauce under cheese and buttered breadcrumbs.

name: Fresh spinach salad
notes: Baby spinach with crisp bacon, sliced mushrooms, hard-boiled egg, and red onion in a sweet warm-bacon dressing.

name: Tuna cakes
notes: Canned tuna bound with egg, breadcrumbs, lemon, and onion, formed into patties and pan-fried — a tuna-version of crab cakes.

name: Self-filled cupcakes (black bottom)
notes: Chocolate cupcake batter topped with a spoonful of sweetened cream cheese and chocolate chips — bakes with a cheesecake-like cap.

name: Tang pie
notes: Frozen Tang concentrate (or orange juice) whipped into sweetened condensed milk and folded with whipped topping, set in a graham crust.

name: Six-week refrigerator muffins
notes: A bran-and-buttermilk muffin batter mixed once and stored in the fridge up to six weeks — bake off in small batches as needed.

name: Jumbo raisin cookies
notes: Large soft drop cookies of butter, brown sugar, oats, plumped raisins, and warm spices — chewy and homey.

name: Corn bake
notes: A spoon-bread-style bake of corn kernels, creamed corn, eggs, butter, and sour cream — sweet, custardy, almost pudding-like.

name: Beef nacho casserole
notes: Layered seasoned ground beef, salsa, beans, and cheese baked over tortilla chips — a Tex-Mex one-pan casserole.

name: Turkey lasagna
notes: Layered lasagna noodles with ground turkey, ricotta, mozzarella, and marinara — a leaner alternative to beef lasagna.

name: Almond chicken
notes: Diced chicken stir-fried with sliced almonds, water chestnuts, peppers, and onions in a soy-garlic sauce — Chinese-American.

name: Butter pound cake
notes: A classic pound cake of equal parts butter, sugar, eggs, and flour — dense, fine-crumbed, and golden.

name: Pecan fingers (sandies)
notes: A butter-and-powdered-sugar shortbread folded with finely chopped pecans, shaped into fingers and rolled in powdered sugar.

name: German sweet chocolate cake
notes: A sweet-mild-chocolate layer cake filled and topped with a coconut-pecan caramel frosting — invented in Texas, named for German's baking chocolate.

name: Gumdrop cake
notes: A spiced fruit-and-nut cake with chopped gumdrops, candied fruit, and dates folded into the batter — fruitcake variant with a candy-store twist.

name: Bread and butter pudding
notes: Slices of buttered bread layered in a dish with raisins, soaked in an egg-milk-cream custard, and baked until set — British comfort dessert.

name: Dill bread
notes: A cottage-cheese yeast bread folded with fresh or dried dill and onion — chewy, savory, and tangy.

name: Braised red cabbage
notes: Shredded red cabbage slow-braised with apples, onions, vinegar, sugar, red wine, and warm spices — a German Rotkohl side.

name: Strawberry sorbet
notes: Strawberries blended with sugar syrup and lemon juice, churned or frozen and stirred until smooth — dairy-free fruit ice.

name: Creamy chicken casserole
notes: Cooked chicken and rice baked with sour cream, cream of chicken soup, mushrooms, and shredded cheese — a hands-off comfort casserole.

name: Cinnamon cookies
notes: Butter sugar cookies heavily cinnamon-spiced, sometimes rolled in cinnamon-sugar before baking — same family as snickerdoodles.

name: Roast leg of lamb
notes: A whole leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted to medium-rare and served with mint jelly or pan jus — Easter centerpiece.

name: Orange fluff
notes: Orange Jello set with mandarin oranges, crushed pineapple, and whipped topping — a Southern molded dessert salad.

name: Heavenly fruit salad
notes: Mandarin oranges, pineapple, and grapes folded with sweetened cream cheese and whipped topping — a chilled Southern dessert salad.

name: Cranberry coffee cake
notes: A sour-cream butter cake folded with cranberries and orange zest, topped with cinnamon-streusel or a powdered-sugar glaze.

name: Burgers
notes: Ground beef patties seasoned with salt and pepper, seared or grilled, served on soft buns with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle, and condiments.

name: Glazed fruit salad
notes: Mixed fresh fruit tossed with a cooked pudding-mix-and-pineapple-juice glaze — a chilled Southern picnic dessert salad.

name: Coconut shrimp
notes: Shrimp dipped in egg, coated in shredded coconut and breadcrumbs, and fried golden — served with a sweet-spicy dipping sauce.

name: Date squares (matrimonial cake)
notes: Cooked dates sandwiched between two layers of an oat-and-brown-sugar crumble, baked and cut into squares — Canadian "matrimonial cake".

name: White bean chicken chili
notes: Shredded chicken simmered with white beans, green chiles, cumin, and broth, finished with sour cream — Tex-Mex white chili.

name: Tuna melt
notes: Tuna salad piled on toasted bread, topped with cheese, and broiled or griddled until the cheese melts — a diner classic.

name: Pasta puttanesca
notes: Spaghetti tossed with a punchy sauce of tomatoes, olives, capers, anchovies, garlic, and chili flakes — a Neapolitan classic.
